sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ puruṣaniḥśreyasārthaṃ dharmajijñāsā |
meaning: अथातः पुरुषनिःश्रेयसार्थं धर्मजिज्ञासा ।
text: Now, therefore, the desire to know the sacred law for their welfare (should arise) in (initiated) men.

sanskrit_iast: jñātvā cānutiṣṭhan dhārmikaḥ |
meaning: ज्ञात्वा चानुतिष्ठन् धार्मिकः ।
text: He who knows and follows the (sacred law is called) a righteous man.

sanskrit_iast: praśasyatamo bhavati loke pretya ca svargalokaṃ samaśnute |
meaning: प्रशस्यतमो भवति लोके प्रेत्य च स्वर्गलोकं समश्नुते ।
text: He becomes most worthy of praise in this world and after death gains heaven.

sanskrit_iast: śrutismṛtivihito dharmaḥ |
meaning: श्रुतिस्मृतिविहितो धर्मः ।
text: The sacred law has been settled by the revealed texts and by the tradition (of the sages).

sanskrit_iast: tadalābhe śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇam |
meaning: तदलाभे शिष्टाचारः प्रमाणम् ।
text: On failure of (rules given in) these (two sources) the practice of the Śishṭas (has) authority.

sanskrit_iast: śiṣṭaḥ punar akāmātmā |
meaning: शिष्टः पुनर् अकामात्मा ।
text: But he whose heart is free from desire (is called) a Śishṭa.

sanskrit_iast: agṛhyamāṇakāraṇo dharmaḥ |
meaning: अगृह्यमाणकारणो धर्मः ।
text: (Acts sanctioned by) the sacred law (are those) for which no (worldly) cause is perceptible.

sanskrit_iast: āryāvartaḥ prāg ādarśāt pratyak kālakavanād udak pāriyātrād dakṣiṇena himavataḥ |
meaning: आर्यावर्तः प्राग् आदर्शात् प्रत्यक् कालकवनाद् उदक् पारियात्राद् दक्षिणेन हिमवतः ।
text: The country of the Āryas (Āryāvarta) lies to the east of the region where (the river Sarasvatī) disappears, to the west of the Black-forest, to the north of the Pāripātra (mountains), to the south of the Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa ca vindhyasya |
meaning: उत्तरेण च विन्ध्यस्य ।
text: (According to others it lies to the south of the Himālaya) and to the north of the Vindhya range (being limited east and west by the two oceans).

sanskrit_iast: tasmin deśe ye dharmās ye cācārās te sarvatra pratyetavyāḥ |
meaning: तस्मिन् देशे ये धर्मास् ये चाचारास् ते सर्वत्र प्रत्येतव्याः ।
text: Acts productive of spiritual merit, and customs which (are approved of) in that country, must be everywhere acknowledged (as authoritative);

sanskrit_iast: na tv anye pratilomakadharmāṇām |
meaning: न त्व् अन्ये प्रतिलोमकधर्माणाम् ।
text: But not different ones, (i.e. those) of (countries where) laws opposed (to those of Āryāvarta prevail).

sanskrit_iast: gaṅgāyamunayor antare 'py eke |
meaning: गङ्गायमुनयोर् अन्तरे ऽप्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare the country of the Āryas to be situated) between the (rivers) Gaṅgā and Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad vā kṛṣṇamṛgo vicarati tāvad brahmavarcasam ity anye |
meaning: यावद् वा कृष्णमृगो विचरति तावद् ब्रह्मवर्चसम् इत्य् अन्ये ।
text: Others (state as) an alternative, that spiritual pre-eminence (is found) as far as the black antelope grazes.

sanskrit_iast: athāpi bhāllavino nidāne gāthām udāharanti |
meaning: अथापि भाल्लविनो निदाने गाथाम् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: Now the Bhāllavins quote also (the following) verse in the Nidāna:

sanskrit_iast: paścāt sindhur vidhāraṇī sūryasyodayanaṃ puraḥ | yāvat kṛṣṇo 'bhidhāvati tāvad vai brahmavarcasam iti |
meaning: पश्चात् सिन्धुर् विधारणी सूर्यस्योदयनं पुरः । यावत् कृष्णो ऽभिधावति तावद् वै ब्रह्मवर्चसम् इति ।
text: 'In the west the boundary-river, in the east the region where the sun rises,--as far as the black antelope wanders (between these two limits), so far spiritual pre-eminence (is found).

sanskrit_iast: traividyavṛddhā yaṃ brūyur dharmaṃ dharmavido janāḥ | pavane pāvane caiva sa dharmo nātra saṃśaya iti |
meaning: त्रैविद्यवृद्धा यं ब्रूयुर् धर्मं धर्मविदो जनाः । पवने पावने चैव स धर्मो नात्र संशय इति ।
text: 'Those religious acts which men, deeply versed in the knowledge of the three Vedas and acquainted with the sacred law, declare to be lawful, (are efficient) for purifying oneself and others.'

sanskrit_iast: deśadharmajātidharmakuladharmāñ śrutyabhāvād abravīn manuḥ |
meaning: देशधर्मजातिधर्मकुलधर्माञ् श्रुत्यभावाद् अब्रवीन् मनुः ।
text: Manu has declared that the (peculiar) laws of countries, castes, and families (may be followed) in the absence of (rules of) the revealed texts.

sanskrit_iast: sūryābhyuditaḥ sūryābhinimruktaḥ kunakhī śyāvadantaḥ parivittiḥ parivettāgredidhiṣūr didhiṣūpatir vīrahā brahmojjha ity enasvinaḥ |
meaning: सूर्याभ्युदितः सूर्याभिनिम्रुक्तः कुनखी श्यावदन्तः परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ताग्रेदिधिषूर् दिधिषूपतिर् वीरहा ब्रह्मोज्झ इत्य् एनस्विनः ।
text: Sinful men are, he who sleeps at sunrise or at sunset, he who has deformed nails or black teeth, he whose younger brother was married first, he who married before his elder brother, the husband of a younger sister married before the elder, the husband of an elder sister whose younger sister was married first, he who extinguishes the sacred fires, (and) he who forgets the Veda through neglect of the daily recitation.

sanskrit_iast: pañca mahāpātakāny ācakṣate |
meaning: पञ्च महापातकान्य् आचक्षते ।
text: They state that there are five mortal sins. (mahāpātaka),

sanskrit_iast: gurutalpaṃ surāpānaṃ bhrūṇahatyā brāhmaṇasuvarṇāpaharaṇaṃ patitasaṃyogaś ca |
meaning: गुरुतल्पं सुरापानं भ्रूणहत्या ब्राह्मणसुवर्णापहरणं पतितसंयोगश् च ।
text: (Viz. violating) a Guru's bed, drinking (the spirituous liquor called) surā, slaying a learned Brāhmaṇa, stealing the gold of a Brāhmaṇa, and associating with outcasts,

sanskrit_iast: brāhmeṇa vā yaunena vā |
meaning: ब्राह्मेण वा यौनेन वा ।
text: Either by (entering into) spiritual or matrimonial (connexion with them).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran | yājanādhyāpanād yaunān na tu yānāsanād dānāditi |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । संवत्सरेण पतति पतितेन सहाचरन् । याजनाध्यापनाद् यौनान् न तु यानासनाद् दानादिति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'He who during a year associates with an outcast becomes (likewise) an outcast; not by sacrificing for him, by teaching him or by (forming) a matrimonial (alliance with him), but by using the same carriage or seat.'

sanskrit_iast: yo 'gnīn apavidhyed guruṃ ca yaḥ pratidaghnuyān nāstiko nāstikavṛttiḥ somaṃ ca vikrīṇīyād ity upapātakāni |
meaning: यो ऽग्नीन् अपविध्येद् गुरुं च यः प्रतिदघ्नुयान् नास्तिको नास्तिकवृत्तिः सोमं च विक्रीणीयाद् इत्य् उपपातकानि ।
text: A minor offence causing loss of caste (ūpapātaka, is committed by him) who (after beginning an Agnihotra sacrifice) forsakes the sacred fires, and by him who offends a Guru, by an atheist, by him who takes his livelihood from atheists, and by him who sells the Soma (plant).

sanskrit_iast: tisro brāhmaṇasya bhāryā varṇānupūrveṇa dve rājanyasya ekaikā vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ |
meaning: तिस्रो ब्राह्मणस्य भार्या वर्णानुपूर्वेण द्वे राजन्यस्य एकैका वैश्यशूद्रयोः ।
text: Three wives (are permitted) to a Brāhmaṇa according to the order of the castes, two to a Kshatriya, one to a Vaiśya and to a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrām apy eke mantravarjaṃ tadvat |
meaning: शूद्राम् अप्य् एके मन्त्रवर्जं तद्वत् ।
text: Some declare (that twice-born men may marry) even a female of the Śūdra caste, like those (other wives), without (the recitation of) Vedic texts.

sanskrit_iast: tathā na kuryāt |
meaning: तथा न कुर्यात् ।
text: Let him not act thus.

sanskrit_iast: ato hi dhruvaḥ kulāpakarṣaḥ pretya cāsvargaḥ |
meaning: अतो हि ध्रुवः कुलापकर्षः प्रेत्य चास्वर्गः ।
text: For in consequence of such (a marriage) the degradation of the family certainly ensues, and after death the loss of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ vivāhāḥ |
meaning: षड् विवाहाः ।
text: There are six marriage-rites,

sanskrit_iast: brāhmo daiva ārṣo gāndharvaḥ kṣātro mānuṣaś ceti |
meaning: ब्राह्मो दैव आर्षो गान्धर्वः क्षात्रो मानुषश् चेति ।
text: (Viz.) that of Brahman (brāhma), that of the gods (daiva), that of the Ri shis (ārsha), that of the Gandharvas (gāndharva), that of the Kshatriyas (kshātra), and that of men (mānusha).

sanskrit_iast: icchata udakapūrvaṃ yāṃ dadyāt sa brāhmaḥ |
meaning: इच्छत उदकपूर्वं यां दद्यात् स ब्राह्मः ।
text: If the father, pouring out a libation of water, gives his (daughter) to a suitor, that (is called) the Brahma-rite

sanskrit_iast: yajñatantre vitata ṛtvije karma kurvate kanyāṃ dadyād alaṃkṛtya taṃ daivam ity ācakṣate |
meaning: यज्ञतन्त्रे वितत ऋत्विजे कर्म कुर्वते कन्यां दद्याद् अलंकृत्य तं दैवम् इत्य् आचक्षते ।
text: If (the father) gives his daughter, decking her with ornaments, to an officiating priest, whilst a sacrifice is being performed, that is called the Daiva-rite.

sanskrit_iast: gomithunena cārṣaḥ |
meaning: गोमिथुनेन चार्षः ।
text: And (if the father gives his daughter) for a cow and a bull, (that is called) the Ārsha-rite.

sanskrit_iast: sakāmāṃ kāmayamānaḥ sadṛśīṃ yonim uhyāt sa gāndharvaḥ |
meaning: सकामां कामयमानः सदृशीं योनिम् उह्यात् स गान्धर्वः ।
text: If a lover takes a loving female of equal caste, that (is called) the Gāndharva-rite.

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ haranti sa kṣātraḥ |
meaning: यां हरन्ति स क्षात्रः ।

sanskrit_iast: sa mānuṣaḥ |
meaning: स मानुषः ।

sanskrit_iast: tasmād duhitṛmate 'dhirathaṃ śataṃ deyam itīha krayo vijñāyate |
meaning: तस्माद् दुहितृमते ऽधिरथं शतं देयम् इतीह क्रयो विज्ञायते ।

sanskrit_iast: yā patyuḥ krītā saty athānyaiś caratīti ha cāturmāsyeṣu |
meaning: या पत्युः क्रीता सत्य् अथान्यैश् चरतीति ह चातुर्मास्येषु ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | vidyā pranaṣṭā punar abhyupaiti kulapraṇāśe tv iha sarvanāśaḥ | kulāpadeśena hayo 'pi pūjyas tasmāt kulīnāṃ striyam udvahantīti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । विद्या प्रनष्टा पुनर् अभ्युपैति कुलप्रणाशे त्व् इह सर्वनाशः । कुलापदेशेन हयो ऽपि पूज्यस् तस्मात् कुलीनां स्त्रियम् उद्वहन्तीति ।

sanskrit_iast: trayo varṇā brāhmaṇasya nirdeśena varteran |
meaning: त्रयो वर्णा ब्राह्मणस्य निर्देशेन वर्तेरन् ।
text: The three (lower) castes shall live according to the teaching of the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo dharmān prabrūyāt |
meaning: ब्राह्मणो धर्मान् प्रब्रूयात् ।
text: The Brāhmaṇa shall declare their duties,

sanskrit_iast: rājā cānuśiṣyāt |
meaning: राजा चानुशिष्यात् ।
text: And the king shall govern them accordingly.

sanskrit_iast: rājā tu dharmeṇānuśāsan ṣaṣṭhaṃ dhanasya haret |
meaning: राजा तु धर्मेणानुशासन् षष्ठं धनस्य हरेत् ।
text: But a king who rules in accordance with the sacred law, may take the sixth part of the wealth (of his subjects),

sanskrit_iast: anyatra brāhmaṇāt |
meaning: अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणात् ।
text: Except from Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭāpūrtasya tu ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ bhajatīti ha |
meaning: इष्टापूर्तस्य तु षष्ठम् अंशं भजतीति ह ।
text: It has been declared in the Veda, 'But he obtains the sixth part of (the merit which Brāhmaṇas gain by) sacrifices and charitable works.'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo vedam āḍhyaṃ karoti brāhmaṇo āpada uddharati tasmād brāhmaṇo 'nādyaḥ | somo 'sya rājā bhavatīti ha |
meaning: ब्राह्मणो वेदम् आढ्यं करोति ब्राह्मणो आपद उद्धरति तस्माद् ब्राह्मणो ऽनाद्यः । सोमो ऽस्य राजा भवतीति ह ।
text: (It is further stated in the Veda), 'The Brāhmaṇa makes the Veda rich; the Brāhmaṇa saves from misfortune; therefore the Brāhmaṇa shall not be made a source of subsistence. Soma is his king.'

sanskrit_iast: pretya cābhyudayikam iti ha vijñāyate ha vijñāyata iti |
meaning: प्रेत्य चाभ्युदयिकम् इति ह विज्ञायते ह विज्ञायत इति ।
text: Further (another passage says), 'After death bliss (awaits the king who does not oppress Brāhmaṇas).'

sanskrit_iast: catvāro varṇā brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāḥ |
meaning: चत्वारो वर्णा ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियवैश्यशूद्राः ।
text: There are four castes (varṇa), Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast: trayo varṇā dvijātayo brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyāḥ |
meaning: त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयो ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियवैश्याः ।
text: Three castes, Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, and Vaiśyas, (are called) twice-born.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām mātur agre vijananaṃ dvitīyaṃ mauñjibandhane | atrāsya mātā sāvitrī pitā tv ācārya ucyate |
meaning: तेषाम् मातुर् अग्रे विजननं द्वितीयं मौञ्जिबन्धने । अत्रास्य माता सावित्री पिता त्व् आचार्य उच्यते ।
text: Their first birth is from their mother; the second from the investiture with the sacred girdle. In that (second birth) the Sāvitrī is the mother, but the teacher is said to be the father.

sanskrit_iast: vedapradānāt pitety ācāryam ācākṣate |
meaning: वेदप्रदानात् पितेत्य् आचार्यम् आचाक्षते ।
text: They call the teacher father, because he gives instruction in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: tathāpy udāharanti | dvayam u ha vai puruṣasya reto brāhmaṇasyordhvaṃ nābher adhastād avācīnam anyat tad yad ūrdhvaṃ nābhes tena haitat prajā jāyate yad brāhmaṇān upanayati yad adhyāpayati yad yājayati yat sādhukaroti | atha yad avācīnaṃ nābhes tenehāsyaurasī prajā jāyate | tasmāc chrotriyam anūcānam aprajo 'sīti na vadantīti |
meaning: तथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । द्वयम् उ ह वै पुरुषस्य रेतो ब्राह्मणस्योर्ध्वं नाभेर् अधस्ताद् अवाचीनम् अन्यत् तद् यद् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस् तेन हैतत् प्रजा जायते यद् ब्राह्मणान् उपनयति यद् अध्यापयति यद् याजयति यत् साधुकरोति । अथ यद् अवाचीनं नाभेस् तेनेहास्यौरसी प्रजा जायते । तस्माच् छ्रोत्रियम् अनूचानम् अप्रजो ऽसीति न वदन्तीति ।
text: They quote also (the following passage from the Veda) to the same (effect): 'Of two kinds, forsooth, is the virile energy of a man learned in the Vedas, that which (resides) above the navel and the other which below (the navel) descends down-wards. Through that which (resides) above the navel, his offspring is produced, when he initiates Brāhmaṇas, when he teaches them, when he causes them to offer oblations, when he makes them holy. By that which resides below the navel the children of his body are produced. Therefore they never say, to a Śrotriya, who teaches the Veda, "Thud art destitute of offspring."'

sanskrit_iast: hārīto 'py udāharati | na hy asmin vidyate karma kimcid ā mauñjibandhanāt | vṛttyā śūdrasamo hy eṣa yāvad vede na jāyata iti |
meaning: हारीतो ऽप्य् उदाहरति । न ह्य् अस्मिन् विद्यते कर्म किम्चिद् आ मौञ्जिबन्धनात् । वृत्त्या शूद्रसमो ह्य् एष यावद् वेदे न जायत इति ।
text: Hārīta also quotes (the following verse): 'No religious rite can be performed by a (child) before he has been girt with the sacred girdle, since he is on a level with a Śūdra before his (new) birth from the Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: anyatrodakakarmasvadhāpitṛsaṃyuktebhyaḥ |
meaning: अन्यत्रोदककर्मस्वधापितृसंयुक्तेभ्यः ।
text: (The above prohibition refers to all rites) except those connected with libations of water, (the exclamation) Svadhā, and the manes.

sanskrit_iast: vidyā ha vai brāhmaṇam ājagāma gopāya māṃ śevadhis te 'ham asmi | asūyakāyānṛjaveyatāya na māṃ brūyā vīryavatī tathā syām |
meaning: विद्या ह वै ब्राह्मणम् आजगाम गोपाय मां शेवधिस् ते ऽहम् अस्मि । असूयकायानृजवेयताय न मां ब्रूया वीर्यवती तथा स्याम् ।
text: Sacred learning approached a Brāhmaṇa (and said to him), 'Preserve me, I am thy treasure, reveal me not to a scorner, nor to a wicked man, nor to one of uncontrolled passions: so (preserved) I shall become strong.'

sanskrit_iast: yam eva vidyāḥ śucim apramattaṃ medhāvinaṃ brahmacaryopapannam | yas te na druhyet katamaccanāhas tasmai māṃ brūyā nidhipāya brahman |
meaning: यम् एव विद्याः शुचिम् अप्रमत्तं मेधाविनं ब्रह्मचर्योपपन्नम् । यस् ते न द्रुह्येत् कतमच्चनाहस् तस्मै मां ब्रूया निधिपाय ब्रह्मन् ।
text: 'Reveal me, O Brāhmaṇa, as to the keeper of thy treasure, to him whom thou shalt know to be pure, attentive, intelligent, and chaste, who will not offend thee nor revile thee.'

sanskrit_iast: ya ātṛṇatty avitathena karṇāv aduḥkhaṃ kurvann amṛtaṃ saṃprayacchan | taṃ manyeta pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tasmai na druhyet katamaccanāhaḥ |
meaning: य आतृणत्त्य् अवितथेन कर्णाव् अदुःखं कुर्वन्न् अमृतं संप्रयच्छन् । तं मन्येत पितरं मातरं च तस्मै न द्रुह्येत् कतमच्चनाहः ।
text: '(That man) who fills his ears with truth, who frees him from pain and confers immortality upon him, (the pupil) shall consider as his father and mother; him he must never grieve nor revile.'

sanskrit_iast: adhyāpitā ye guruṃ nādriyante viprā vācā manasā karmaṇā vā | yathaiva te na guror bhojanīyās tathaiva tān na bhunakti śrutaṃ tat |
meaning: अध्यापिता ये गुरुं नाद्रियन्ते विप्रा वाचा मनसा कर्मणा वा । यथैव ते न गुरोर् भोजनीयास् तथैव तान् न भुनक्ति श्रुतं तत् ।
text: 'As those Brāhmaṇas who, after receiving instruction, do not honour their teacher by their speech, in their hearts or by their acts, will not be profitable to their teacher, even so that sacred learning (which they acquired) will not profit them.'

sanskrit_iast: dahaty agnir yathā kakṣaṃ brahma pṛṣṭam anādṛtam | na brahma tasmai prabrūyāc chakyaṃ mānam akurvata iti |
meaning: दहत्य् अग्निर् यथा कक्षं ब्रह्म पृष्टम् अनादृतम् । न ब्रह्म तस्मै प्रब्रूयाच् छक्यं मानम् अकुर्वत इति ।
text: 'As fire consumes dry grass, even so the Veda, asked for, (but) not honoured, (destroys the enquirer). Let him not proclaim the Veda to that man, who does not show him honour according to his ability.'

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭ karmāṇi brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: षट् कर्माणि ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: The (lawful) occupations of a Brāhmaṇa are six,

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyādhyayanam adhyāpanaṃ yajño yajanaṃ dānaṃ pratigrahaś ceti |
meaning: स्वाध्यायाध्ययनम् अध्यापनं यज्ञो यजनं दानं प्रतिग्रहश् चेति ।
text: Studying the Veda, teaching, sacrificing for himself, sacrificing for. others, giving alms, and accepting gifts.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi rājanyasya |
meaning: त्रीणि राजन्यस्य ।
text: (The lawful occupations) of a Kshatriya are three,

sanskrit_iast: adhyayanaṃ yajño dānaṃ ca |
meaning: अध्ययनं यज्ञो दानं च ।
text: Studying, sacrificing for himself, and bestowing gifts;

sanskrit_iast: śastreṇa ca prajāpālanaṃ svadharmas tena jīvet |
meaning: शस्त्रेण च प्रजापालनं स्वधर्मस् तेन जीवेत् ।
text: And his peculiar duty is to protect the people with his weapons; let him gain his livelihood thereby.

sanskrit_iast: etāny eva vaiśyasya |
meaning: एतान्य् एव वैश्यस्य ।
text: (The lawful occupations) of a Vaiśya are the same (as those mentioned above, Sūtra 16),

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣir vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyaṃ kusīdaṃ ca |
meaning: कृषिर् वाणिज्यं पाशुपाल्यं कुसीदं च ।
text: Besides, agriculture, trading, tending cattle, and lending money at interest,

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ paricaryā śūdrasya niyatā ca vṛttiḥ |
meaning: तेषां परिचर्या शूद्रस्य नियता च वृत्तिः ।
text: To serve those (superior castes) has been fixed as the means of livelihood for a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: niyatakeśaveṣāḥ sarve vā muktakeśāḥ śikhāvarjam |
meaning: नियतकेशवेषाः सर्वे वा मुक्तकेशाः शिखावर्जम् ।
text: (Men of) all (castes) may wear their hair arranged according to the customs fixed (for their family), or allow it to hang down excepting the lock on the crown of the head.

sanskrit_iast: ajīvantaḥ svadharmeṇānantarāṃ yavīyasīṃ vṛttim ātiṣṭheran |
meaning: अजीवन्तः स्वधर्मेणानन्तरां यवीयसीं वृत्तिम् आतिष्ठेरन् ।
text: Those who are unable to live by their own lawful occupation may adopt (that of) the next inferior (caste),

sanskrit_iast: na tu kadācij jyāyasīm |
meaning: न तु कदाचिज् ज्यायसीम् ।
text: But never (that of a) higher (caste).

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyajīvikām āsthāya paṇyena jīvato 'śmalavaṇamaṇiśāṇakauśeyakṣaumājināni ca |
meaning: वैश्यजीविकाम् आस्थाय पण्येन जीवतो ऽश्मलवणमणिशाणकौशेयक्षौमाजिनानि च ।
text: (A Brāhmaṇa and a Kshatriya) who have re-sorted to a Vaiśya's mode of living, and maintain themselves by trade (shall not sell) stones, salt, hempen (cloth), silk, linen (cloth), and skins,

sanskrit_iast: tāntavaṃ raktaṃ sarvaṃ ca |
meaning: तान्तवं रक्तं सर्वं च ।
text: Nor any kind of dyed cloth,

sanskrit_iast: kṛtānnaṃ puṣpaphalamūlāni gandharasā udakaṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ rasaḥ somaś ca śastraṃ viṣaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kṣīraṃ ca savikāram ayas trapu jatu sīsaṃ ca |
meaning: कृतान्नं पुष्पफलमूलानि गन्धरसा उदकं चौषधीनां रसः सोमश् च शस्त्रं विषं मांसं च क्षीरं च सविकारम् अयस् त्रपु जतु सीसं च ।
text: Nor prepared food, flowers, fruit, roots, per-fumes, substances (used for) flavouring (food); nor water, the juice extracted from plants; nor Soma, weapons, poison; nor flesh, nor milk, nor preparations from it, iron, tin, lac, and lead,

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | sadyaḥ patati māṃsena lākṣayā lavaṇena ca | tryaheṇa śūdro bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ kṣīravikrayāditi |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । सद्यः पतति मांसेन लाक्षया लवणेन च । त्र्यहेण शूद्रो भवति ब्राह्मणः क्षीरविक्रयादिति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'By (selling) flesh, lac, and salt a Brāhmaṇa at once becomes an outcast; by selling milk he. becomes (equal to) a Śūdra after three days.'

sanskrit_iast: grāmapaśūnām ekaśaphāḥ keśinaś ca sarve cāraṇyāḥ paśavo vayāṃsi daṃṣṭriṇaś ca |
meaning: ग्रामपशूनाम् एकशफाः केशिनश् च सर्वे चारण्याः पशवो वयांसि दंष्ट्रिणश् च ।
text: Among tame animals those with uncloven hoofs, and those that have an abundance of hair, (must not be sold), nor any wild animals, (nor) birds, nor beasts that have tusks (or fangs).

sanskrit_iast: dhānyānāṃ tilān āhuḥ |
meaning: धान्यानां तिलान् आहुः ।
text: Among the various kinds of grain they mention sesamum (as forbidden).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | bhojanābhyañjanād dānād yad anyat kurute tilaiḥ | kṛmibhūtaḥ śvaviṣṭhāyāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha majjatīti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । भोजनाभ्यञ्जनाद् दानाद् यद् अन्यत् कुरुते तिलैः । कृमिभूतः श्वविष्ठायां पितृभिः सह मज्जतीति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): If he applies sesamum to any other purpose, but food, anointing, and charitable gifts, he will be born again as a worm and, together with his ancestors, be plunged into his own ordure.'

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ vā svayaṃ kṛṣyotpādya tilān vikrīṇīran |
meaning: कामं वा स्वयं कृष्योत्पाद्य तिलान् विक्रीणीरन् ।
text: Or, at pleasure, they may sell (sesamum), if they themselves have produced it by tillage.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt sāṇḍābhyām anasyotābhyāṃ prāk prātarāśāt karṣī syāt |
meaning: तस्मात् साण्डाभ्याम् अनस्योताभ्यां प्राक् प्रातराशात् कर्षी स्यात् ।
text: For that purpose he shall plough before breakfast with two bulls whose noses have not been pierced.

sanskrit_iast: nidāghe 'paḥ prayacchet |
meaning: निदाघे ऽपः प्रयच्छेत् ।
text: (If he ploughs) in the hot season, he shall water (his beasts even in the morning).

sanskrit_iast: lāṅgalaṃ pavīravatsuśeva somapitsaru | tad ud vapati gām aviṃ prapharvyaṃ ca pīvarīṃ prasthāvad rathavāhanam iti |
meaning: लाङ्गलं पवीरवत्सुशेव सोमपित्सरु । तद् उद् वपति गाम् अविं प्रफर्व्यं च पीवरीं प्रस्थावद् रथवाहनम् इति ।
text: The plough is attended by strong males, provided with a useful share and with a handle (to be held) by the drinker of Soma; that raises (for him) a cow, a sheep, a stout damsel, and a swift horse for the chariot.

sanskrit_iast: kathaṃ hi laṅgalam udvaped anyatra dhānyavikrayāt |
meaning: कथं हि लङ्गलम् उद्वपेद् अन्यत्र धान्यविक्रयात् ।
text: For how could the plough raise (anything for him) if he did not sell grain?

sanskrit_iast: rasā rasair mahato hīnato vā vibhātavyāḥ |
meaning: रसा रसैर् महतो हीनतो वा विभातव्याः ।
text: Substances used for flavouring may be bartered for (other) substances of the same kind, be it for one more valuable or for one worth less.

sanskrit_iast: na tv eva lavaṇaṃ rasaiḥ |
meaning: न त्व् एव लवणं रसैः ।
text: But salt must never (be exchanged) for (other) substances-used for flavouring (food).

sanskrit_iast: tilataṇḍulapakvānaṃ vidyā mānuṣyāś ca vihitāḥ parivarttakena |
meaning: तिलतण्डुलपक्वानं विद्या मानुष्याश् च विहिताः परिवर्त्तकेन ।
text: It is permitted to barter sesamum, rice, cooked food, learning, and slaves (each for its own kind and the one for the other).

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇarājanyau vārdhuṣī na dadyātām |
meaning: ब्राह्मणराजन्यौ वार्धुषी न दद्याताम् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa and a Kshatriya shall not lend (anything at interest acting like) usurers.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | samarghaṃ dhānyam uddhṛtya mahārghaṃ yaḥ prayacchati | sa vai vārdhuṣiko nāma brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । समर्घं धान्यम् उद्धृत्य महार्घं यः प्रयच्छति । स वै वार्धुषिको नाम ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हितः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'He who acquiring property cheap, gives it for a high price, is called a usurer and blamed among those who recite the Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: brahmahatyāṃ ca vṛddhiṃ ca tulayā samatolayat | atiṣṭhad bhrūṇahā koṭyāṃ vārdhuṣiḥ samakampata iti |
meaning: ब्रह्महत्यां च वृद्धिं च तुलया समतोलयत् । अतिष्ठद् भ्रूणहा कोट्यां वार्धुषिः समकम्पत इति ।
text: '(Brahman) weighed in the scales the crime of killing a learned Brāhmaṇa against (the crime of) usury; the slayer of the Brāhmaṇa remained at the top, the usurer sank downwards.'

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ vā pariluptakṛtyāya pāpīyase dadyātām |
meaning: कामं वा परिलुप्तकृत्याय पापीयसे दद्याताम् ।
text: Or, at pleasure, they may lend to a person who entirely neglects his sacred duties, and is exceedingly wicked,

sanskrit_iast: dviguṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ triguṇaṃ dhānyam |
meaning: द्विगुणं हिरण्यं त्रिगुणं धान्यम् ।
text: Gold (taking) double (its value on repayment, and) grain trebling (the original price).

sanskrit_iast: dhānyenaiva rasā vyākhyātāḥ |
meaning: धान्येनैव रसा व्याख्याताः ।
text: (The case of) flavouring substances has been explained by (the rule regarding) grain,

sanskrit_iast: puṣpamūlaphalāni ca |
meaning: पुष्पमूलफलानि च ।
text: As well as (the case of) flowers, roots, and fruit.

sanskrit_iast: tulādhṛtam aṣṭaguṇam |
meaning: तुलाधृतम् अष्टगुणम् ।
text: (They may lend) what is sold by weight, (taking) eight times (the original value on repayment).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | dvikaṃ trikaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca pañcakaṃ ca śataṃ smṛtam | māsasya vṛddhiṃ gṛhṇīyād varṇānām anupūrvaśaḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । द्विकं त्रिकं चतुष्कं च पञ्चकं च शतं स्मृतम् । मासस्य वृद्धिं गृह्णीयाद् वर्णानाम् अनुपूर्वशः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Two in the hundred, three and four and five, as has teen declared in the Sm ri ti, he may take as interest by the month according to the order of the castes.'

sanskrit_iast: rājā tu mṛtabhāvena dravyavṛddhiṃ vināśayet | punā rājābhiṣekeṇa dravyamūlaṃ ca vardhate |
meaning: राजा तु मृतभावेन द्रव्यवृद्धिं विनाशयेत् । पुना राजाभिषेकेण द्रव्यमूलं च वर्धते ।

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhavacanaproktāṃ vṛddhiṃ vārdhuṣike śṛṇu | pañca māṣās tu viṃśatyā evaṃ dharmo na hīyata iti | na hīyate iti |
meaning: वसिष्ठवचनप्रोक्तां वृद्धिं वार्धुषिके शृणु । पञ्च माषास् तु विंशत्या एवं धर्मो न हीयत इति । न हीयते इति ।

sanskrit_iast: aśrotriyā ananuvākyā anagnayo vā śūdrasadharmāṇo bhavanti |
meaning: अश्रोत्रिया अननुवाक्या अनग्नयो वा शूद्रसधर्माणो भवन्ति ।
text: (Brāhmaṇas) who neither study nor teach the Veda nor keep sacred fires become equal to Śūdras;

sanskrit_iast: mānavaṃ cātra ślokam udāharanti | yo 'nadhītya dvijo vedam anyatra kurute śramam | sa jīvann eva śūdratvam āśu gacchati sānvayaḥ |
meaning: मानवं चात्र श्लोकम् उदाहरन्ति । यो ऽनधीत्य द्विजो वेदम् अन्यत्र कुरुते श्रमम् । स जीवन्न् एव शूद्रत्वम् आशु गच्छति सान्वयः ।
text: And they quote a verse of Manu on this (subject), 'A twice-born man, who not having studied the Veda applies himself to other (and worldly study), soon falls, even while living, to the condition of a Śūdra, and his descendants after him.'

sanskrit_iast: nānṛg brāhmaṇo bhavati na vaṇig na kuśīlavaḥ | na śūdrapreṣaṇaṃ kurvan na steno na cikitsakaḥ |
meaning: नानृग् ब्राह्मणो भवति न वणिग् न कुशीलवः । न शूद्रप्रेषणं कुर्वन् न स्तेनो न चिकित्सकः ।
text: '(A twice-born man) who does not know the [paragraph continues] Veda (can)not be (called) a Brāhmaṇa, nor he who lives by trade, nor he who (lives as) an actor, nor he who obeys a Śūdra's commands, nor (he who like) a thief (takes the property of others), nor he who makes his living by the practice of medicine.'

sanskrit_iast: avratā hy anadhīyānā yatra bhaikṣacarā dvijāḥ | taṃ grāmaṃ daṇḍayed rājā corabhaktaprado hi saḥ |
meaning: अव्रता ह्य् अनधीयाना यत्र भैक्षचरा द्विजाः । तं ग्रामं दण्डयेद् राजा चोरभक्तप्रदो हि सः ।
text: 'The king shall punish that village where Brāhmaṇas, unobservant of their sacred duties and ignorant of the Veda, subsist by begging; for it feeds robbers.'

sanskrit_iast: avratānām amantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām | sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate |
meaning: अव्रतानाम् अमन्त्राणां जातिमात्रोपजीविनाम् । सहस्रशः समेतानां परिषत्त्वं न विद्यते ।
text: 'Many thousands (of Brāhmaṇas) cannot form a (legal) assembly (for declaring the sacred law), if they have not fulfilled their sacred duties, are unacquainted with the Veda, and subsist only by the name of their caste.'

sanskrit_iast: yad vadanti tamomūḍhā mūrkhā dharmam ajānataḥ | tat pāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā tadvaktṝn adhigacchati |
meaning: यद् वदन्ति तमोमूढा मूर्खा धर्मम् अजानतः । तत् पापं शतधा भूत्वा तद्वक्तॄन् अधिगच्छति ।
text: 'That sin which dunces, perplexed by ignorance and unacquainted with the sacred law, declare (to be duty) shall fall, increased a hundredfold, on those who propound it.'

sanskrit_iast: catvāro vā trayo vāpi yaṃ brūyur vedapāragāḥ | sa dharma iti vijñeyo netareṣāṃ sahasraśaḥ |
meaning: चत्वारो वा त्रयो वापि यं ब्रूयुर् वेदपारगाः । स धर्म इति विज्ञेयो नेतरेषां सहस्रशः ।
text: 'What four or (even) three (Brāhmaṇas) who have completely studied the Vedas proclaim, that must be distinctly recognised as the sacred law, not (the decision) of a thousand fools.'

sanskrit_iast: śrotriyāya ca deyāni havyakavyāni nityaśaḥ | aśrotriyāya dattaṃ hi pitṝn naiti na devatāḥ |
meaning: श्रोत्रियाय च देयानि हव्यकव्यानि नित्यशः । अश्रोत्रियाय दत्तं हि पितॄन् नैति न देवताः ।
text: 'Offerings to the gods and to the manes must always be given to a Śrotriya alone. For gifts bestowed on a man unacquainted with the Veda, reach neither the ancestors nor the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: yasya caikagṛhe mūrkho dūre vāpi bahuśrutaḥ | bahuśrutāya dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhe vyatikramaḥ |
meaning: यस्य चैकगृहे मूर्खो दूरे वापि बहुश्रुतः । बहुश्रुताय दातव्यं नास्ति मूर्खे व्यतिक्रमः ।
text: 'If a fool lives even in one's house and a (Brāhmaṇa) deeply learned in the Veda lives at a great distance, the learned man shall receive the gift. The sin of neglecting (a Brāhmaṇa is not incurred) in (the case of) a fool.'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti vipre vedavivarjite | jvalantam agnim utsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate |
meaning: ब्राह्मणातिक्रमो नास्ति विप्रे वेदविवर्जिते । ज्वलन्तम् अग्निम् उत्सृज्य न हि भस्मनि हूयते ।
text: 'The offence of neglecting a Brāhmaṇa cannot be committed against a twice-born man who is ignorant of the Veda. For (in offering sacrifices) one does not pass by a brilliant fire and throw the oblations into ashes.'

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca kāṣṭhamayo hastī yaś ca carmamayo mṛgaḥ | yaś ca vipro 'nadhīyānas trayas te nāmadhārakāḥ |
meaning: यश् च काष्ठमयो हस्ती यश् च चर्ममयो मृगः । यश् च विप्रो ऽनधीयानस् त्रयस् ते नामधारकाः ।
text: An elephant made of wood, an antelope made of leather, and a Brāhmaṇa ignorant of the Veda, those three have nothing but the name (of their kind).

sanskrit_iast: vidvadbhojyāny avidvāṃso yeṣu rāṣṭreṣu bhuñjate | tāny anāvṛṣṭim ṛcchanti mahad vā jāyate bhayam iti |
meaning: विद्वद्भोज्यान्य् अविद्वांसो येषु राष्ट्रेषु भुञ्जते । तान्य् अनावृष्टिम् ऋच्छन्ति महद् वा जायते भयम् इति ।
text: 'Those kingdoms, where ignorant men eat the food of the learned, will be visited by drought; or (some other) great evil will befall (them).'

sanskrit_iast: aprajñāyamānaṃ vittaṃ yo 'dhigacched rājā tad hared adhigantre ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ pradāya |
meaning: अप्रज्ञायमानं वित्तं यो ऽधिगच्छेद् राजा तद् हरेद् अधिगन्त्रे षष्ठम् अंशं प्रदाय ।
text: If anybody finds treasure (the owner of) which is not known, the king shall take it, giving one sixth to the finder.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaś ced adhigacchet ṣaṭsu karmasu varttamāno na rājā haret |
meaning: ब्राह्मणश् चेद् अधिगच्छेत् षट्सु कर्मसु वर्त्तमानो न राजा हरेत् ।
text: If a Brāhmaṇa who follows the six (lawful) occupations, finds it, the king shall not take it.

sanskrit_iast: ātatāyinaṃ hatvā nātra prāṇachettuḥ kimcit kilviṣam āhuḥ |
meaning: आततायिनं हत्वा नात्र प्राणछेत्तुः किम्चित् किल्विषम् आहुः ।
text: They declare that the slayer commits no crime by killing an assassin.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | agnido garadaś caiva śastrapāṇir dhanāpahaḥ | kṣetradāraharaś caiva ṣaḍ ete ātatāyinaḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अग्निदो गरदश् चैव शस्त्रपाणिर् धनापहः । क्षेत्रदारहरश् चैव षड् एते आततायिनः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'An incendiary, likewise a poisoner, one who holds a weapon in his hand (ready to kill), a robber, he who takes away land, and he who abducts (another man's) wife, these six are called assassins (ātatāyin).'

sanskrit_iast: ātatāyinam āyāntam api vedāntapāragam | jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsīyān na tena brahmahā bhavet |
meaning: आततायिनम् आयान्तम् अपि वेदान्तपारगम् । जिघांसन्तं जिघांसीयान् न तेन ब्रह्महा भवेत् ।
text: 'He may slay an assassin who comes with the intention of slaying, even though he knows the whole Veda together with the Upanishads; by that (act) he (does) not (incur the guilt of) the slayer of a Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyinaṃ kule jātaṃ yo hanyād ātatāyinam | na tena bhrūṇahā sa syān manyus tanmanyum ṛcchatīti |
meaning: स्वाध्यायिनं कुले जातं यो हन्याद् आततायिनम् । न तेन भ्रूणहा स स्यान् मन्युस् तन्मन्युम् ऋच्छतीति ।
text: 'He who slays an assassin learned in the Veda and belonging to a noble family, does not incur by that act the guilt of the murderer of a learned Brāhmaṇa.; (in) that (case) fury recoils upon fury.'

sanskrit_iast: triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnis trisuparṇaś caturmedhā vājasaneyī ṣaḍaṅgavid brahmadeyānusantānaś chandogo jyeṣṭhasāmago mantrabrāhmaṇavidyaś ca dharmān adhīte yasya ca daśapuruṣaṃ mātṛpitṛvaṃśaḥ śrotriyo vijñāyate vidvāṃsaḥ snātakāś caite paṅktipāvanā bhavanti |
meaning: त्रिणाचिकेतः पञ्चाग्निस् त्रिसुपर्णश् चतुर्मेधा वाजसनेयी षडङ्गविद् ब्रह्मदेयानुसन्तानश् छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामगो मन्त्रब्राह्मणविद्यश् च धर्मान् अधीते यस्य च दशपुरुषं मातृपितृवंशः श्रोत्रियो विज्ञायते विद्वांसः स्नातकाश् चैते पङ्क्तिपावना भवन्ति ।
text: Persons who sanctify the company are, a Triṇā k iketa, one who keeps five fires, a Trisuparṇa, one who (knows the texts required for) the four sacrifices (called Aśvamedha, Purushamedha, Sarvamedha, and Pit ri medha), one who knows the Vā g asaneyi- s ākhā of the White Ya g ur-veda, one who knows the six Aṅgas, the son of a female married according to the Brāhma-rite, one who knows the first part of the Sāma-veda Saṃhitā, one who sings the Gyesh th asāman, one who knows the Saṃhitā and the Brāhmaṇa, one who studies (the treatises on) the sacred law, one whose ancestors to the ninth degree, both on the mother's and on the father's side, are distinctly known to have been Śrotriyas, and learned men and Snātakas.

sanskrit_iast: cāturvidyaṃ vikalpī ca aṅgavid dharmapāṭhakaḥ | āśramasthās trayo mukhyāḥ parṣad eṣāṃ daśāvarā |
meaning: चातुर्विद्यं विकल्पी च अङ्गविद् धर्मपाठकः । आश्रमस्थास् त्रयो मुख्याः पर्षद् एषां दशावरा ।
text: (Four students of) the four Vedas, one who knows the Mīmāṃsā, one who knows the Aṅgas, a teacher of the sacred law, and three eminent men who are in three (different) orders, (compose) a (legal) assembly consisting at least of ten (members).

sanskrit_iast: upanīya kṛtsnaṃ vedam adhyāpayet sa ācāryaḥ |
meaning: उपनीय कृत्स्नं वेदम् अध्यापयेत् स आचार्यः ।
text: He who initiates (a pupil) and teaches him the whole Veda is called the teacher (ā k ārya).

sanskrit_iast: yas tv ekadeśaṃ sa upādhyāyaḥ |
meaning: यस् त्व् एकदेशं स उपाध्यायः ।
text: But he who (teaches) a portion (of the Veda only is called) the sub-teacher (upādhyāya);

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca vedāṅgāni |
meaning: यश् च वेदाङ्गानि ।
text: So is he who (teaches) the Aṅgas of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: ātmatrāṇe varṇasaṃvarge brāhmaṇavaiśyau śastram ādadīyātām |
meaning: आत्मत्राणे वर्णसंवर्गे ब्राह्मणवैश्यौ शस्त्रम् आददीयाताम् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa and a Vaiśya may take up arms in self-defence, and in (order to prevent) a confusion of the castes.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatriyasya tu tan nityam eva rakṣaṇādhikārāt |
meaning: क्षत्रियस्य तु तन् नित्यम् एव रक्षणाधिकारात् ।
text: But that (trade of arms) is the constant (duty) of a Kshatriya, because he is appointed to protect (the people).

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālya pādau pāṇī cā maṇibandhāt prāg vodag vāsīno 'ṅguṣṭhamūlasyottararekhā brāhmaṃ tīrthaṃ tena trir ācāmed aśabdavat |
meaning: प्रक्षाल्य पादौ पाणी चा मणिबन्धात् प्राग् वोदग् वासीनो ऽङ्गुष्ठमूलस्योत्तररेखा ब्राह्मं तीर्थं तेन त्रिर् आचामेद् अशब्दवत् ।
text: Having washed his feet and his hands up to the wrist, and sitting with his face turned towards the east or towards the north, he shall thrice sip water out of the Tīrtha sacred to Brahman, (i.e.) the part of the hand above the root of the thumb, without uttering any sound;

sanskrit_iast: dviḥ parimṛjīta |
meaning: द्विः परिमृजीत ।
text: He shall twice wipe (his mouth with the root of the thumb);.

sanskrit_iast: khāny adbhiḥ saṃspṛśet |
meaning: खान्य् अद्भिः संस्पृशेत् ।
text: He shall touch the cavities (of the head) with water;

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhany apo ninayet savye ca pāṇau |
meaning: मूर्धन्य् अपो निनयेत् सव्ये च पाणौ ।
text: He shall pour water on his head and on the left hand;

sanskrit_iast: vrajaṃs tiṣṭhañ śayānaḥ praṇato vā nācāmet |
meaning: व्रजंस् तिष्ठञ् शयानः प्रणतो वा नाचामेत् ।
text: He shall not sip water while walking, standing., lying down or bending forward.

sanskrit_iast: hṛdayaṅgamābhir adbhir abudbudābhir aphenābhir brāhmaṇaḥ |
meaning: हृदयङ्गमाभिर् अद्भिर् अबुद्बुदाभिर् अफेनाभिर् ब्राह्मणः ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa (becomes pure) by (sipping) water, free from bubbles and foam, that reaches his heart,

sanskrit_iast: kaṇṭhagābhis tu kṣatriyaḥ |
meaning: कण्ठगाभिस् तु क्षत्रियः ।
text: But a Kshatriya by (sipping water) that reaches his throat,

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyo 'dbhiḥ prāśitābhiḥ |
meaning: वैश्यो ऽद्भिः प्राशिताभिः ।
text: A Vaiśya by (sipping water) that wets his palate,

sanskrit_iast: strīśūdraṃ spṛṣṭābhir eva ca |
meaning: स्त्रीशूद्रं स्पृष्टाभिर् एव च ।
text: A woman and a Śūdra by merely touching water (with the lips).

sanskrit_iast: pradarād api yā gos taparṇasamarthāḥ syuḥ |
meaning: प्रदराद् अपि या गोस् तपर्णसमर्थाः स्युः ।
text: Water (for sipping may) even (be taken) out of a hole in the ground, if it is fit to slake the thirst of cows.

sanskrit_iast: na varṇagandharasaduṣṭābhir yāś ca syur aśubhāgamāḥ |
meaning: न वर्णगन्धरसदुष्टाभिर् याश् च स्युर् अशुभागमाः ।
text: (He shall not purify himself with water) which has been defiled with colours, perfumes, or flavouring substances, nor with such as is collected in unclean places.

sanskrit_iast: na mukhyā vipruṣa ucchiṣṭaṃ kurvanty anaṅgaspṛṣṭāḥ |
meaning: न मुख्या विप्रुष उच्छिष्टं कुर्वन्त्य् अनङ्गस्पृष्टाः ।
text: Drops (of saliva) falling from the mouth, which do not touch a limb of the body, do not make (a man) impure.

sanskrit_iast: suptvā bhuktvā kṣutvā pītvā ruditvā snātvā cāntaḥ punar ācāmed vāsaś ca paridhāya |
meaning: सुप्त्वा भुक्त्वा क्षुत्वा पीत्वा रुदित्वा स्नात्वा चान्तः पुनर् आचामेद् वासश् च परिधाय ।
text: If, after having sipped water, he sleeps, eats, sneezes, drinks, weeps or bathes, or puts on a dress, he must again sip water,

sanskrit_iast: oṣṭhau saṃspṛśya yatrālomakau |
meaning: ओष्ठौ संस्पृश्य यत्रालोमकौ ।
text: Likewise, if he touches (that part of) the lips on which no hair grows.

sanskrit_iast: na śmaśrugato lepaḥ |
meaning: न श्मश्रुगतो लेपः ।
text: No defilement is caused by the hair of the moustache (entering the mouth).

sanskrit_iast: dantavad dantasakteṣu yac cāntarmūkhe bhaven nigirann eva tac chucir iti |
meaning: दन्तवद् दन्तसक्तेषु यच् चान्तर्मूखे भवेन् निगिरन्न् एव तच् छुचिर् इति ।
text: If (remnants of food) adhere to the teeth, (they are pure) like the teeth, and he is purified by swallowing those which (become detached) in the mouth.

sanskrit_iast: parān apy ācāmayataḥ pādau yā vipruṣo gatāḥ | tābhir nocchiṣṭatāṃ yānti bhūmyās tās tu samāḥ smṛtāḥ |
meaning: परान् अप्य् आचामयतः पादौ या विप्रुषो गताः । ताभिर् नोच्छिष्टतां यान्ति भूम्यास् तास् तु समाः स्मृताः ।
text: He is not defiled by the drops which fall on his feet, while somebody gives to others water for sipping; they are stated to be equally (clean) as the ground.

sanskrit_iast: carann abhyavahāreṣu ucchiṣṭaṃ yadi saṃspṛśet | bhūmau nidhāya tad dravyām ācamya pracaret punaḥ |
meaning: चरन्न् अभ्यवहारेषु उच्छिष्टं यदि संस्पृशेत् । भूमौ निधाय तद् द्रव्याम् आचम्य प्रचरेत् पुनः ।
text: If, while occupied with eatables, he touches any impure substance, then he shall place that thing (which he holds in his hand) on the ground, sip water and afterwards again use it.

sanskrit_iast: yad yan mīmāṃsyaṃ syād adbhiḥ saṃspṛśet |
meaning: यद् यन् मीमांस्यं स्याद् अद्भिः संस्पृशेत् ।
text: Let him sprinkle with water all objects (the purity of) which may be doubtful.

sanskrit_iast: śvahatāś ca mṛgā vanyāḥ pātitaṃ ca khagaiḥ phalam | bālair anuparikrāntaṃ strībhir ācaritaṃ ca yat |
meaning: श्वहताश् च मृगा वन्याः पातितं च खगैः फलम् । बालैर् अनुपरिक्रान्तं स्त्रीभिर् आचरितं च यत् ।
text: 'Both wild animals killed by dogs, and fruit thrown by birds (from the tree), what has been spoilt by children, and what has been handled by women,'

sanskrit_iast: prasāritaṃ ca yat paṇyaṃ ye doṣāḥ strīmukheṣu ca |
meaning: प्रसारितं च यत् पण्यं ये दोषाः स्त्रीमुखेषु च ।
text: 'A vendible commodity tendered for sale and what is not dirtied by gnats and flies that have settled on it,'

sanskrit_iast: maśakair makṣikābhiś ca nilīnair nopahanyate | kṣitisthāś caiva yā āpo gavāṃ tṛptikarāś ca yāḥ | parisaṃkhyāya tān sarvāñ śucīn āha prajāpatiriti |
meaning: मशकैर् मक्षिकाभिश् च निलीनैर् नोपहन्यते । क्षितिस्थाश् चैव या आपो गवां तृप्तिकराश् च याः । परिसंख्याय तान् सर्वाञ् शुचीन् आह प्रजापतिरिति ।
text: 'Likewise water collected on the ground that quenches the thirst of cows,--enumerating all these things, the Lord of created beings has declared them to be pure.'

sanskrit_iast: lepagandhāpakarṣaṇe śaucam amedhyaliptasyādbhir mṛdā ca |
meaning: लेपगन्धापकर्षणे शौचम् अमेध्यलिप्तस्याद्भिर् मृदा च ।
text: Anything defiled by unclean (substances) becomes pure when the stains and the smell have been removed by water and earth.

sanskrit_iast: taijasamṛdmayadāravatāntavānāṃ bhasmaparimārjanapradāhanatakṣaṇadhāvanāni |
meaning: तैजसमृद्मयदारवतान्तवानां भस्मपरिमार्जनप्रदाहनतक्षणधावनानि ।
text: (Objects) made of metal must be scoured with ashes, those made of clay should be thoroughly heated by fire, those made of wood should be planed, and (cloth) made of thread should be washed.

sanskrit_iast: taijasavad upalamaṇīnām |
meaning: तैजसवद् उपलमणीनाम् ।
text: Stones and gems (should be treated) like objects made of metal,

sanskrit_iast: maṇivac chaṅkhaśuktīnām |
meaning: मणिवच् छङ्खशुक्तीनाम् ।
text: Conch-shells and pearl-shells like gems,

sanskrit_iast: dāruvad asthnām |
meaning: दारुवद् अस्थ्नाम् ।
text: (Objects made of) bone like wood,

sanskrit_iast: rajjuvidalacarmaṇāṃś cailavac chaucam |
meaning: रज्जुविदलचर्मणांश् चैलवच् छौचम् ।
text: Ropes, chips (of bamboo), and leather become pure (if treated) like clothes,

sanskrit_iast: govālaiḥ phalamayānām |
meaning: गोवालैः फलमयानाम् ।
text: (Objects) made of fruits, (if rubbed) with (a brush of) cow hair,

sanskrit_iast: gaurasarṣapakalkena kṣaumajānām |
meaning: गौरसर्षपकल्केन क्षौमजानाम् ।
text: Linen cloth, (if smeared) with a paste of yellow mustard (and washed afterwards with water).

sanskrit_iast: bhūmes tu saṃmārjanopalenollekhanaprokṣaṇopakarṇair yathāsthānaṃ doṣaviśeṣāt prāyatyam upaiti |
meaning: भूमेस् तु संमार्जनोपलेनोल्लेखनप्रोक्षणोपकर्णैर् यथास्थानं दोषविशेषात् प्रायत्यम् उपैति ।
text: But land becomes pure, according to the degree of defilement, by sweeping (the defiled spot), by smearing it with cowdung, by scraping it, by sprinkling (water) or by heaping (pure earth) on (it).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | khananād dahanād dharṣād gobhir ākramaṇād api | caturbhiḥ śudhyate bhūmiḥ pañcamāc copalepanāt |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । खननाद् दहनाद् धर्षाद् गोभिर् आक्रमणाद् अपि । चतुर्भिः शुध्यते भूमिः पञ्चमाच् चोपलेपनात् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Land is purified by these four methods, by digging, burning, scraping, being trodden on by cows, and fifthly by being smeared with cowdung.'

sanskrit_iast: rajasā śudhyate nārī nadī vegena śudhyate | bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ punaḥpākena mṛdmayam |
meaning: रजसा शुध्यते नारी नदी वेगेन शुध्यते । भस्मना शुध्यते कांस्यं पुनःपाकेन मृद्मयम् ।
text: 'A woman is purified by her monthly discharge, a river by its current, brass by (being scoured with) ashes, and an earthen pot by another burning.'

sanskrit_iast: madyair mūtraiḥ purīṣair vā śleṣmapūyāśruśoṇitaiḥ | saṃspṛṣṭaṃ naiva śudhyeta punaḥpākena mṛdmayam |
meaning: मद्यैर् मूत्रैः पुरीषैर् वा श्लेष्मपूयाश्रुशोणितैः । संस्पृष्टं नैव शुध्येत पुनःपाकेन मृद्मयम् ।
text: 'But an earthen vessel which has been defiled by spirituous liquor, urine, ordure, phlegm, pus, tears, or blood cannot be purified even by another burning.'

sanskrit_iast: adbhir gātrāṇi śudhyanti manaḥ satyena śudhyati | vidyātapobhyāṃ bhūtātmā buddhir jñānena śudhyatīti |
meaning: अद्भिर् गात्राणि शुध्यन्ति मनः सत्येन शुध्यति । विद्यातपोभ्यां भूतात्मा बुद्धिर् ज्ञानेन शुध्यतीति ।
text: 'The body is purified by water, the internal organ by truth, the soul by sacred learning and austerities, and the understanding by knowledge.'

sanskrit_iast: adbhir eva kāñcanaṃ pūyate |
meaning: अद्भिर् एव काञ्चनं पूयते ।
text: Gold is purified by water alone,

sanskrit_iast: tathā rajatam |
meaning: तथा रजतम् ।
text: Likewise silver,

sanskrit_iast: tāmram amlena śudhyati |
meaning: ताम्रम् अम्लेन शुध्यति ।
text: Copper is cleansed by acids.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulikaniṣṭhikāmūle daivaṃ tīrtham |
meaning: अङ्गुलिकनिष्ठिकामूले दैवं तीर्थम् ।
text: The Tīrtha sacred to the Gods lies at the root of the little finger,

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulyam ṛṣīṇām |
meaning: अङ्गुल्यम् ऋषीणाम् ।
text: That sacred to the Ri shis in the middle of the fingers,

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulyagreṣu mānuṣam |
meaning: अङ्गुल्यग्रेषु मानुषम् ।
text: That sacred to Men at the tips of the fingers,

sanskrit_iast: pāṇimadhya āgneyam |
meaning: पाणिमध्य आग्नेयम् ।
text: That sacred to Agni (fire) in the middle of the hand,

sanskrit_iast: pradeśinyaṅguṣṭhayor antarā pitryam |
meaning: प्रदेशिन्यङ्गुष्ठयोर् अन्तरा पित्र्यम् ।
text: That sacred to the Manes between the forefinger and the thumb.

sanskrit_iast: rocata iti sāyamprātaraśanāny abhipūjayet |
meaning: रोचत इति सायम्प्रातरशनान्य् अभिपूजयेत् ।
text: He shall honour (his food at) the evening and morning meals (saying), 'It pleases me,'

sanskrit_iast: svaditam iti pitrye |
meaning: स्वदितम् इति पित्र्ये ।
text: At meals in honour of the Manes (saying), I have dined well,'

sanskrit_iast: saṃpannam ity ābhyudayikeṣv ābhyudayikeṣv eti |
meaning: संपन्नम् इत्य् आभ्युदयिकेष्व् आभ्युदयिकेष्व् एति ।
text: At (a dinner given on the occasion of) rites procuring prosperity (saying), 'It is perfect:

sanskrit_iast: prakṛtiviśiṣṭaṃ cāturvarṇyaṃ saṃskāraviśeṣāc ca |
meaning: प्रकृतिविशिष्टं चातुर्वर्ण्यं संस्कारविशेषाच् च ।
text: The four castes are distinguished by their origin and by particular sacraments.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo 'sya mukham āsīd bāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ | urū tad asya yad vaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata | ity api nigamo bhavati |
meaning: ब्राह्मणो ऽस्य मुखम् आसीद् बाहू राजन्यः कृतः । उरू तद् अस्य यद् वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत । इत्य् अपि निगमो भवति ।
text: There is also the following passage of the Veda, 'The Brāhmaṇa was his mouth, the Kshatriya formed his arms, the Vaiśya his thighs; the Śūdra was born from his feet.'

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryā brāhmaṇam asṛjata triṣṭubhā rājanyaṃ jagatyā vaiśyaṃ na kenacic chandasā śūdram ity asaṃskāryo vijñāyate |
meaning: गायत्र्या ब्राह्मणम् असृजत त्रिष्टुभा राजन्यं जगत्या वैश्यं न केनचिच् छन्दसा शूद्रम् इत्य् असंस्कार्यो विज्ञायते ।
text: It has been declared in (the following passage of) the Veda that (a Śūdra) shall not receive the sacraments, 'He created the Brāhmaṇa with the Gāyatrī (metre), the Kshatriya with the Trishṭubh, the Vaiśya with the G agatī, the Śūdra without any metre.'

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ satyam akrodho dānam ahiṃsā prajananaṃ ca |
meaning: सर्वेषां सत्यम् अक्रोधो दानम् अहिंसा प्रजननं च ।
text: Truthfulness, suppression of anger, liberality, abstention from injuring living beings, and the procreation of offspring (are duties common to) all (castes).

sanskrit_iast: pitṛdevatātithipūjāyām apy eva paśuṃ hiṃsyād iti mānavam |
meaning: पितृदेवतातिथिपूजायाम् अप्य् एव पशुं हिंस्याद् इति मानवम् ।
text: The Mānava (Sūtra states), 'Only when he worships the manes and the gods, or honours guests, he may certainly do injury to animals.'

sanskrit_iast: madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛdaivatakarmaṇi | atraiva ca paśuṃ hiṃsyān nānyathety abravīn manuḥ |
meaning: मधुपर्के च यज्ञे च पितृदैवतकर्मणि । अत्रैव च पशुं हिंस्यान् नान्यथेत्य् अब्रवीन् मनुः ।
text: 'On offering a Madhuparka (to a guest), at a sacrifice, and at the rites in honour of the manes, but on these occasions only may an animal be slain; that (rule) Manu proclaimed.'

sanskrit_iast: nākṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsam utpadyate kvacit | na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyas tasmād yāge vadho 'vadhaḥ |
meaning: नाकृत्वा प्राणिनां हिंसां मांसम् उत्पद्यते क्वचित् । न च प्राणिवधः स्वर्ग्यस् तस्माद् यागे वधो ऽवधः ।
text: 'Meat can never be obtained without injuring living beings, and to injure living beings does not procure heavenly bliss; therefore the (sages declare) the slaughter (of beasts) at a sacrifice not to be slaughter (in the ordinary sense of the word).'

sanskrit_iast: athāpi brāhmaṇāya vā rājanyāya vābhyāgatāya mahokṣāṇaṃ vā mahājaṃ vā paced evam asmā ātithyaṃ kurvantīti |
meaning: अथापि ब्राह्मणाय वा राजन्याय वाभ्यागताय महोक्षाणं वा महाजं वा पचेद् एवम् अस्मा आतिथ्यं कुर्वन्तीति ।
text: 'Now he may also cook a full-grown ox or a full-grown he-goat for a Brāhmaṇa or Kshatriya guest; in this manner they offer hospitality to such (a man).'

sanskrit_iast: udakakriyāśaucaṃ ca dvivarṣaṃ prabhṛti |
meaning: उदकक्रियाशौचं च द्विवर्षं प्रभृति ।
text: Libations of water (must be poured out) for all (deceased relatives) who completed the second year and (their death causes) impurity.

sanskrit_iast: ā dantajananād ity eke |
meaning: आ दन्तजननाद् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some declare that (this rule applies also to children) that died after teething.

sanskrit_iast: śarīram agninā saṃyojyān avekṣamāṇā apo 'bhyavayanti |
meaning: शरीरम् अग्निना संयोज्यान् अवेक्षमाणा अपो ऽभ्यवयन्ति ।
text: After having burnt the body (of the deceased, the relatives) enter the water without looking at (the place of cremation),

sanskrit_iast: savyetarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyam udakakriyāṃ kurvīrann ayugmāsu dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ |
meaning: सव्येतराभ्यां पाणिभ्यम् उदकक्रियां कुर्वीरन्न् अयुग्मासु दक्षिणामुखाः ।
text: Facing the south, they shall pour out water with both hands on (those days of the period of impurity) which are marked by odd numbers.

sanskrit_iast: pitṝṇāṃ vā eṣā dig yā dakṣiṇā |
meaning: पितॄणां वा एषा दिग् या दक्षिणा ।
text: The south, forsooth, is the region sacred to the manes.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhān vrajitvā prastare tryaham anaśnanta āsīran |
meaning: गृहान् व्रजित्वा प्रस्तरे त्र्यहम् अनश्नन्त आसीरन् ।
text: After they have gone home, they shall sit during three days on mats, fasting.

sanskrit_iast: aśaktau krītotpannena varteran |
meaning: अशक्तौ क्रीतोत्पन्नेन वर्तेरन् ।
text: If they are unable (to fast so long), they shall subsist on food bought in the market or given unasked.

sanskrit_iast: daśāhaṃ śāvam āśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate |
meaning: दशाहं शावम् आशौचं सपिण्डेषु विधीयते ।
text: It is ordered that impurity caused by a death shall last ten days in the case of Sapiṇd a relations.

sanskrit_iast: sapiṇḍatvaṃ sāptapuruṣaṃ vijñāyate |
meaning: सपिण्डत्वं साप्तपुरुषं विज्ञायते ।
text: It has been declared in the Veda that Sapiṇd a relationship extends to the seventh person (in the ascending or descending line).

sanskrit_iast: prattānāṃ ca strīṇāṃ tripuruṣaṃ vijñāyate |
meaning: प्रत्तानां च स्त्रीणां त्रिपुरुषं विज्ञायते ।
text: It has been declared in the Veda that for married females it extends to the third person (in the ascending or descending line).

sanskrit_iast: prattānām itare kurvīraṃs tāś ca teṣām |
meaning: प्रत्तानाम् इतरे कुर्वीरंस् ताश् च तेषाम् ।
text: Others (than the blood-relations) shall perform (the obsequies) of married females,

sanskrit_iast: janane 'py evam eva syān nipuṇāṃ śuddhim icchatām |
meaning: जनने ऽप्य् एवम् एव स्यान् निपुणां शुद्धिम् इच्छताम् ।
text: (The rule regarding impurity) should be exactly the same on the birth of a child for those men who desire complete purity,

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitror vā |
meaning: मातापित्रोर् वा ।

sanskrit_iast: tannimittatvān mātur ity eke |
meaning: तन्निमित्तत्वान् मातुर् इत्य् एके ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | nāśaucaṃ sūtake puṃsaḥ saṃsargaṃ cen na gacchati | rajas tatrāśuci jñeyaṃ tac ca puṃṣi na vidyata iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । नाशौचं सूतके पुंसः संसर्गं चेन् न गच्छति । रजस् तत्राशुचि ज्ञेयं तच् च पुंषि न विद्यत इति ।

sanskrit_iast: tac ced antaḥ punar āpatec cheṣeṇa śudhyeran |
meaning: तच् चेद् अन्तः पुनर् आपतेच् छेषेण शुध्येरन् ।

sanskrit_iast: rātriśeṣe dvābhyām |
meaning: रात्रिशेषे द्वाभ्याम् ।

sanskrit_iast: prabhāte tisṛbhiḥ |
meaning: प्रभाते तिसृभिः ।

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo daśarātreṇa |
meaning: ब्राह्मणो दशरात्रेण ।

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśarātreṇa rājanyaḥ |
meaning: पञ्चदशरात्रेण राजन्यः ।

sanskrit_iast: viṃśatirātreṇa vaiśyaḥ |
meaning: विंशतिरात्रेण वैश्यः ।

sanskrit_iast: śūdro māsena śudhyati |
meaning: शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aśauce yas tu śūdrasya sūtake vāpi bhuktavān | sa gacchen narakaṃ ghoraṃ tiryagyonyāṃ ca jāyate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अशौचे यस् तु शूद्रस्य सूतके वापि भुक्तवान् । स गच्छेन् नरकं घोरं तिर्यग्योन्यां च जायते ।

sanskrit_iast: anirdaśāhe paraśave niyogād bhuktavān dvijaḥ | kṛmir bhūtvā sa dehānte tāṃ viṣṭhāṃ samupāśnuta iti |
meaning: अनिर्दशाहे परशवे नियोगाद् भुक्तवान् द्विजः । कृमिर् भूत्वा स देहान्ते तां विष्ठां समुपाश्नुत इति ।

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa māsān dvādaśārdhamāsān vānaśnan saṃhitādhyayanam adhīyānaḥ pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: द्वादश मासान् द्वादशार्धमासान् वानश्नन् संहिताध्ययनम् अधीयानः पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।

sanskrit_iast: ūnadvivarṣe prete garbhapatane vā sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātram āśaucam |
meaning: ऊनद्विवर्षे प्रेते गर्भपतने वा सपिण्डानां त्रिरात्रम् आशौचम् ।

sanskrit_iast: sadyaḥ śaucam iti gautamaḥ |
meaning: सद्यः शौचम् इति गौतमः ।

sanskrit_iast: deśāntarasthe preta ūrdhvaṃ daśāhāc chrutvaikarātram āśaucam |
meaning: देशान्तरस्थे प्रेत ऊर्ध्वं दशाहाच् छ्रुत्वैकरात्रम् आशौचम् ।

sanskrit_iast: āhitāgniś cet pravasan mriyeta punaḥ saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā śavavacchaucam iti gautamaḥ |
meaning: आहिताग्निश् चेत् प्रवसन् म्रियेत पुनः संस्कारं कृत्वा शववच्छौचम् इति गौतमः ।

sanskrit_iast: yūpacitiśmaśānarajasvalāsūtikāśucīṃś ca spṛṣṭvā saśirasko 'bhyupeyād apa ity apa iti |
meaning: यूपचितिश्मशानरजस्वलासूतिकाशुचींश् च स्पृष्ट्वा सशिरस्को ऽभ्युपेयाद् अप इत्य् अप इति ।

sanskrit_iast: asvatantrā strī puruṣapradhānā |
meaning: अस्वतन्त्रा स्त्री पुरुषप्रधाना ।

sanskrit_iast: anagnikānudakyā vāmṛtam iti vijñāyate |
meaning: अनग्निकानुदक्या वामृतम् इति विज्ञायते ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putraś ca sthavire bhāve na strī svātantryam arhatīti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने । पुत्रश् च स्थविरे भावे न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यम् अर्हतीति ।

sanskrit_iast: tasyā bhartur abhicāra uktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ rahasyeṣu |
meaning: तस्या भर्तुर् अभिचार उक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं रहस्येषु ।

sanskrit_iast: māsi māsi rajo hy āsāṃ duṣkṛtāny apakarṣati |
meaning: मासि मासि रजो ह्य् आसां दुष्कृतान्य् अपकर्षति ।

sanskrit_iast: trirātraṃ rajasvalāśucir bhavati |
meaning: त्रिरात्रं रजस्वलाशुचिर् भवति ।

sanskrit_iast: sā nāñjyān nābhyañjyān nāpsu snāyād adhaḥ śayīta na divā svapyān nāgniṃ spṛśen na rañjuṃ sṛjen na dantān dhāvayen na māṃsam aśnīyān na grahān nirīkṣeta na hasen na kiṃcetad ācaren na dhāvetad akharveṇa pātreṇa pibed añjalinā vā pibel lohitāyasena vā |
meaning: सा नाञ्ज्यान् नाभ्यञ्ज्यान् नाप्सु स्नायाद् अधः शयीत न दिवा स्वप्यान् नाग्निं स्पृशेन् न रञ्जुं सृजेन् न दन्तान् धावयेन् न मांसम् अश्नीयान् न ग्रहान् निरीक्षेत न हसेन् न किंचेतद् आचरेन् न धावेतद् अखर्वेण पात्रेण पिबेद् अञ्जलिना वा पिबेल् लोहितायसेन वा ।

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate hi | indras triśīrṣāṇaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ hatvā pāpmagṛhīto mahattamādharmasaṃbaddho 'ham ity evam ātmānam amanyata | taṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāny abhyakrośan bhrūṇahan bhrūṇahann iti | sa striya upādhāvad asyai me bhrūṇahatyāyai tṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ pratigṛhṇīteti | tā abravan kiṃ no bhūyād iti | so 'bravīd varaṃ vṛṇīdhvam iti | tā abruvann ṛtau prajāṃ vindāmaha iti kāmam ā vijanitoḥ saṃbhavāmeti | tatheti tāḥ pratijagṛhuḥ saiṣā bhrūṇahatyā māsimāsy āvir bhavati tasmād rajasvalāyā annaṃ nāśnīyād bhrūṇahatyāyā evaiṣā rūpaṃ pratimucyāste |
meaning: विज्ञायते हि । इन्द्रस् त्रिशीर्षाणं त्वाष्ट्रं हत्वा पाप्मगृहीतो महत्तमाधर्मसंबद्धो ऽहम् इत्य् एवम् आत्मानम् अमन्यत । तं सर्वाणि भूतान्य् अभ्यक्रोशन् भ्रूणहन् भ्रूणहन्न् इति । स स्त्रिय उपाधावद् अस्यै मे भ्रूणहत्यायै तृतीयं भागं प्रतिगृह्णीतेति । ता अब्रवन् किं नो भूयाद् इति । सो ऽब्रवीद् वरं वृणीध्वम् इति । ता अब्रुवन्न् ऋतौ प्रजां विन्दामह इति कामम् आ विजनितोः संभवामेति । तथेति ताः प्रतिजगृहुः सैषा भ्रूणहत्या मासिमास्य् आविर् भवति तस्माद् रजस्वलाया अन्नं नाश्नीयाद् भ्रूणहत्याया एवैषा रूपं प्रतिमुच्यास्ते ।

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ | añjanābhyañjanam evāsyā na pratigrāhyaṃ tad hi striyā annam iti | tasmāt tasyai ca tatra ca bībhatsante meyam upāgād iti |
meaning: तद् आहुः । अञ्जनाभ्यञ्जनम् एवास्या न प्रतिग्राह्यं तद् हि स्त्रिया अन्नम् इति । तस्मात् तस्यै च तत्र च बीभत्सन्ते मेयम् उपागाद् इति ।

sanskrit_iast: udakyās tv āsate yeṣāṃ ye ca kecid anagnayaḥ | kulaṃ cāśrotriyām yeṣāṃ sarve te śūdradharmiṇa iti | sarve te śūdradharmiṇa iti |
meaning: उदक्यास् त्व् आसते येषां ये च केचिद् अनग्नयः । कुलं चाश्रोत्रियाम् येषां सर्वे ते शूद्रधर्मिण इति । सर्वे ते शूद्रधर्मिण इति ।

sanskrit_iast: ācāraḥ paramo dharmaḥ sarveṣām iti niścayaḥ | hīnācāraparītātmā pretya ceha ca naśyati |
meaning: आचारः परमो धर्मः सर्वेषाम् इति निश्चयः । हीनाचारपरीतात्मा प्रेत्य चेह च नश्यति ।
text: (To live according to) the rule of conduct is doubtlessly the highest duty of all men. He whose soul is defiled by vile conduct perishes in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast: nainaṃ tapāṃsi na brahma nāgnihotraṃ na dakṣiṇāḥ | hīnācāram ito bhraṣṭaṃ tārayanti kathamcana |
meaning: नैनं तपांसि न ब्रह्म नाग्निहोत्रं न दक्षिणाः । हीनाचारम् इतो भ्रष्टं तारयन्ति कथम्चन ।
text: Neither austerities, nor (the study of) the Veda, nor (the performance of) the Agnihotra, nor lavish liberality can ever save him whose conduct is vile and who has strayed from this (path of duty).

sanskrit_iast: ācārahīnaṃ na punanti vedā yady apy adhītāḥ saha ṣaḍbhir aṅgaiḥ | chandāṃsy enaṃ mṛtyukāle tyajanti nīḍaṃ śakuntā iva jātapakṣāḥ |
meaning: आचारहीनं न पुनन्ति वेदा यद्य् अप्य् अधीताः सह षड्भिर् अङ्गैः । छन्दांस्य् एनं मृत्युकाले त्यजन्ति नीडं शकुन्ता इव जातपक्षाः ।
text: The Vedas do not purify him who is deficient in good conduct, though he may have learnt them all together with the six Aṅgas; the sacred texts depart from such a man at death, even as birds, when full-fledged, leave their nest.

sanskrit_iast: ācārahīnasya tu brāhmaṇasya vedāḥ ṣaḍaṅgās tv akhilāḥ sayajñāḥ | kāṃ prītim utpādayituṃ samarthā andhasya dārā iva darśanīyāḥ |
meaning: आचारहीनस्य तु ब्राह्मणस्य वेदाः षडङ्गास् त्व् अखिलाः सयज्ञाः । कां प्रीतिम् उत्पादयितुं समर्था अन्धस्य दारा इव दर्शनीयाः ।
text: As the beauty of a wife causes no joy to a blind man, even so all the four Vedas together with the six Aṅgas and sacrifices give no happiness to him who is deficient in good conduct.

sanskrit_iast: nainaṃ chandāṃsi vṛjināt tārayanti māyāvinaṃ māyayā vartamānam | dve 'py akṣare samyag adhīyamāne punāti tad brahma yathā iṣe 'bdāḥ |
meaning: नैनं छन्दांसि वृजिनात् तारयन्ति मायाविनं मायया वर्तमानम् । द्वे ऽप्य् अक्षरे सम्यग् अधीयमाने पुनाति तद् ब्रह्म यथा इषे ऽब्दाः ।
text: The sacred texts do not save from sin the deceitful man who behaves deceitfully. But that Veda, two syllables of which are studied in the right manner, purifies, just as the clouds (give beneficent rain) in the month of Isha.

sanskrit_iast: durācāro hi puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ | duḥkhabhāgī ca satataṃ vyādhito 'lpāyur eva ca |
meaning: दुराचारो हि पुरुषो लोके भवति निन्दितः । दुःखभागी च सततं व्याधितो ऽल्पायुर् एव च ।
text: A man of bad conduct is blamed among men, evils befal him constantly, he is afflicted with disease and short-lived.

sanskrit_iast: ācārāt phalate dharma ācārāt phalate dhanam | ācārāc chriyam āpnoti ācāro hanty alakṣaṇam |
meaning: आचारात् फलते धर्म आचारात् फलते धनम् । आचाराच् छ्रियम् आप्नोति आचारो हन्त्य् अलक्षणम् ।
text: Through good conduct man gains spiritual merit, through good conduct he gains wealth, through good conduct he obtains beauty, good conduct obviates the effect of evil marks.

sanskrit_iast: sarvalakṣaṇahīno 'pi yaḥ sadācāravān naraḥ | śraddadhāno 'nasūyaś ca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati |
meaning: सर्वलक्षणहीनो ऽपि यः सदाचारवान् नरः । श्रद्दधानो ऽनसूयश् च शतं वर्षाणि जीवति ।
text: A man who follows the rule of conduct established among the virtuous, who has faith and is free from envy, lives a hundred years, though he be destitute of all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast: āhāranirhāravihārayogāḥ susaṃvṛtā dharmavidā tu kāryāḥ | vācbuddhikāryāṇi tapas tathaiva dhanāyuṣī guptatame tu kārye |
meaning: आहारनिर्हारविहारयोगाः सुसंवृता धर्मविदा तु कार्याः । वाच्बुद्धिकार्याणि तपस् तथैव धनायुषी गुप्ततमे तु कार्ये ।
text: But a man who knows the sacred law shall perform in secret all acts connected with eating, the natural evacuations and dalliance with (his wife); business to be accomplished by speech or intellect, likewise austerities, wealth, and age, must be most carefully concealed.

sanskrit_iast: ubhe mūtrapurīṣe divā kuryād udaṅmukhaḥ | rātrau tu dakṣiṇā kuryād evaṃ hy āyur na riṣyati |
meaning: उभे मूत्रपुरीषे दिवा कुर्याद् उदङ्मुखः । रात्रौ तु दक्षिणा कुर्याद् एवं ह्य् आयुर् न रिष्यति ।

sanskrit_iast: praty agniṃ prati sūryaṃ ca prati gāṃ prati brāhmaṇam | prati somodakaṃ sandhyāṃ prajñā naśyati mehataḥ |
meaning: प्रत्य् अग्निं प्रति सूर्यं च प्रति गां प्रति ब्राह्मणम् । प्रति सोमोदकं सन्ध्यां प्रज्ञा नश्यति मेहतः ।

sanskrit_iast: na nadyāṃ mehanaṃ kuryān na pathi na ca bhasmani | na gomaye na kṛṣṭe nopte na śādvalopajīvyachāyāsu |
meaning: न नद्यां मेहनं कुर्यान् न पथि न च भस्मनि । न गोमये न कृष्टे नोप्ते न शाद्वलोपजीव्यछायासु ।
text: Let him not void urine in a river, nor on a path, nor on ashes, nor on cowdung, nor on a ploughed field, nor on one which has been sown, nor on a grass-plot, nor in the shade (of trees) that afford protection (to travellers).

sanskrit_iast: chāyāyām andhakāre vā rātrāv ahani vā dvijaḥ | yathāsukhamukhaḥ kuryāt prāṇabādhābhayeṣu ca |
meaning: छायायाम् अन्धकारे वा रात्राव् अहनि वा द्विजः । यथासुखमुखः कुर्यात् प्राणबाधाभयेषु च ।
text: Standing in the shade (of houses, clouds, and so forth), when it is quite dark, and when he fears for his life, a Brāhmaṇa may void urine, by day and by night, in any position he pleases.

sanskrit_iast: uddhṛtābhir adbhiḥ kāryaṃ kuryāt |
meaning: उद्धृताभिर् अद्भिः कार्यं कुर्यात् ।
text: (Afterwards) he shall perform the necessary (purification) with water fetched for the purpose (from a tank or river, and with earth).

sanskrit_iast: snānam anuddhṛtābhir api |
meaning: स्नानम् अनुद्धृताभिर् अपि ।
text: For a bath water not fetched for the purpose (may also be used).

sanskrit_iast: āharen mṛttikāṃ vipraḥ kūlāt sasikatā tu yā |
meaning: आहरेन् मृत्तिकां विप्रः कूलात् ससिकता तु या ।
text: (For the purpose of purification) a Brāhmaṇa shall take earth that is mixed with gravel, from the bank (of a river).

sanskrit_iast: antarjale devagṛhe valmīke mūṣakasthale | kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭā vā na grāhyāḥ pañca mṛttikāḥ |
meaning: अन्तर्जले देवगृहे वल्मीके मूषकस्थले । कृतशौचावशिष्टा वा न ग्राह्याः पञ्च मृत्तिकाः ।
text: Five kinds of earth must not be used, viz. such as is covered by water, such as lies in a temple, on an ant-hill, on a hillock thrown up by rats, and that which has been left by one who cleaned himself.

sanskrit_iast: ekā liṅge kare tisra ubhayor mṛddvayaṃ smṛtam | pañcāpāne daśaikasminn ubhayoḥ sapta mṛttikāḥ |
meaning: एका लिङ्गे करे तिस्र उभयोर् मृद्द्वयं स्मृतम् । पञ्चापाने दशैकस्मिन्न् उभयोः सप्त मृत्तिकाः ।
text: The organ (must be cleaned by) one (application of) earth, the (right) hand by three, but both (feet) by two, the anus by five, the one (i.e. the left hand) by ten, and both (hands and feet) by seven (applications of earth).

sanskrit_iast: etac chaucaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇām | triguṇaṃ vānaprasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ tac caturguṇam iti |
meaning: एतच् छौचं गृहस्थानां द्विगुणं ब्रह्मचारिणाम् । त्रिगुणं वानप्रस्थानां यतीनां तच् चतुर्गुणम् इति ।
text: Such is the purification ordained for house-holders; it is double for students, treble for hermits, but quadruple for ascetics.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau grāsā muner bhaktaṃ vānaprasthasya ṣoḍaśa | dvātriṃśat tu gṛhasthasyāparimitaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ |
meaning: अष्टौ ग्रासा मुनेर् भक्तं वानप्रस्थस्य षोडश । द्वात्रिंशत् तु गृहस्थस्यापरिमितं ब्रह्मचारिणः ।
text: Eight mouthfuls are the meal of an ascetic, sixteen that of a hermit, but thirty-two that of a householder, and an unlimited quantity that of a student.

sanskrit_iast: āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca brahmacārī ca te trayaḥ | aśnanta eva sidhyanti naiṣāṃ siddhir anaśnatām |
meaning: आहिताग्निर् अनड्वांश् च ब्रह्मचारी च ते त्रयः । अश्नन्त एव सिध्यन्ति नैषां सिद्धिर् अनश्नताम् ।
text: An Agnihotrin, a draught-ox, and a student, those three can do their work only if they eat (well); without eating (much), they cannot do it.

sanskrit_iast: vrateṣu niyameṣu cejyādhyayanadharmeṣu |
meaning: व्रतेषु नियमेषु चेज्याध्ययनधर्मेषु ।
text: (The above rule regarding limited allowances of food holds good) in the case of penances, of self-imposed restraint, of sacrifices, of the recitation of the Veda, and of (the performance of other) sacred duties.

sanskrit_iast: yogas tapo damo dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucaṃ śrutaṃ ghṛṇā | vidyā vijñānam āstikyam etad brāhmaṇalakṣaṇam |
meaning: योगस् तपो दमो दानं सत्यं शौचं श्रुतं घृणा । विद्या विज्ञानम् आस्तिक्यम् एतद् ब्राह्मणलक्षणम् ।
text: The qualities by which a (true) Brāhmaṇa may be recognised are, the concentration of the mind, austerities, the subjugation of the senses, liberality, truthfulness, purity, sacred learning, compassion, worldly learning, intelligence, and the belief (in the existence of the deity and of a future life).

sanskrit_iast: dīrghavairam asūyā cāsatyaṃ brāhmaṇadūṣaṇam | paiśunyaṃ nirdayatvaṃ ca jānīyāc chūdralakṣaṇam |
meaning: दीर्घवैरम् असूया चासत्यं ब्राह्मणदूषणम् । पैशुन्यं निर्दयत्वं च जानीयाच् छूद्रलक्षणम् ।
text: One may know that bearing grudges, envy, speaking untruths, speaking evil of Brāhmaṇas, backbiting, and cruelty are the characteristics of a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: ye śāntadāntāḥ śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhān nivṛttāḥ | pratigrahe saṅkucitāgrahastās te brāhmaṇās tārayituṃ samarthāḥ |
meaning: ये शान्तदान्ताः श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेन्द्रियाः प्राणिवधान् निवृत्ताः । प्रतिग्रहे सङ्कुचिताग्रहस्तास् ते ब्राह्मणास् तारयितुं समर्थाः ।
text: Those Brāhmaṇas can save (from evil) who are free from passion, and patient of austerities, whose ears have been filled with the texts of the Veda, who have subdued the organs of sensation and action, who have ceased to injure animated beings, and who close their hands when gifts are offered.

sanskrit_iast: kimcid vedamayaṃ pātraṃ kimcit pātraṃ tapomayam | pātrāṇām api tat pātraṃ śūdrānnaṃ yasya nodare |
meaning: किम्चिद् वेदमयं पात्रं किम्चित् पात्रं तपोमयम् । पात्राणाम् अपि तत् पात्रं शूद्रान्नं यस्य नोदरे ।

sanskrit_iast: śūdrānnenodarasthena yadi kaścin mṛto dvijaḥ | sa bhavec chūkaro grāmyas tasya vā jāyate kule |
meaning: शूद्रान्नेनोदरस्थेन यदि कश्चिन् मृतो द्विजः । स भवेच् छूकरो ग्राम्यस् तस्य वा जायते कुले ।

sanskrit_iast: śūdrānnarasapuṣṭāṅgo hy adhīyāno 'pi nityaśaḥ | juhvan vāpi japan vāpi gatim ūrdhvāṃ na vindati |
meaning: शूद्रान्नरसपुष्टाङ्गो ह्य् अधीयानो ऽपि नित्यशः । जुह्वन् वापि जपन् वापि गतिम् ऊर्ध्वां न विन्दति ।
text: For though a (Brāhmaṇa) whose body is nourished by the essence of a Śūdra's food may daily recite the Veda, though he may offer (an Agnihotra) or mutter (prayers, nevertheless) he will not find the path that leads upwards.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrānnena tu bhuktena maithunaṃ yo 'dhigacchati | yasyānnaṃ tasya te putrā na ca svargāruho bhavet |
meaning: शूद्रान्नेन तु भुक्तेन मैथुनं यो ऽधिगच्छति । यस्यान्नं तस्य ते पुत्रा न च स्वर्गारुहो भवेत् ।
text: But if, after eating the food of a Śūdra, he has conjugal intercourse, his sons will belong to the giver of the food, and he shall not ascend to heaven.

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyotthaṃ yonimantaṃ praśāntaṃ vaitānasthaṃ pāpabhīruṃ bahujñam | strīṣu kṣāntaṃ dhārmikaṃ gośaraṇyaṃ vrataiḥ klāntaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātram āhuḥ |
meaning: स्वाध्यायोत्थं योनिमन्तं प्रशान्तं वैतानस्थं पापभीरुं बहुज्ञम् । स्त्रीषु क्षान्तं धार्मिकं गोशरण्यं व्रतैः क्लान्तं तादृशं पात्रम् आहुः ।
text: They declare that he is worthy to receive gifts, who (daily) rises to recite the Veda, who is of good family, and perfectly free from, passion, who constantly offers. sacrifices in the three sacred fires, who fears sin, and knows much, who is beloved among the females (of his family), who is righteous, protects cows, and reduces himself by austerities.

sanskrit_iast: āmapātre yathā nyastaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu | vinaśyet pātradaurbalyān na ca pātraṃ rasāś ca te |
meaning: आमपात्रे यथा न्यस्तं क्षीरं दधि घृतं मधु । विनश्येत् पात्रदौर्बल्यान् न च पात्रं रसाश् च ते ।
text: Just as milk, sour milk, clarified butter, and honey poured. into an unburnt earthen vessel, perish, owing to the weakness of the vessel, and neither the vessel nor those liquids (remain),

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ gā vā hiraṇyaṃ vā vastram aśvaṃ mahīṃ tilān | avidvān pratigṛhṇāno bhasmībhavati kāṣṭhavat |
meaning: एवं गा वा हिरण्यं वा वस्त्रम् अश्वं महीं तिलान् । अविद्वान् प्रतिगृह्णानो भस्मीभवति काष्ठवत् ।
text: Even so a man destitute of sacred learning, who accepts cows or gold, clothes, a horse, land, (or) sesamum, becomes ashes, as (if he were dry) wood.

sanskrit_iast: nāṅganakhavādanaṃ kuryāt |
meaning: नाङ्गनखवादनं कुर्यात् ।
text: He shall not make his joints or his nails crack,

sanskrit_iast: nakhaiś ca bhojanādau |
meaning: नखैश् च भोजनादौ ।
text: Nor shall he make a vessel ring with his nails.

sanskrit_iast: na cāpo 'ñjalinā pibet |
meaning: न चापो ऽञ्जलिना पिबेत् ।
text: Let him not drink water out of his joined hands.

sanskrit_iast: na pādena pāṇinā vā jalam abhihanyāt |
meaning: न पादेन पाणिना वा जलम् अभिहन्यात् ।
text: Let him not strike the water with his foot or his hand,

sanskrit_iast: na jalena jalam |
meaning: न जलेन जलम् ।
text: Nor (pour) water into (other) water.

sanskrit_iast: neṣṭakābhiḥ phalaṃ śātayīta |
meaning: नेष्टकाभिः फलं शातयीत ।
text: Let him not gather fruit by throwing brickbats,

sanskrit_iast: na phalena phalam |
meaning: न फलेन फलम् ।
text: Nor by throwing another fruit at it.

sanskrit_iast: na kalko na kuhako bhavet |
meaning: न कल्को न कुहको भवेत् ।
text: He shall not become a hypocrite or deceitful.

sanskrit_iast: na mlecchabhāṣāṃ śikṣeta |
meaning: न म्लेच्छभाषां शिक्षेत ।
text: Let him not learn a language spoken by barbarians.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | na pāṇipādacapalo na netracapalo bhavet | na ca vācaṅgacapala iti śiṣṭasya gocaraḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । न पाणिपादचपलो न नेत्रचपलो भवेत् । न च वाचङ्गचपल इति शिष्टस्य गोचरः ।
text: Now they quote' also (the following verses): 'The opinion of the Śishṭas is, that a man shall not be uselessly active, neither with his hands and his feet, nor with his eyes, nor with his tongues and his body.'

sanskrit_iast: pāraṃparyagato yeṣāṃ vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ | te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā jñeyāḥ śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ |
meaning: पारंपर्यगतो येषां वेदः सपरिबृंहणः । ते शिष्टा ब्राह्मणा ज्ञेयाः श्रुतिप्रत्यक्षहेतवः ।
text: 'Those Brāhmaṇas, in whose families the study of the Veda and of its supplements is hereditary, and who are able to adduce proofs perceptible by the senses from the revealed texts, must be known to be Śishṭas.'

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ na santaṃ na vāsantaṃ nāśrutaṃ na bahuśrutam | na suvṛttaṃ na durvṛttaṃ veda kaścit sa brāhmaṇaḥ | sa brāhmaṇa iti |
meaning: यं न सन्तं न वासन्तं नाश्रुतं न बहुश्रुतम् । न सुवृत्तं न दुर्वृत्तं वेद कश्चित् स ब्राह्मणः । स ब्राह्मण इति ।
text: 'He is a (true) Brāhmaṇa regarding whom no one knows if he be good or bad, if he be ignorant or deeply learned, if he be of good or of bad conduct.'

sanskrit_iast: catvāra āśramāḥ |
meaning: चत्वार आश्रमाः ।
text: There are four orders,

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārigṛhasthavānaprasthaparivrājakāḥ |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारिगृहस्थवानप्रस्थपरिव्राजकाः ।
text: Viz. (that of) the student, (that of) the house-holder, (that of) the hermit, and (that of) the ascetic.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ vedam adhītya vedau vedān vāviśīrṇabrahmacaryo yam icchet tam āvaset |
meaning: तेषां वेदम् अधीत्य वेदौ वेदान् वाविशीर्णब्रह्मचर्यो यम् इच्छेत् तम् आवसेत् ।
text: A man who has studied one, two, or three Vedas without violating the rules of studentship, may enter any of these (orders), whichsoever he pleases.

sanskrit_iast: brahamacāry ācāryaṃ paricared ā śarīravimokṣaṇāt |
meaning: ब्रहमचार्य् आचार्यं परिचरेद् आ शरीरविमोक्षणात् ।
text: A (professed) student shall serve his teacher until death;

sanskrit_iast: ācārye ca prete 'gniṃ paricaret |
meaning: आचार्ये च प्रेते ऽग्निं परिचरेत् ।
text: And in case the teacher dies, he shall serve the sacred fire.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate hy agnir ācāryas taveti |
meaning: विज्ञायते ह्य् अग्निर् आचार्यस् तवेति ।
text: For it has been declared in the Veda, 'The fire is thy teacher:'

sanskrit_iast: saṃyatavāc |
meaning: संयतवाच् ।
text: (A student, whether professed or temporary), shall bridle his tongue;

sanskrit_iast: caturthaṣaṣṭhāṣṭamakālabhojī |
meaning: चतुर्थषष्ठाष्टमकालभोजी ।
text: He shall eat in the fourth, sixth, or eighth hour of the day.

sanskrit_iast: bhaikṣam ācaret |
meaning: भैक्षम् आचरेत् ।
text: He shall go out in order to beg.

sanskrit_iast: gurvadhīnaḥ |
meaning: गुर्वधीनः ।
text: He shall obey his teacher.

sanskrit_iast: jaṭilaḥ śikhājaṭo vā |
meaning: जटिलः शिखाजटो वा ।
text: He either (may wear all his hair) tied in a knot or (keep merely) a lock on the crown of his head tied in a knot, (shaving the other parts of the head.)

sanskrit_iast: guruṃ gacchantam anugacched āsīnaś cet tiṣṭhec chayānaś ced āsīna upāsīta |
meaning: गुरुं गच्छन्तम् अनुगच्छेद् आसीनश् चेत् तिष्ठेच् छयानश् चेद् आसीन उपासीत ।
text: If the teacher walks, he shall attend him walking after him; if the teacher is seated, standing; if the teacher lies down, seated.

sanskrit_iast: āhūtādhyāyī |
meaning: आहूताध्यायी ।
text: He shall study after having been called (by the teacher, and not request the latter to begin the lesson).

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ labdhaṃ nivedya tadanujñayā bhuñjīta |
meaning: सर्वं लब्धं निवेद्य तदनुज्ञया भुञ्जीत ।
text: Let him announce (to the teacher) all that he has received (when begging), and eat after permission (has been given to him).

sanskrit_iast: khaṭvāśayanadantadhāvanaprakṣālanāñjanābhyañjanopānachatravarjī |
meaning: खट्वाशयनदन्तधावनप्रक्षालनाञ्जनाभ्यञ्जनोपानछत्रवर्जी ।
text: Let him avoid to sleep on a cot, to clean his teeth, to wash (his body for pleasure), to apply collyrium (to his eyes),. to anoint (his body), and to wear shoes or a parasol.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhed ahani rātrāv āsīta |
meaning: तिष्ठेद् अहनि रात्राव् आसीत ।
text: (While reciting his prayers) he shall stand in the day-time and sit down at night.

sanskrit_iast: trir ahno 'bhyupeyād apa ity apa iti |
meaning: त्रिर् अह्नो ऽभ्युपेयाद् अप इत्य् अप इति ।
text: Let him bathe three times a day.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhastho vinītakrodhaharṣo guruṇānujñātaḥ snātvāsamānārṣeyām aspṛṣṭamaithunām avaravayasīṃ sadṛśīṃ bhāryāṃ vindeta |
meaning: गृहस्थो विनीतक्रोधहर्षो गुरुणानुज्ञातः स्नात्वासमानार्षेयाम् अस्पृष्टमैथुनाम् अवरवयसीं सदृशीं भार्यां विन्देत ।
text: (A student who desires to become) a house-holder shall bathe, free from anger and elation, with the permission of his teacher, and take for a wife a young female of his own caste, who does neither belong to the same Gotra nor has the same Pravara, who has not had intercourse (with another man),

sanskrit_iast: pañcamīṃ mātṛbandhubhyaḥ saptamīṃ pitṛbandhubhyaḥ |
meaning: पञ्चमीं मातृबन्धुभ्यः सप्तमीं पितृबन्धुभ्यः ।
text: Who is not related within four degrees on the mother's side, nor within six degrees on the fatherśside.

sanskrit_iast: vaivāhyam agnim indhīta |
meaning: वैवाह्यम् अग्निम् इन्धीत ।
text: Let him kindle the nuptial fire.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam āgatam atithiṃ nāparundhyāt |
meaning: सायम् आगतम् अतिथिं नापरुन्ध्यात् ।
text: Let him not turn away a guest who comes in the evening.

sanskrit_iast: nāsyānaśnan gṛhe vaset |
meaning: नास्यानश्नन् गृहे वसेत् ।
text: (A guest) shall not dwell in his house without receiving food.

sanskrit_iast: yasya nāśnāti vāsārthī brāhmaṇo gṛham āgataḥ | sukṛtaṃ tasya yat kimcit sarvam ādāya gacchati |
meaning: यस्य नाश्नाति वासार्थी ब्राह्मणो गृहम् आगतः । सुकृतं तस्य यत् किम्चित् सर्वम् आदाय गच्छति ।
text: If a Brāhmaṇa who has come for shelter to the house of a (householder) receives no food, on departure he will take with him all the spiritual merit of that (churlish host).

sanskrit_iast: ekarātraṃ tu nivasann atithir brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāt tasmād atithir ucyate |
meaning: एकरात्रं तु निवसन्न् अतिथिर् ब्राह्मणः स्मृतः । अनित्यं हि स्थितो यस्मात् तस्माद् अतिथिर् उच्यते ।
text: But a Brāhmaṇa who stays for one night only is called a guest. For (the etymological import of the word) atithi (a guest) is 'he who stays for a short while only.'

sanskrit_iast: naikagrāmīṇa atithir vipraḥ sāṅgatikas tathā | kāle prāpte akāle vā nāsyānaśnan gṛhe vaset |
meaning: नैकग्रामीण अतिथिर् विप्रः साङ्गतिकस् तथा । काले प्राप्ते अकाले वा नास्यानश्नन् गृहे वसेत् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who lives in the same village (with his host) and a visitor on business, or pleasure (are) not (called guests. But a guest), whether he arrives at the moment (of dinner) or at an inopportune time, must not stay in the house of a (householder) without receiving food.

sanskrit_iast: śraddhāśīlospṛhayālur alam agnyādheyāya nānāhitāgniḥ syāt |
meaning: श्रद्धाशीलोस्पृहयालुर् अलम् अग्न्याधेयाय नानाहिताग्निः स्यात् ।
text: (A householder) who has faith, is free from covetousness, and (possesses wealth) sufficient for (performing) the Agnyādheya-sacrifice, must become an Agnihotrin.

sanskrit_iast: alaṃ ca somāya nāsomayājī |
meaning: अलं च सोमाय नासोमयाजी ।
text: He (who possesses wealth) sufficient for (the expenses of) a Soma, sacrifice shall not abstain from offering it.

sanskrit_iast: yuktaḥ svādhyāye yajñe prajanane ca |
meaning: युक्तः स्वाध्याये यज्ञे प्रजनने च ।
text: (A householder) shall be industrious in reciting the Veda, offering sacrifices, begetting children, and (performing his other duties).

sanskrit_iast: gṛheṣv abhyāgataṃ pratyutthānāsanavācsūnṛtānasūyābhir mahayet |
meaning: गृहेष्व् अभ्यागतं प्रत्युत्थानासनवाच्सूनृतानसूयाभिर् महयेत् ।
text: Let him honour visitors (who come) to his house by rising to meet them, by (offering them) seats, by speaking to them kindly and extolling their virtues,

sanskrit_iast: yathāśakti cānnena sarvāṇi bhūtāni |
meaning: यथाशक्ति चान्नेन सर्वाणि भूतानि ।
text: And all creatures by (giving them) food according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhastha eva yajate gṛhasthas tapyate tapaḥ | caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ tu gṛhasthaś ca viśiṣyate |
meaning: गृहस्थ एव यजते गृहस्थस् तप्यते तपः । चतुर्णाम् आश्रमाणां तु गृहस्थश् च विशिष्यते ।
text: A householder alone performs sacrifices, a householder alone performs austerities, and (therefore) the order of householders is the most distinguished among the four.

sanskrit_iast: yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve samudre yānti saṃsthitim | evam āśramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim |
