meaning: यथा नदीनदाः सर्वे समुद्रे यान्ति संस्थितिम् । एवम् आश्रमिणः सर्वे गृहस्थे यान्ति संस्थितिम् ।
text: As all rivers, both great and small, find a resting-place in the ocean, even so men of all orders find protection with householders.

sanskrit_iast: yathā mātaram āśritya sarve jīvanti jantavaḥ | evaṃ gṛhastham āśritya sarve jīvanti bhikṣukāḥ |
meaning: यथा मातरम् आश्रित्य सर्वे जीवन्ति जन्तवः । एवं गृहस्थम् आश्रित्य सर्वे जीवन्ति भिक्षुकाः ।
text: As all creatures exist through the protection afforded by their mothers, even so all mendicants subsist through the protection afforded by householders.

sanskrit_iast: nityodakī nityayajñopavītī nityasvādhyāyī patitānnavarjī | ṛtau ca gacchan vidhivac ca juhvan na brāhmaṇaś cyavate brahmalokāt | brahmalokād iti |
meaning: नित्योदकी नित्ययज्ञोपवीती नित्यस्वाध्यायी पतितान्नवर्जी । ऋतौ च गच्छन् विधिवच् च जुह्वन् न ब्राह्मणश् च्यवते ब्रह्मलोकात् । ब्रह्मलोकाद् इति ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who always carries water (in his gourd), who always wears the sacred thread, who daily recites the Veda, who avoids the food of outcasts, who approaches (his wife) in the proper season, and offers sacrifices in accordance with the rules (of the Veda, after death) never falls from Brahman's heaven.

sanskrit_iast: vānaprastho jaṭilaś cīrājinavāsī |
meaning: वानप्रस्थो जटिलश् चीराजिनवासी ।
text: A hermit shall wear (his hair in) braids, and dress (in garments made of) bark and skins;

sanskrit_iast: grāmaṃ ca na praviśet |
meaning: ग्रामं च न प्रविशेत् ।
text: And he shall not enter a village.

sanskrit_iast: na phālakṛṣṭam adhitiṣṭhet |
meaning: न फालकृष्टम् अधितिष्ठेत् ।
text: He shall not step on ploughed (land).

sanskrit_iast: akṛṣṭaṃ mūlaphalaṃ sañcinvīta |
meaning: अकृष्टं मूलफलं सञ्चिन्वीत ।
text: He shall gather wild growing roots and fruit (only).

sanskrit_iast: urdhvaretāḥ |
meaning: उर्ध्वरेताः ।
text: He shall remain chaste.

sanskrit_iast: kṣamāśayaḥ |
meaning: क्षमाशयः ।
text: His heart shall be full of meekness.

sanskrit_iast: mūlaphalabhaikṣeṇāśramāgatam atithim abhyarcayet |
meaning: मूलफलभैक्षेणाश्रमागतम् अतिथिम् अभ्यर्चयेत् ।
text: He shall honour guests coming to his hermitage with alms (consisting of) roots and fruit.

sanskrit_iast: dadyād eva na pratigṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: दद्याद् एव न प्रतिगृह्णीयात् ।
text: He shall only give, not receive (presents).

sanskrit_iast: tripavaṇam udakopasparśī |
meaning: त्रिपवणम् उदकोपस्पर्शी ।
text: He shall bathe at morn, noon, and eve.

sanskrit_iast: śrāmaṇakenāgnim ādhāyāhitāgniḥ syāt |
meaning: श्रामणकेनाग्निम् आधायाहिताग्निः स्यात् ।
text: Kindling a fire according to the (rule of the) Śrāmaṇaka (Sūtra), he shall offer the Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: vṛkṣamūlaniketana ūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍbhyo māsebhyo 'nagnir aniketaḥ |
meaning: वृक्षमूलनिकेतन ऊर्ध्वं षड्भ्यो मासेभ्यो ऽनग्निर् अनिकेतः ।
text: After (living in this manner during) six months, he shall dwell at the root of a tree, keeping no fire and having no house.

sanskrit_iast: dadyād devapitṛmanuṣyebhyaḥ sa gacchet svargam ānantyam ity ānantyam |
meaning: दद्याद् देवपितृमनुष्येभ्यः स गच्छेत् स्वर्गम् आनन्त्यम् इत्य् आनन्त्यम् ।
text: He (who in this manner) gives (their due) to gods, manes, and men, will attain endless (bliss in) heaven.

sanskrit_iast: parivrājakaḥ sarvabhūtābhayadakṣiṇāṃ dattvā pratiṣṭheta |
meaning: परिव्राजकः सर्वभूताभयदक्षिणां दत्त्वा प्रतिष्ठेत ।
text: Let an ascetic depart from his house, giving a promise of safety from injury to all animated beings.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā carati yo muniḥ | tasyāpi sarvabhūtebhyo na bhayaṃ jātu vidyate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा चरति यो मुनिः । तस्यापि सर्वभूतेभ्यो न भयं जातु विद्यते ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'That ascetic who wanders about at peace with all creatures, forsooth, has nothing to fear from any living being,'

sanskrit_iast: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yas tu nivarttate | hanti jātān ajātāṃś ca dravyāṇi pratigṛhya ca |
meaning: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यस् तु निवर्त्तते । हन्ति जातान् अजातांश् च द्रव्याणि प्रतिगृह्य च ।
text: 'But he who becomes an ascetic and does not promise safety from injury to all beings, destroys the born and the unborn; and (so does an ascetic) who accepts presents.'

sanskrit_iast: sannyaset sarvakarmāṇi vedam ekaṃ na sannyaset | vedasannyasanāc chūdras tasmād vedaṃ na sannyaset |
meaning: सन्न्यसेत् सर्वकर्माणि वेदम् एकं न सन्न्यसेत् । वेदसन्न्यसनाच् छूद्रस् तस्माद् वेदं न सन्न्यसेत् ।
text: Let him discontinue the performance of all religious ceremonies, but let him never discontinue the recitation of the Veda. By neglecting the Veda he becomes a Śūdra; therefore he shall not neglect it.'

sanskrit_iast: ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmāḥ paraṃ tapaḥ | upavāsāt paraṃ bhaikṣaṃ dayā dānād viśiṣyata iti |
meaning: एकाक्षरं परं ब्रह्म प्राणायामाः परं तपः । उपवासात् परं भैक्षं दया दानाद् विशिष्यत इति ।
text: '(To pronounce) the one syllable (Om) is the best (mode of reciting the) Veda, to suppress the breath is the highest (form of) austerity; (to subsist on) alms is better than fasting; compassion is preferable to liberality.'

sanskrit_iast: muṇḍomamoparigrahaḥ |
meaning: मुण्डोममोपरिग्रहः ।
text: (Let the ascetic) shave (his head); let him have no property and no home.

sanskrit_iast: saptāgārāṇy asaṅkalpitāni cared bhikṣām |
meaning: सप्तागाराण्य् असङ्कल्पितानि चरेद् भिक्षाम् ।
text: Let him beg food at seven houses which he has not selected (beforehand),

sanskrit_iast: vidhūme sann amusale |
meaning: विधूमे सन्न् अमुसले ।
text: (At the time) when the smoke (of the kitchen-fire) has ceased and the pestle lies motionless.

sanskrit_iast: ekaśāṭīparihitaḥ |
meaning: एकशाटीपरिहितः ।
text: Let him wear a single garment,

sanskrit_iast: ajinena vā gopralūnais tṛṇair avastṛtaśarīraḥ |
meaning: अजिनेन वा गोप्रलूनैस् तृणैर् अवस्तृतशरीरः ।
text: Or cover his body with a skin or with grass that has been nibbled at by a cow.

sanskrit_iast: sthaṇḍilaśāyī |
meaning: स्थण्डिलशायी ।
text: Let him sleep on the bare ground.

sanskrit_iast: anityāṃ vasatiṃ vaset |
meaning: अनित्यां वसतिं वसेत् ।
text: Let him frequently change his residence,

sanskrit_iast: grāmānte devagṛhe śūnyāgāre vā vṛkṣamūle vā |
meaning: ग्रामान्ते देवगृहे शून्यागारे वा वृक्षमूले वा ।
text: (Dwelling) at the extremity of the village, in a temple, or in an empty house, or at the root of a tree.

sanskrit_iast: manasā jñānam adhīyānaḥ |
meaning: मनसा ज्ञानम् अधीयानः ।
text: Let him (constantly) seek in his heart the knowledge (of the universal soul).

sanskrit_iast: araṇyanityaḥ |
meaning: अरण्यनित्यः ।
text: (An ascetic) who lives constantly in the forest,

sanskrit_iast: na grāmyapaśūnāṃ sandarśane vicaret |
meaning: न ग्राम्यपशूनां सन्दर्शने विचरेत् ।
text: Shall not wander about within sight of the village-cattle.

sanskrit_iast: araṇyanityasya jitendriyasya sarvendriyaprītinivartakasya | adhyātmacintāgatamānasasya dhruvā hy anāvṛttir upekṣakasyeti |
meaning: अरण्यनित्यस्य जितेन्द्रियस्य सर्वेन्द्रियप्रीतिनिवर्तकस्य । अध्यात्मचिन्तागतमानसस्य ध्रुवा ह्य् अनावृत्तिर् उपेक्षकस्येति ।
text: 'Freedom from future births is certain for him who constantly dwells in the forest, who has subdued his organs of sensation and action, who has renounced all sensual gratification, whose mind is fixed in meditation on the Supreme Spirit, and who is (wholly) indifferent (to pleasure and pain).'

sanskrit_iast: avyaktaliṅgovyaktācāraḥ |
meaning: अव्यक्तलिङ्गोव्यक्ताचारः ।
text: (Let him) not (wear) any visible mark (of his order), nor (follow) any visible rule of conduct.

sanskrit_iast: anunmatta unmattaveṣaḥ |
meaning: अनुन्मत्त उन्मत्तवेषः ।
text: Let him, though not mad, appear like one out of his mind.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | na śabdaśāstrabhiratasya mokṣo na cāpi lokagrahaṇe ratasya | na bhojanācchādanatatparasya na cāpi ramyāvasathapriyasya |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । न शब्दशास्त्रभिरतस्य मोक्षो न चापि लोकग्रहणे रतस्य । न भोजनाच्छादनतत्परस्य न चापि रम्यावसथप्रियस्य ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'There is no salvation for him who is addicted to the pursuit of the science of words, nor for him who rejoices in captivating men, nor for him who is fond of (good) eating and (fine) clothing, nor for him who loves a pleasant dwelling.'

sanskrit_iast: na cotpātanimittābhyām na nakṣatrāṅgavidyayā | nānuśāsanavādābhyāṃ bhikṣāṃ lipseta karhicit |
meaning: न चोत्पातनिमित्ताभ्याम् न नक्षत्राङ्गविद्यया । नानुशासनवादाभ्यां भिक्षां लिप्सेत कर्हिचित् ।
text: 'Neither by (explaining) prodigies and omens, nor by skill in astrology and palmistry, nor by casuistry and expositions (of the Śāstras), let him ever seek to obtain alms.'

sanskrit_iast: alābhe na viṣādī syāl lābhe naiva ca harṣayet | prāṇayātrikamātraḥ syān mātrāsaṅgād vivarjitaḥ |
meaning: अलाभे न विषादी स्याल् लाभे नैव च हर्षयेत् । प्राणयात्रिकमात्रः स्यान् मात्रासङ्गाद् विवर्जितः ।
text: 'Let him not be dejected when he obtains nothing, nor glad when he receives something. Let him only seek as much as will sustain life, without caring for household property.'

sanskrit_iast: na kuṭyāṃ nodake saṅgo na caile na tripuṣkare | nāgāre nāsane nānne yasya vai mokṣavid tu sa iti |
meaning: न कुट्यां नोदके सङ्गो न चैले न त्रिपुष्करे । नागारे नासने नान्ने यस्य वै मोक्षविद् तु स इति ।
text: 'But he, forsooth, knows (the' road to) salvation who cares neither for a hut, nor for water, nor for clothes, nor for the three Pushkaras' (holy tanks), nor for a house, nor for a seat, nor for food.'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇakule yāval labheta tad bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātar madhumāṃsavarjam |
meaning: ब्राह्मणकुले यावल् लभेत तद् भुञ्जीत सायं प्रातर् मधुमांसवर्जम् ।
text: In the morning and in the evening he may eat as much (food) as he obtains in the house of one Brāhmaṇa, excepting honey and meat,

sanskrit_iast: na ca tṛpyet |
meaning: न च तृप्येत् ।
text: And he shall not (eat so much that he is quite) satiated.

sanskrit_iast: grāme vā vaset |
meaning: ग्रामे वा वसेत् ।
text: At his option (an ascetic) may (also) dwell in a village.

sanskrit_iast: ajihmośaḍhośaraṇovasaṅkusukaḥ |
meaning: अजिह्मोशढोशरणोवसङ्कुसुकः ।
text: Let him not be crooked (in his ways); (let him) not (observe the rules of) impurity on account of deaths (or births); let him not have a house; let him be of concentrated mind.

sanskrit_iast: na cendriyasaṃsargaṃ kurvīta kenacit |
meaning: न चेन्द्रियसंसर्गं कुर्वीत केनचित् ।
text: Let him not enjoy any object of sensual gratification.

sanskrit_iast: upekṣakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hiṃsānugrahaparihāreṇa |
meaning: उपेक्षकः सर्वभूतानां हिंसानुग्रहपरिहारेण ।
text: Let him be (utterly) indifferent, avoiding to do injury or to show kindness to any living being.

sanskrit_iast: paiśunyamatsarābhimānāhaṅkārāśraddhānārjavātmastavaparagarhādambhalobhamohakrodhāsūyāvivarjanaṃ sarvāśramāṇaṃ dharma iṣṭaḥ |
meaning: पैशुन्यमत्सराभिमानाहङ्काराश्रद्धानार्जवात्मस्तवपरगर्हादम्भलोभमोहक्रोधासूयाविवर्जनं सर्वाश्रमाणं धर्म इष्टः ।
text: To avoid backbiting, jealousy, pride, self-consciousness, unbelief, dishonesty, self-praise, blaming others, deceit, covetousness, delusion, anger, and envy is considered to be the duty of (men of) all orders.

sanskrit_iast: yajñopavīty udakamaṇḍaluhastaḥ śucir brāhmaṇo vṛṣalānnavarjī na hīyate brahmalokād brahmalokād iti |
meaning: यज्ञोपवीत्य् उदकमण्डलुहस्तः शुचिर् ब्राह्मणो वृषलान्नवर्जी न हीयते ब्रह्मलोकाद् ब्रह्मलोकाद् इति ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who wears the sacred thread, who holds in his hand a gourd filled with water, who is pure and avoids the food of Śūdras will not fail (to gain) the world of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ arghārhā bhavanti |
meaning: षड् अर्घार्हा भवन्ति ।
text: Six persons are (particularly) worthy to receive the honey-mixture (madhuparka),

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvij vivāhyo rājāpitṛvyasnātakamātulāś ca |
meaning: ऋत्विज् विवाह्यो राजापितृव्यस्नातकमातुलाश् च ।
text: (Viz.) an officiating priest, the bridegroom of one's daughter, a king, a paternal uncle, a Snātaka, a maternal uncle, as well as (others enumerated elsewhere).

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevasya siddhasya sāyaṃ prātar gṛhyāgnau juhuyāt |
meaning: वैश्वदेवस्य सिद्धस्य सायं प्रातर् गृह्याग्नौ जुहुयात् ।
text: (A householder) shall offer, both at the morning and the evening (meals, a portion) of the prepared (food) to the Viśve Devas in the (sacred) domestic fire.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhadevatābhyo baliṃ haret |
meaning: गृहदेवताभ्यो बलिं हरेत् ।
text: Let him give a Bali-offering to the (guardian) deities of the house,

sanskrit_iast: śrotriyāyāgrabhāgaṃ dattvā brahmacāriṇe vānantaraṃ pitṛbhyo dadyāt |
meaning: श्रोत्रियायाग्रभागं दत्त्वा ब्रह्मचारिणे वानन्तरं पितृभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: (Thereafter) let him give a portion, one Pala in weight, to a Śrotriya or to a student, (and afterwards an offering) to the manes.

sanskrit_iast: tato 'tithiṃ bhojayec chreyāṃsaṃ śreyāṃsam ānupūrvyeṇa |
meaning: ततो ऽतिथिं भोजयेच् छ्रेयांसं श्रेयांसम् आनुपूर्व्येण ।
text: Next let him feed his guests in due order, the worthiest first,

sanskrit_iast: svagṛhyāṇāṃ kumārībālavṛddhataruṇaprajātāḥ |
meaning: स्वगृह्याणां कुमारीबालवृद्धतरुणप्रजाताः ।
text: (Thereafter) the maidens, the infants, the aged, the half-grown members of his family, and pradātās,

sanskrit_iast: tato 'parān gṛhyān |
meaning: ततो ऽपरान् गृह्यान् ।
text: Then the other members of his family.

sanskrit_iast: śvacāṇḍālapatitavāyasebhyo bhūmau nirvapet |
meaning: श्वचाण्डालपतितवायसेभ्यो भूमौ निर्वपेत् ।
text: (Outside the house) he shall throw (some food) on the ground for the dogs, Kāṇd ālas, outcasts, and crows.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrāyocchiṣṭam anucchiṣṭaṃ vā dadyāt |
meaning: शूद्रायोच्छिष्टम् अनुच्छिष्टं वा दद्यात् ।
text: He may give to a Śūdra either the fragments (of the meal) or (a portion of) fresh (food).

sanskrit_iast: śeṣaṃ dampatī bhuñjīyātām |
meaning: शेषं दम्पती भुञ्जीयाताम् ।
text: The master of the house and his wife may eat what remains.

sanskrit_iast: sarvopayogena punaḥpāko yadi nirupte vaiśvadeve 'tithir āgacched viśeṣeṇāsmā annaṃ kārayet |
meaning: सर्वोपयोगेन पुनःपाको यदि निरुप्ते वैश्वदेवे ऽतिथिर् आगच्छेद् विशेषेणास्मा अन्नं कारयेत् ।
text: A fresh meal for which all (the same materials as for the first) are used (may be prepared), if a guest comes after the Vaiśvadeva has been offered. For such a (guest) he shall cause to be prepared food (of a) particularly (good quality).

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate hi | vaiśvānaraḥ praviśaty atithir brāhmaṇo gṛhaṃ tasmād apa ānayanty annaṃ varṣābhyas tāṃ hi śāntiṃ janā vidur iti |
meaning: विज्ञायते हि । वैश्वानरः प्रविशत्य् अतिथिर् ब्राह्मणो गृहं तस्माद् अप आनयन्त्य् अन्नं वर्षाभ्यस् तां हि शान्तिं जना विदुर् इति ।
text: For it has been declared in the Veda, 'A Brāhmaṇa guest enters the house resembling the Vaiśvānara fire. Through., him they obtain rain, and food through rain. Therefore people know that the (hospitable reception of a guest) is a ceremony averting evil.'

sanskrit_iast: taṃ bhojayitvopāsīta |
meaning: तं भोजयित्वोपासीत ।
text: Having fed the (guest), he shall honour him.

sanskrit_iast: ā sīmāntam anuvrajed anujñānād vā |
meaning: आ सीमान्तम् अनुव्रजेद् अनुज्ञानाद् वा ।
text: He shall accompany him to the boundary (of the village) or until he receives permission (to return).

sanskrit_iast: aparapakṣa ūrdhvaṃ caturthyāḥ pitṛbhyo dadyāt |
meaning: अपरपक्ष ऊर्ध्वं चतुर्थ्याः पितृभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: Let him present (funeral offerings) to the manes during the dark half of the month (on any day) after the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyur brāhmaṇān sannipātya yatīn gṛhasthān sādhūn vāpariṇatavayaso vikarmasthāñ śrotriyān aśiṣyān anantevāsinaḥ |
meaning: पूर्वेद्युर् ब्राह्मणान् सन्निपात्य यतीन् गृहस्थान् साधून् वापरिणतवयसो विकर्मस्थाञ् श्रोत्रियान् अशिष्यान् अनन्तेवासिनः ।
text: After issuing an invitation on the day preceding (the Śrāddha, he shall feed on that occasion) three ascetics or three virtuous householders, who are Śrotriyas, who are not very aged, who do not follow forbidden occupations, and neither (have been his) pupils, nor are (living as) pupils in his house.

sanskrit_iast: śiṣyān api guṇavato bhojayet |
meaning: शिष्यान् अपि गुणवतो भोजयेत् ।
text: He may also feed pupils who are endowed with good qualities.

sanskrit_iast: nagnaśuklaklībāndhaśyāvadantakuṣṭhikunakhivarjam |
meaning: नग्नशुक्लक्लीबान्धश्यावदन्तकुष्ठिकुनखिवर्जम् ।
text: Let him avoid men neglecting their duties, those afflicted with white leprosy, eunuchs, blind men, those who have black teeth, those who suffer from black leprosy, (and) those who have deformed nails.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | atha cen mantravid yuktaḥ śārīraiḥ paṅktidūṣaṇaiḥ | aduṣyaṃ taṃ yamaḥ prāha paṅktipāvana eva saḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अथ चेन् मन्त्रविद् युक्तः शारीरैः पङ्क्तिदूषणैः । अदुष्यं तं यमः प्राह पङ्क्तिपावन एव सः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Now, if a (Brāhmaṇa) versed in the Vedas is afflicted with bodily (defects) which exclude him from the company, Yama declares him to be irreproachable. Such (a man) sanctifies the company.'

sanskrit_iast: śrāddhe nodvāsanīyāni ucchiṣṭāny ā dinakṣayāt | ścyotante hi sudhādhārās tāḥ pibanty akṛtodakāḥ |
meaning: श्राद्धे नोद्वासनीयानि उच्छिष्टान्य् आ दिनक्षयात् । श्च्योतन्ते हि सुधाधारास् ताः पिबन्त्य् अकृतोदकाः ।
text: 'At a funeral sacrifice the fragments (of the meal) must not be swept away until the end of the day. For streams of nectar flow (from them, and the manes of) those who have received no libations of water drink (them).'

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭaṃ na pramṛjyāt tu yāvan nāstamito raviḥ | kṣīradhārās tato yānty akṣayyāḥ sañcarabhāginaḥ |
meaning: उच्छिष्टं न प्रमृज्यात् तु यावन् नास्तमितो रविः । क्षीरधारास् ततो यान्त्य् अक्षय्याः सञ्चरभागिनः ।
text: 'But let him not sweep up the fragments (of the meal) before the sun has set. Thence issue rich streams of milk for those who obtain a share with difficulty.'

sanskrit_iast: prāk saṃskārāt pramītānāṃ svavaṃśyānām iti sthitiḥ | bhāgadheyaṃ manuḥ prāha ucchiṣṭoccheṣaṇe ubhe |
meaning: प्राक् संस्कारात् प्रमीतानां स्ववंश्यानाम् इति स्थितिः । भागधेयं मनुः प्राह उच्छिष्टोच्छेषणे उभे ।
text: 'Manu declares that both the remainder (in the vessels) and the fragments (of the meal) certainly are the portion of those members of the family who died before receiving the sacraments.'

sanskrit_iast: uccheṣaṇaṃ bhūmigataṃ vikiraṃ lepanodakam | annaṃ preteṣu visṛjed aprajānām anāyuṣām |
meaning: उच्छेषणं भूमिगतं विकिरं लेपनोदकम् । अन्नं प्रेतेषु विसृजेद् अप्रजानाम् अनायुषाम् ।
text: 'Let him give the fragments that have fallen on the ground and the portion scattered (on the blades of Kuśa grass), which consists of the wipings and water, as their food, to the manes of those who died without offspring and of those who died young.'

sanskrit_iast: ubhayor hastayor muktaṃ pitṛbhyo 'nnaṃ niveditam | tadantaraṃ pratīkṣante hy asurā duṣṭacetasaḥ |
meaning: उभयोर् हस्तयोर् मुक्तं पितृभ्यो ऽन्नं निवेदितम् । तदन्तरं प्रतीक्षन्ते ह्य् असुरा दुष्टचेतसः ।
text: 'The malevolent Asuras seek an opportunity (to snatch away) that food intended for the manes, which is not supported with both hands;'

sanskrit_iast: tasmād aśūnyahastena kuryād annam upāgatam | bhojanaṃ vā samālabhya tiṣṭhetoccheṣaṇe ubhe |
meaning: तस्माद् अशून्यहस्तेन कुर्याद् अन्नम् उपागतम् । भोजनं वा समालभ्य तिष्ठेतोच्छेषणे उभे ।
text: 'Therefore let him not offer it (to the Brāhmaṇas) without holding (a spoon) in his hand; or let him stand, holding the dish (with both hands, until) leavings of both kinds (have been produced).'

sanskrit_iast: dvau daive pitṛkṛtye trīn ekaikam ubhayatra vā | bhojayet susamṛddho 'pi na prasajjeta vistare |
meaning: द्वौ दैवे पितृकृत्ये त्रीन् एकैकम् उभयत्र वा । भोजयेत् सुसमृद्धो ऽपि न प्रसज्जेत विस्तरे ।
text: 'He shall feed two (Brāhmaṇas) at the offering to the gods, and three at the offering to the manes, or a single man on either occasion; even a very wealthy man shall not be anxious (to entertain) a large company.'

sanskrit_iast: satkriyāṃ deśakālau ca śaucaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpadam | pañcaitān vistaro hanti tasmāt taṃ parivarjayet |
meaning: सत्क्रियां देशकालौ च शौचं ब्राह्मणसंपदम् । पञ्चैतान् विस्तरो हन्ति तस्मात् तं परिवर्जयेत् ।
text: 'A large company destroys these five (advantages), the respectful treatment (of the invited guests, the propriety of) time and place, purity and (the selection of) virtuous Brāhmaṇa (guests); therefore he shall not (invite a large number).'

sanskrit_iast: api vā bhojayed ekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam | śrutaśīlopasaṃpannaṃ sarvālakṣaṇavarjitam |
meaning: अपि वा भोजयेद् एकं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् । श्रुतशीलोपसंपन्नं सर्वालक्षणवर्जितम् ।
text: 'Or he may entertain (at a Śrāddha) even a single Brāhmaṇa who has studied the whole Veda, who is distinguished by learning and virtue, and is free from all evil marks (on his body).'

sanskrit_iast: yady ekaṃ bhojayec chrāddhe daivaṃ tatra kathaṃ bhavet | annaṃ pātre samuddhṛtya sarvasya prakṛtasya tu |
meaning: यद्य् एकं भोजयेच् छ्राद्धे दैवं तत्र कथं भवेत् । अन्नं पात्रे समुद्धृत्य सर्वस्य प्रकृतस्य तु ।
text: '(But) how can the oblation to the gods be made if he feeds a single Brāhmaṇa at a funeral sacrifice? Let him take (a portion) of each (kind of) food that has been prepared (and put it) into a vessel;'

sanskrit_iast: devatāyatane kṛtvā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pravartayet | prāsyed agnau tad annaṃ vā dadyād vā brahmacāriṇe |
meaning: देवतायतने कृत्वा ततः श्राद्धं प्रवर्तयेत् । प्रास्येद् अग्नौ तद् अन्नं वा दद्याद् वा ब्रह्मचारिणे ।
text: 'Let him place it in the sanctuary of a god and afterwards continue (the performance of) the funeral sacrifice. Let him offer that food in the fire or give it (as alms) to a student.'

sanskrit_iast: yāvad uṣṇaṃ bhavaty annaṃ yāvad aśnanti vācyatāḥ | tāvad hi pitaro 'śnanti yāvan noktā havirguṇāḥ |
meaning: यावद् उष्णं भवत्य् अन्नं यावद् अश्नन्ति वाच्यताः । तावद् हि पितरो ऽश्नन्ति यावन् नोक्ता हविर्गुणाः ।
text: 'As long as the food continues warm, as long as they eat in silence, as long as the qualities of the food are not declared (by them), so long the manes feast on it.'

sanskrit_iast: havirguṇā na vaktavyāḥ pitaro yāvad atarpitāḥ | pitṛbhis tarpitaiḥ paścād vaktavyaṃ śobhanaṃ haviḥ |
meaning: हविर्गुणा न वक्तव्याः पितरो यावद् अतर्पिताः । पितृभिस् तर्पितैः पश्चाद् वक्तव्यं शोभनं हविः ।
text: 'The qualities of the food must not be declared as long as the (Brāhmaṇas who represent the) manes are not satiated. Afterwards when they are satisfied, they may say, "Beautiful is the sacrificial food."'

sanskrit_iast: niyuktas tu yatiḥ śrāddhe daive vā māṃsam utsṛjet | yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvan narakam ṛcchati |
meaning: नियुक्तस् तु यतिः श्राद्धे दैवे वा मांसम् उत्सृजेत् । यावन्ति पशुरोमाणि तावन् नरकम् ऋच्छति ।
text: 'But an ascetic who, invited to dine at a sacrifice of the manes or of the gods, rejects meat, shall go to hell for as many years as the slaughtered beast has hairs.'

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutapas tilāḥ | trīṇi cātra praśaṃsānti śaucam akrodham atvarām |
meaning: त्रीणि श्राद्धे पवित्राणि दौहित्रः कुतपस् तिलाः । त्रीणि चात्र प्रशंसान्ति शौचम् अक्रोधम् अत्वराम् ।
text: 'Three (things are held to) sanctify a funeral sacrifice, a daughter's son, the midday, and sesamum grains; and they recommend three (other things) for it, purity, freedom from anger and from precipitation.'

sanskrit_iast: divasasyāṣṭame bhāge mandībhavati bhāskaraḥ | sa kālaḥ kutapo jñeyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam |
meaning: दिवसस्याष्टमे भागे मन्दीभवति भास्करः । स कालः कुतपो ज्ञेयः पितॄणां दत्तम् अक्षयम् ।
text: 'The eighth division of the day, during which the sun's (progress in the heavens) becomes slow, one must know to be midday; what is (then) given to the manes lasts (them) for a very long time.'

sanskrit_iast: śrāddhaṃ dattvā bhuktvā ca maithunaṃ yo 'dhigacchati | bhavanti pitaras tasya tanmāsaṃ retaso bhujaḥ |
meaning: श्राद्धं दत्त्वा भुक्त्वा च मैथुनं यो ऽधिगच्छति । भवन्ति पितरस् तस्य तन्मासं रेतसो भुजः ।
text: 'The ancestors of that man who has intercourse with a woman after offering or having dined at a Śrāddha, feed during a month from that (day) on his semen.'

sanskrit_iast: yas tato jāyate garbho dattvā bhuktvā ca paitṛkam | na sa vidyāṃ samāpnoti kṣīṇāyuś caiva jāyate |
meaning: यस् ततो जायते गर्भो दत्त्वा भुक्त्वा च पैतृकम् । न स विद्यां समाप्नोति क्षीणायुश् चैव जायते ।
text: 'A child that is born from (intercourse immediately) after offering a Śrāddha or partaking of a funeral repast, is unable to acquire sacred learning and becomes short-lived.'

sanskrit_iast: pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | upāsate sutaṃ jātaṃ śakuntā iva pippalam |
meaning: पिता पितामहश् चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः । उपासते सुतं जातं शकुन्ता इव पिप्पलम् ।
text: 'The father and the grandfather, likewise the great-grandfather, beset a descendant who is born to them, just as birds (fly to) a rig tree;'

sanskrit_iast: madhumāṃsaiś ca śākaiś ca payasā pāyasena ca | eṣa no dāsyati śrāddhaṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca |
meaning: मधुमांसैश् च शाकैश् च पयसा पायसेन च । एष नो दास्यति श्राद्धं वर्षासु च मघासु च ।
text: '(Saying), "He will offer to us funeral repasts with honey and meat, with vegetables, with milk and with messes made of milk, both in the rainy season and under the constellation Maghā h ."

sanskrit_iast: santānavarddhanaṃ putram udyataṃ pitṛkarmaṇi | devabrāhmaṇasaṃpannamabhinandanti pūrvajāḥ |
meaning: सन्तानवर्द्धनं पुत्रम् उद्यतं पितृकर्मणि । देवब्राह्मणसंपन्नमभिनन्दन्ति पूर्वजाः ।
text: 'The ancestors always rejoice at a descendant who lengthens the line, who is zealous in performing funeral sacrifices, and who is rich in (images of the) gods and (virtuous) Brāhmaṇa (guests).'

sanskrit_iast: nandanti pitaras tasya sukṛṣṭair iva karṣakāḥ | yad gayāstho dadāty annaṃ pitaras tena putriṇa iti |
meaning: नन्दन्ति पितरस् तस्य सुकृष्टैर् इव कर्षकाः । यद् गयास्थो ददात्य् अन्नं पितरस् तेन पुत्रिण इति ।
text: 'The manes consider him to be their (true) descendant who offers (to them) food at Gayā, and (by the virtue of that gift) they grant him (blessings), just as husbandmen (produce grain) on well-ploughed (fields).'

sanskrit_iast: śrāvaṇyāgrahāyiṇyoś cānvaṣṭakyāṃ ca pitṛbhyo dadyāt |
meaning: श्रावण्याग्रहायिण्योश् चान्वष्टक्यां च पितृभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: He shall offer (a Śrāddha) both on the full moon days of the months Śrāvaṇa and Āgrahāyaṇa and on the Anvashṭakī.

sanskrit_iast: dravyadeśabrāhmaṇasannidhāne vākālaniyamaḥ |
meaning: द्रव्यदेशब्राह्मणसन्निधाने वाकालनियमः ।
text: There is no restriction as to time, if (particularly suitable) materials and (particularly holy) Brāhmaṇas are at hand, or (if the sacrificer is) near (a particularly sacred) place.

sanskrit_iast: avaśyaṃ brāhmaṇo 'gnīn ādadhīta |
meaning: अवश्यं ब्राह्मणो ऽग्नीन् आदधीत ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa must necessarily kindle the three sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsāgrayaṇeṣṭicāturmāsyapaśusomaiś ca yajeta |
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासाग्रयणेष्टिचातुर्मास्यपशुसोमैश् च यजेत ।
text: He shall offer (in them) the full and new moon sacrifices, the (half-yearly) Āgraya.a Ishṭi, the K āturmāsya-sacrifice, the (half-yearly) sacrifices at which animals are slain, and the (annual) Soma-sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: naiyamikaṃ hy etad ṛṇasaṃstutaṃ ca |
meaning: नैयमिकं ह्य् एतद् ऋणसंस्तुतं च ।
text: For all this is (particularly) enjoined (in the Veda), and called by way of laudation 'a debt.'

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate hi | tribhir ṛṇair ṛṇavān brāhmaṇo jāyata iti | yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyo brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhya ity eṣa vānṛṇo yajvā yaḥ putrī brahmacaryavān iti |
meaning: विज्ञायते हि । त्रिभिर् ऋणैर् ऋणवान् ब्राह्मणो जायत इति । यज्ञेन देवेभ्यः प्रजया पितृभ्यो ब्रह्मचर्येण ऋषिभ्य इत्य् एष वानृणो यज्वा यः पुत्री ब्रह्मचर्यवान् इति ।
text: For it is declared in the Veda, 'A Brāhmaṇa is born, loaded with three debts,' (and further, 'He owes) sacrifices to the gods, a son to the manes, the study of the Veda to the Ri shis; therefore he is free from debt who has offered sacrifices, who has begotten a son, and who has lived as a student (with a teacher).'

sanskrit_iast: garbhāṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇam upanayīta |
meaning: गर्भाष्टमेषु ब्राह्मणम् उपनयीत ।
text: Let him (ordinarily) initiate a Brāhmaṇa in the eighth (year) after conception,

sanskrit_iast: garbhād ekādaśeṣu rājanyam |
meaning: गर्भाद् एकादशेषु राजन्यम् ।
text: A Kshatriya in the eleventh year after conception,

sanskrit_iast: garbhād dvādaśeṣu vaiśyam |
meaning: गर्भाद् द्वादशेषु वैश्यम् ।
text: A Vaiśya in the twelfth year after conception.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśo vā daṇḍo brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: पालाशो वा दण्डो ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: The staff of a Brāhmaṇa (student may) optionally (be made) of Palāśa wood,

sanskrit_iast: naiyyagrodhaḥ kṣatriyasya vā |
meaning: नैय्यग्रोधः क्षत्रियस्य वा ।
text: (That) of a Kshatriya optionally of the wood of the Banyan tree,

sanskrit_iast: audumbaro vā vaiśyasya |
meaning: औदुम्बरो वा वैश्यस्य ।
text: (That) of a Vaiśya optionally of Udumbara wood.

sanskrit_iast: keśasaṃmito brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: केशसंमितो ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: (The staff) of a Brāhmaṇa shall (be of such a length as to) reach the hair,

sanskrit_iast: lalāṭasaṃmitaḥ kṣatriyasya |
meaning: ललाटसंमितः क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: (That) of a Kshatriya the forehead,

sanskrit_iast: ghrāṇasaṃmito vaiśyasya |
meaning: घ्राणसंमितो वैश्यस्य ।
text: (That) of a Vaiśya the (tip of the) nose.

sanskrit_iast: mauñjī raśanā brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: मौञ्जी रशना ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: The girdle of a Brāhmaṇa shall be made of Mu ñ g a grass,

sanskrit_iast: dhanurjyā kṣatriyasya |
meaning: धनुर्ज्या क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: A bowstring (shall be that) of a Kshatriya,

sanskrit_iast: śaṇatāntavī vaiśyasya |
meaning: शणतान्तवी वैश्यस्य ।
text: (That) of a Vaiśya shall be made of hempen threads.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinam uttarīyaṃ brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: कृष्णाजिनम् उत्तरीयं ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: The upper garment of a Brāhmaṇa (shall be) the skin of a black antelope,

sanskrit_iast: rauravaṃ kṣatriyasya |
meaning: रौरवं क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: (That) of a Kshatriya the skin of a spotted deer,

sanskrit_iast: gavyaṃ bastājinaṃ vā vaiśyasya |
meaning: गव्यं बस्ताजिनं वा वैश्यस्य ।
text: (That) of a Vaiśya a cow-skin or the hide of a he-goat.

sanskrit_iast: śuklam ahataṃ vāso brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: शुक्लम् अहतं वासो ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: The (lower) garment of a Brāhmaṇa (shall be) white (and) unblemished,

sanskrit_iast: māñjiṣṭhaṃ kṣatriyasya |
meaning: माञ्जिष्ठं क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: (That) of a Kshatriya dyed with madder,

sanskrit_iast: hāridraṃ kauśeyaṃ vā vaiśyasya |
meaning: हारिद्रं कौशेयं वा वैश्यस्य ।
text: (That) of a Vaiśya dyed with turmeric, or made of (raw) silk;

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ vā tāntavam araktam |
meaning: सर्वेषां वा तान्तवम् अरक्तम् ।
text: Or (a dress made of) undyed (cotton) cloth may be worn by (students of) all (castes).

sanskrit_iast: bhavatpūrvāṃ brāhmaṇo bhikṣāṃ yācet |
meaning: भवत्पूर्वां ब्राह्मणो भिक्षां याचेत् ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa shall ask for alms placing (the word) 'Lady' first,

sanskrit_iast: bhavanmadhyāṃ rājanyaḥ |
meaning: भवन्मध्यां राजन्यः ।
text: A Kshatriya placing (the word)' Lady' in the middle,

sanskrit_iast: bhavadantyāṃ vaiśyaḥ |
meaning: भवदन्त्यां वैश्यः ।
text: A Vaiśya placing (the word) Lady' at the end (of the formula).

sanskrit_iast: ā ṣoḍaśād brāhmaṇasya nātītaḥ kālaḥ |
meaning: आ षोडशाद् ब्राह्मणस्य नातीतः कालः ।
text: The time (for the initiation) of a Brāhmaṇa has not passed until the completion of the sixteenth year,

sanskrit_iast: ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatriyasya |
meaning: आ द्वाविंशात् क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: (For that) of a Kshatriya until the completion of the twenty-second,

sanskrit_iast: ā caturviṃśād vaiśyasya |
meaning: आ चतुर्विंशाद् वैश्यस्य ।
text: (For that) of a Vaiśya until the completion of the twenty-fourth.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ patitasāvitrīkā bhavanti |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं पतितसावित्रीका भवन्ति ।
text: After that they become 'men whose Sāvitrī has been neglected.'

sanskrit_iast: naitān upanayen nādhyāpayen na yājayen naibhir vivāhayeyuḥ |
meaning: नैतान् उपनयेन् नाध्यापयेन् न याजयेन् नैभिर् विवाहयेयुः ।
text: Let him not initiate such men, nor teach them, nor sacrifice for them; let them not form matrimonial alliances (with such outcasts).

sanskrit_iast: patitasāvitrīka uddālakavrataṃ caret |
meaning: पतितसावित्रीक उद्दालकव्रतं चरेत् ।
text: A man whose Sāvitrī has not been performed, may undergo the Uddālaka-penance.

sanskrit_iast: dvau māsau yāvakena vartayen māsaṃ payasārdhamāsam āmikṣayāṣṭarātraṃ ghṛtena ṣaḍrātram ayācitena trirātram abbhakṣo 'hā rātram upavaset |
meaning: द्वौ मासौ यावकेन वर्तयेन् मासं पयसार्धमासम् आमिक्षयाष्टरात्रं घृतेन षड्रात्रम् अयाचितेन त्रिरात्रम् अब्भक्षो ऽहा रात्रम् उपवसेत् ।
text: Let him subsist during two months on barley-gruel, during one month on milk, during half a month on curds of two-milk whey, during eight days on clarified butter, during six days on alms given without asking, (and) during three days on water, and let him fast for one day and one night.

sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhāvabhṛthaṃ gacchet |
meaning: अश्वमेधावभृथं गच्छेत् ।
text: (Or) he may go to bathe (with the priests) at the end of an Aśvamedha (horse-sacrifice).

sanskrit_iast: vrātyastomena vā yajed vā yajed veti |
meaning: व्रात्यस्तोमेन वा यजेद् वा यजेद् वेति ।
text: Or he may offer a Vrātya-stoma.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ snātakavratāni |
meaning: अथातः स्नातकव्रतानि ।
text: Now, therefore, the duties of a Snātaka (will be explained).

sanskrit_iast: sa na kamcid yācetānyatra rājāntevāsibhyaḥ |
meaning: स न कम्चिद् याचेतान्यत्र राजान्तेवासिभ्यः ।
text: Let him not beg from anybody except from a king and a pupil.

sanskrit_iast: kṣudhāparītas tu kimcid eva yāceta kṛtam akṛtaṃ vā kṣetraṃ gām ajāvikam antato hiraṇyaṃ dhānyam annaṃ vā |
meaning: क्षुधापरीतस् तु किम्चिद् एव याचेत कृतम् अकृतं वा क्षेत्रं गाम् अजाविकम् अन्ततो हिरण्यं धान्यम् अन्नं वा ।
text: But let him ask, if pressed by hunger, for some (small gift) only, a cultivated or uncultivated field, a cow, a goat or a sheep, (or) at the last extremity, for gold, grain or food.

sanskrit_iast: na tu snātakaḥ kṣudhāvasīded ity upadeśaḥ |
meaning: न तु स्नातकः क्षुधावसीदेद् इत्य् उपदेशः ।
text: But the injunction (given by those who know the law) is, 'A Snātaka shall not be faint with hunger.'

sanskrit_iast: na malinavāsasā saha saṃvaseta |
meaning: न मलिनवाससा सह संवसेत ।
text: Let him not dwell together with a person whose clothes are foul;

sanskrit_iast: na rajasvalayā |
meaning: न रजस्वलया ।
text: (Let him not cohabit) with a woman during her courses,

sanskrit_iast: nāyogyayā |
meaning: नायोग्यया ।
text: Nor with an unfit one.

sanskrit_iast: na kulaṃkulaḥ syāt |
meaning: न कुलंकुलः स्यात् ।
text: Let him not be a stay-at-home.

sanskrit_iast: vatsatantrīṃ vitatāṃ nātikrāmet |
meaning: वत्सतन्त्रीं विततां नातिक्रामेत् ।
text: Let him not step over a stretched rope to which a calf (or cow) is tied.

sanskrit_iast: nodyantam ādityaṃ paśyen nāstaṃ yantam |
meaning: नोद्यन्तम् आदित्यं पश्येन् नास्तं यन्तम् ।
text: Let him not look at the sun when he rises or sets.

sanskrit_iast: nāpsu mūtrapurīṣe kuryāt |
meaning: नाप्सु मूत्रपुरीषे कुर्यात् ।
text: Let him not void excrements or urine in water,

sanskrit_iast: na niṣṭhīvet |
meaning: न निष्ठीवेत् ।
text: Nor spit into it.

sanskrit_iast: pariveṣṭitaśirā bhūmim ayajñiyais tṛṇair antardhāya mutrapurīṣe kuryād udaṅmukhaś cāhani naktaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ sandhyām āsītottaram |
meaning: परिवेष्टितशिरा भूमिम् अयज्ञियैस् तृणैर् अन्तर्धाय मुत्रपुरीषे कुर्याद् उदङ्मुखश् चाहनि नक्तं दक्षिणामुखः सन्ध्याम् आसीतोत्तरम् ।
text: Let him ease himself, after wrapping up his head and covering the ground with grass that is not fit to be used at a sacrifice, and turning towards the north in the day-time, turning towards the south at night, sitting with his face towards the north in the twilight.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | snātakānāṃ tu nityaṃ syād antarvāsas tathottaram | yajñopavīte dve yaṣṭiḥ sodakaś ca kamaṇḍaluḥ |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । स्नातकानां तु नित्यं स्याद् अन्तर्वासस् तथोत्तरम् । यज्ञोपवीते द्वे यष्टिः सोदकश् च कमण्डलुः ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'But Snātakas shall always wear a lower garment and an upper one, two sacrificial threads, (shall carry) a staff and a vessel filled with water.'

sanskrit_iast: apsu pāṇau ca kāṣṭhe ca kathitaṃ pāvake śuciḥ | tasmād udakapāṇibhyāṃ parimṛjyāt kamaṇḍalum |
meaning: अप्सु पाणौ च काष्ठे च कथितं पावके शुचिः । तस्माद् उदकपाणिभ्यां परिमृज्यात् कमण्डलुम् ।
text: 'It is declared, that (a vessel becomes) pure (if cleaned) with water, or with the hand, or with a stick, or with fire: Therefore he shall clean (his) vessel with water and with his (right) hand.'

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikaraṇaṃ hy etan manur āha prajāpatiḥ |
meaning: पर्यग्निकरणं ह्य् एतन् मनुर् आह प्रजापतिः ।
text: 'For Manu, the lord of created beings, calls (this mode of cleaning) encircling it-with fire.'

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā cāvaśyakarmāṇi ācāmec chaucavittama iti |
meaning: कृत्वा चावश्यकर्माणि आचामेच् छौचवित्तम इति ।
text: He who is perfectly acquainted with (the rules of) purification shall sip water (out of this vessel), after he has relieved the necessities of nature.'

sanskrit_iast: prāṅmukho 'nnāni bhuñjīta |
meaning: प्राङ्मुखो ऽन्नानि भुञ्जीत ।
text: Let him eat his food facing the east.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ sāṅguṣṭhaṃ kṛtsnagrāsaṃ graseta |
meaning: तूष्णीं साङ्गुष्ठं कृत्स्नग्रासं ग्रसेत ।
text: Silently let him swallow the entire mouthful, (introducing it into the mouth) with the four fingers and with the thumb;

sanskrit_iast: na ca śabdaṃ kuryāt |
meaning: न च शब्दं कुर्यात् ।
text: And let him not make a noise (while eating).

sanskrit_iast: ṛtukālagāmī syāt parvavarjaṃ svadāreṣu |
meaning: ऋतुकालगामी स्यात् पर्ववर्जं स्वदारेषु ।
text: Let him approach his wife in the proper season, except on the Parva days.

sanskrit_iast: atiryag upeyāt |
meaning: अतिर्यग् उपेयात् ।
text: Let him not commit a crime against nature (with her).

sanskrit_iast: yas tu pāṇigṛhītāyā āsye kurvīta maithunam | bhavanti pitaras tasya tanmāsaṃ retaso bhujaḥ | yā syād anityacāreṇa ratiḥ sādharmasaṃśritā |
meaning: यस् तु पाणिगृहीताया आस्ये कुर्वीत मैथुनम् । भवन्ति पितरस् तस्य तन्मासं रेतसो भुजः । या स्याद् अनित्यचारेण रतिः साधर्मसंश्रिता ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The ancestors of a man-who commits an unnatural crime with a wedded wife, feed during that month on his semen. All unnatural intercourse is against the sacred law.'

sanskrit_iast: api ca kāṭhake vijñāyate | api naḥ śvo vijaniṣyamāṇāḥ patibhiḥ saha śayīrann iti strīṇām indradatto vara iti |
meaning: अपि च काठके विज्ञायते । अपि नः श्वो विजनिष्यमाणाः पतिभिः सह शयीरन्न् इति स्त्रीणाम् इन्द्रदत्तो वर इति ।
text: It is also declared in the Kā th aka, '(When) the women (asked) Indra, "May even those among us, who are soon to be mothers, (be allowed to) cohabit with their husbands," he granted that wish.'

sanskrit_iast: na vṛkṣam ārohet |
meaning: न वृक्षम् आरोहेत् ।
text: Let him not ascend a tree.

sanskrit_iast: na kūpam avarohet |
meaning: न कूपम् अवरोहेत् ।
text: Let him not descend into a well.

sanskrit_iast: nāgniṃ mukhenopadhamet |
meaning: नाग्निं मुखेनोपधमेत् ।
text: Let him not blow the fire with his mouth.

sanskrit_iast: nāgniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāntareṇa vyapeyāt |
meaning: नाग्निं ब्राह्मणं चान्तरेण व्यपेयात् ।
text: Let him not pass between a fire and a Brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast: nāgnyoḥ |
meaning: नाग्न्योः ।
text: Nor between two fires;

sanskrit_iast: na brāhmaṇayor anujñāpya vā |
meaning: न ब्राह्मणयोर् अनुज्ञाप्य वा ।
text: Nor between two Brāhmaṇas; or (he may do it) after having asked for permission.

sanskrit_iast: bhāryayā saha nāśnīyād avīryavad apatyaṃ bhavatīti vājasaneyake vijñāyate |
meaning: भार्यया सह नाश्नीयाद् अवीर्यवद् अपत्यं भवतीति वाजसनेयके विज्ञायते ।
text: Let him not dine together with his wife. For it is declared in the Vā g asaneyaka, His children will be destitute of manly vigour.'

sanskrit_iast: nendradhanurnāmnā nirdiśet |
meaning: नेन्द्रधनुर्नाम्ना निर्दिशेत् ।
text: Let him not point out (a rainbow calling it) by (its proper) name, 'Indra's bow.'

sanskrit_iast: maṇidhanuriti brūyāt |
meaning: मणिधनुरिति ब्रूयात् ।
text: Let him call it 'the jewelled bow' (maṇidhanu h ).

sanskrit_iast: pālāśam āsanaṃ pāduke dantadhāvanam iti varjayet |
meaning: पालाशम् आसनं पादुके दन्तधावनम् इति वर्जयेत् ।
text: Let him avoid seats, clogs, sticks for cleaning the teeth, (and other implements) made of Palāśa wood.

sanskrit_iast: notsaṅge bhakṣayet |
meaning: नोत्सङ्गे भक्षयेत् ।
text: Let him not eat (food placed) in his lap.

sanskrit_iast: nāsandyāṃ bhuñjīta |
meaning: नासन्द्यां भुञ्जीत ।
text: Let him not eat (food placed) on a chair.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārayet |
meaning: वैणवं दण्डं धारयेत् ।
text: Let him carry a staff of bamboo,

sanskrit_iast: rukmakuṇḍale ca |
meaning: रुक्मकुण्डले च ।
text: And (wear) two golden earrings.

sanskrit_iast: na bahir mālāṃ dhārayed anyatra rukmamayyā |
meaning: न बहिर् मालां धारयेद् अन्यत्र रुक्ममय्या ।
text: Let him not wear any visible wreath excepting a golden one;

sanskrit_iast: sabhāḥ samavāyāṃś ca varjayet |
meaning: सभाः समवायांश् च वर्जयेत् ।
text: And let him disdain assemblies and crowds.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aprāmāṇyaṃ ca vedānām ārṣāṇāṃ caiva kutsanam | avyavasthā ca sarvatra etan nāśanam ātmana iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अप्रामाण्यं च वेदानाम् आर्षाणां चैव कुत्सनम् । अव्यवस्था च सर्वत्र एतन् नाशनम् आत्मन इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'To deny the authority of the Vedas, to carp at the teaching of the Ri shis, to waver with respect to any (matter of duty), that is to destroy one's soul.'

sanskrit_iast: nāvṛto yajñaṃ gacched yadi vrajet pradakṣiṇaṃ punar āvrajet |
meaning: नावृतो यज्ञं गच्छेद् यदि व्रजेत् प्रदक्षिणं पुनर् आव्रजेत् ।
text: Let him not go to a sacrifice except if he is chosen (to be an officiating priest. But) if he goes,. he must, on returning home, turn his right hand (towards the place).

sanskrit_iast: adhivṛkṣasūryam adhvānaṃ na pratipadyeta |
meaning: अधिवृक्षसूर्यम् अध्वानं न प्रतिपद्येत ।
text: Let him not set out on a journey when the sun stands over the trees.

sanskrit_iast: nāvaṃ ca sāṃśayikīṃ nādhirohet |
meaning: नावं च सांशयिकीं नाधिरोहेत् ।
text: Let him not ascend an unsafe boat, or (any unsafe conveyance).

sanskrit_iast: bāhubhyāṃ na nadīṃ taret |
meaning: बाहुभ्यां न नदीं तरेत् ।
text: Let him not cross a river, swimming.

sanskrit_iast: utthāyāpararātram adhītya na punaḥ pratisaṃviśet |
meaning: उत्थायापररात्रम् अधीत्य न पुनः प्रतिसंविशेत् ।
text: When he has risen in the last watch (of the night) and has recited (the Veda) he shall not lie down again.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatye muhūrte brāhmaṇaḥ kāṃścin niyamān anutiṣṭhed anutiṣṭhed iti |
meaning: प्राजापत्ये मुहूर्ते ब्राह्मणः कांश्चिन् नियमान् अनुतिष्ठेद् अनुतिष्ठेद् इति ।
text: In the Muhūrta sacred to Pra g āpati a Brāhmaṇa shall fulfil some sacred duties.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ svādhyāyopākarma śrāvaṇyām paurṇamāsyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vā |
meaning: अथातः स्वाध्यायोपाकर्म श्रावण्याम् पौर्णमास्यां प्रौष्ठपद्यां वा ।
text: Now, therefore, the Upākarman (or the rite preparatory to the study) of the Veda (must be performed) on the full moon day of the month Śrāvaṇa or Praush th apada.

sanskrit_iast: agnim upasamādhāyākṣatadhānā juhoti |
meaning: अग्निम् उपसमाधायाक्षतधाना जुहोति ।
text: Having kindled the sacred fire, he offers (therein) unground (rice) grains,

sanskrit_iast: devebhya ṛṣibhyaś chandobhyaś ceti |
meaning: देवेभ्य ऋषिभ्यश् छन्दोभ्यश् चेति ।
text: To the gods, to the Ri shis, and to the Khaṇd as.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān svastivācya dadhi prāśya tato 'dhyāyān upākurvīran |
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्तिवाच्य दधि प्राश्य ततो ऽध्यायान् उपाकुर्वीरन् ।
text: Let them begin to study the Vedas, after having made Brāhmaṇas (invited for the purpose) wish 'welfare' (svasti), and after having fed them with sour milk,

sanskrit_iast: ardhapañcamān māsān ardhaṣaṣṭhān vā |
meaning: अर्धपञ्चमान् मासान् अर्धषष्ठान् वा ।
text: (And continue the Veda-study) during four months and a half or during five months and a half.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ śuklapakṣeṣv adhīyīta |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं शुक्लपक्षेष्व् अधीयीत ।
text: After (the expiration of) that (period), he may study (the Vedas) during the bright half of each month,

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ tu vedāṅgāni |
meaning: कामं तु वेदाङ्गानि ।
text: But the supplementary treatises (Aṅgas) of the Veda at pleasure (both during the bright and the dark halves of each month).

sanskrit_iast: tasyānadhyāyāḥ |
meaning: तस्यानध्यायाः ।
text: Interruptions of the (Veda-study shall take place),

sanskrit_iast: sandhyāstanite |
meaning: सन्ध्यास्तनिते ।
text: If it thunders during the twilight,

sanskrit_iast: sandhyāsu |
meaning: सन्ध्यासु ।
text: During (both) the twilights (of each day),

sanskrit_iast: antaḥśavadivākīrtyeṣu nagareṣu |
meaning: अन्तःशवदिवाकीर्त्येषु नगरेषु ।
text: In towns where a corpse (lies) or K āṇd ālas (stay).

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ gomayaparyuṣite parilikhite vā |
meaning: कामं गोमयपर्युषिते परिलिखिते वा ।
text: At pleasure (he may study seated) in (a place) which has been smeared with cowdung and around which a line has been drawn.

sanskrit_iast: śmaśānānte |
meaning: श्मशानान्ते ।
text: (Let him not study) near a burial-ground,

sanskrit_iast: śayānasya |
meaning: शयानस्य ।
text: (Nor) lying down,

sanskrit_iast: śrāddhikasya |
meaning: श्राद्धिकस्य ।
text: Nor when he has eaten or received a gift at a funeral sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast: mānavaṃ cātra ślokam udāharanti | phalāny apas tilān bhakṣān yac cānyac chrāddhikaṃ bhavet | pratigṛhyāpy anadhyāyaḥ pāṇyāsyā brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtā iti |
meaning: मानवं चात्र श्लोकम् उदाहरन्ति । फलान्य् अपस् तिलान् भक्षान् यच् चान्यच् छ्राद्धिकं भवेत् । प्रतिगृह्याप्य् अनध्यायः पाण्यास्या ब्राह्मणाः स्मृता इति ।
text: And with reference to this (subject) they quote a verse of Manu, 'Be it fruit, or water, or sesamum, or food, or whatever be the (gift) at a Śrāddha, let him not, having just accepted it, recite the Veda; for it is declared in the Sm ri ti, that the hand of a Brāhmaṇa is his mouth.'

sanskrit_iast: dhāvataḥ pūtigandhaprabhṛtāv īriṇe |
meaning: धावतः पूतिगन्धप्रभृताव् ईरिणे ।
text: (Let him not recite the Veda) while he runs, (nor) while a foul smell and the like (are perceptible, nor) on barren ground,

sanskrit_iast: vṛkṣārūḍhasya |
meaning: वृक्षारूढस्य ।
text: (Nor) when he has ascended a tree,

sanskrit_iast: nāvi senāyāṃ ca |
meaning: नावि सेनायां च ।
text: (Nor) in a boat or in a camp,

sanskrit_iast: bhuktvā cārdrapāṇeḥ |
meaning: भुक्त्वा चार्द्रपाणेः ।
text: Nor after meals while his hands are moist,

sanskrit_iast: vāṇaśabde |
meaning: वाणशब्दे ।
text: (Nor) while the sound of a Vāṇa (is heard),

sanskrit_iast: caturdaśyām āmāvāsyāyām aṣṭamyām aṣṭakāsu |
meaning: चतुर्दश्याम् आमावास्यायाम् अष्टम्याम् अष्टकासु ।
text: (Nor) on the fourteenth day (of each half-month, nor) on the new moon day, (nor) on the eighth day (of each half-month, nor) on an Ashṭakā,

sanskrit_iast: prasāritapādopasthakṛtopāśritasya ca |
meaning: प्रसारितपादोपस्थकृतोपाश्रितस्य च ।
text: (Nor) while he stretches his feet out, (nor) while he makes a lap, (nor) while he leans against (something), nor (in any other unbecoming posture),

sanskrit_iast: gurusamīpe |
meaning: गुरुसमीपे ।
text: (Nor) close to his Gurus,

sanskrit_iast: maithunavyapetāyām |
meaning: मैथुनव्यपेतायाम् ।
text: (Nor) during that night in which he has had conjugal intercourse,

sanskrit_iast: vāsasā maithunavyapetenānirṇiktena |
meaning: वाससा मैथुनव्यपेतेनानिर्णिक्तेन ।
text: (Nor) dressed in that garment which he had on during conjugal intercourse, except if it has been washed,

sanskrit_iast: grāmānte |
meaning: ग्रामान्ते ।
text: (Nor) at the extremity of a village,

sanskrit_iast: charditasya |
meaning: छर्दितस्य ।
text: (Nor) after (an attack of) vomiting,

sanskrit_iast: mūtritasyoccāritasya |
meaning: मूत्रितस्योच्चारितस्य ।
text: (Nor) while voiding urine or fæces.

sanskrit_iast: ṛcyajuṣāṃ ca sāmaśabde vā |
meaning: ऋच्यजुषां च सामशब्दे वा ।

sanskrit_iast: ajīrṇe |
meaning: अजीर्णे ।

sanskrit_iast: nirghāte |
meaning: निर्घाते ।

sanskrit_iast: bhūmicalane |
meaning: भूमिचलने ।

sanskrit_iast: candrasūryoparāge |
meaning: चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे ।

sanskrit_iast: diśnādaparvataprapāteṣūpalarudhirapāṃsuvarṣeṣv ākālikam |
meaning: दिश्नादपर्वतप्रपातेषूपलरुधिरपांसुवर्षेष्व् आकालिकम् ।

sanskrit_iast: ulkāvidyutsamāse trirātram |
meaning: उल्काविद्युत्समासे त्रिरात्रम् ।

sanskrit_iast: ulkāvidyut sajyotiṣam |
meaning: उल्काविद्युत् सज्योतिषम् ।

sanskrit_iast: apartāv ākālikam |
meaning: अपर्ताव् आकालिकम् ।

sanskrit_iast: ācārye prete trirātram |
meaning: आचार्ये प्रेते त्रिरात्रम् ।

sanskrit_iast: ācāryaputraśiṣyabhāryāsv ahā rātram |
meaning: आचार्यपुत्रशिष्यभार्यास्व् अहा रात्रम् ।
text: If the teacher's son, a pupil, or a wife (have died, he shall not study) during a day and a night.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijśvaśurapitṛvyamātulān anavaravayasaḥ pratyutthāyābhivadet |
meaning: ऋत्विज्श्वशुरपितृव्यमातुलान् अनवरवयसः प्रत्युत्थायाभिवदेत् ।
text: Let him honour an officiating priest, a father-in-law, paternal and maternal uncles, (though they may be) younger than himself, by rising and saluting them,

sanskrit_iast: ye caiva pādagrāhyās teṣāṃ bhāryā guroś ca |
meaning: ये चैव पादग्राह्यास् तेषां भार्या गुरोश् च ।
text: Likewise the wives of those persons whose feet must be embraced, and the teacher's (wives)

sanskrit_iast: mātāpitarau ca |
meaning: मातापितरौ च ।
text: And his parents.

sanskrit_iast: yo vidyād abhivaditum aham ayaṃ bho iti yāt |
meaning: यो विद्याद् अभिवदितुम् अहम् अयं भो इति यात् ।
text: Let him say to one acquainted with (the meaning of) a salute, 'I N. N. ho! (salute thee);'

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca na vidyāt |
meaning: यश् च न विद्यात् ।
text: But him who does not know it (he shall address with the same formula, omitting his name).

sanskrit_iast: pratyabhivādam āmantrite svaro 'ntyaḥ plavate sandhyakṣaram apragṛhyam āyāvabhāvaṃ cāpadyate yathā bho bhāv iti |
meaning: प्रत्यभिवादम् आमन्त्रिते स्वरो ऽन्त्यः प्लवते सन्ध्यक्षरम् अप्रगृह्यम् आयावभावं चापद्यते यथा भो भाव् इति ।
text: When a salute is returned, the last vowel (of the noun standing) in the vocative is produced to the length of three moras, and if it is a diphthong (e or o) changeable according to the Sandhi rules, it becomes āy or āv, e.g. bho, bhāv.

sanskrit_iast: patitaḥ pitā parityājyo mātā tu putre na patati |
meaning: पतितः पिता परित्याज्यो माता तु पुत्रे न पतति ।
text: A father who has committed a crime causing loss of caste must be cast off. But a mother does not become an outcast for her son.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | upādhyāyād daśācāryā ācāryāṇāṃ śataṃ pitā | pitur daśaśataṃ mātā gauraveṇātiricyate |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । उपाध्यायाद् दशाचार्या आचार्याणां शतं पिता । पितुर् दशशतं माता गौरवेणातिरिच्यते ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): [paragraph continues] 'The teacher (ā k ārya) is ten times more venerable than a sub-teacher (upādhyāya), the father a hundred times more than the teacher, and the mother a thousand times more than the father.'

sanskrit_iast: bhāryā putrāś ca śiṣyāś ca saṃsṛṣṭāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ | paribhāṣya parityājyāḥ patito yo 'nyathā tyajet |
meaning: भार्या पुत्राश् च शिष्याश् च संसृष्टाः पापकर्मभिः । परिभाष्य परित्याज्याः पतितो यो ऽन्यथा त्यजेत् ।
text: 'A wife, sons, and pupils who are defiled by sinful deeds, must first be reproved, and (if they do not amend, then) be cast off. He who forsakes them in any other way, becomes (himself) an outcast.'

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijācāryāv ayājakānadhyāpakau heyāv anyatra hānāt patati |
meaning: ऋत्विजाचार्याव् अयाजकानध्यापकौ हेयाव् अन्यत्र हानात् पतति ।
text: An officiating priest and a teacher who neglect to teach the recitation of the Veda, or to sacrifice, shall be cast off. If he does not forsake them, he becomes an outcast.

sanskrit_iast: patitenotpannaḥ patito bhavatīty āhur anyatra striyāḥ |
meaning: पतितेनोत्पन्नः पतितो भवतीत्य् आहुर् अन्यत्र स्त्रियाः ।
text: They declare that the male offspring of outcasts are (also) outcasts, but not the females.

sanskrit_iast: sā hi paragāminī |
meaning: सा हि परगामिनी ।
text: For a female enters (the family of) a stranger.

sanskrit_iast: tām arikthām upeyāt |
meaning: ताम् अरिक्थाम् उपेयात् ।
text: He may marry such a (female) without a dowry.

sanskrit_iast: guror gurau sannihite guruvadvṛttir iṣyate | guruvad guruputrasya vartitavyam iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: गुरोर् गुरौ सन्निहिते गुरुवद्वृत्तिर् इष्यते । गुरुवद् गुरुपुत्रस्य वर्तितव्यम् इति श्रुतिः ।
text: 'If the teacher's teacher is near, he must be treated like the teacher (himself). The Veda declares that one must behave towards the teacher's son just as towards the teacher.'

sanskrit_iast: śastraṃ viṣaṃ surā cāpratigṛhyāṇi brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: शस्त्रं विषं सुरा चाप्रतिगृह्याणि ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa shall not accept (as gifts) weapons, poison, and spirituous liquor.

sanskrit_iast: vidyāvittavayaḥsaṃbandhāḥ karma ca mānyam |
meaning: विद्यावित्तवयःसंबन्धाः कर्म च मान्यम् ।
text: Learning, wealth, age, relationship, and occupation must be honoured.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaḥ pūrvo garīyān |
meaning: पूर्वः पूर्वो गरीयान् ।
text: (But) each earlier named (quality) is more venerable than (the succeeding ones).

sanskrit_iast: sthavirabālāturabhārikastrīcakrīvagatāṃ panthāḥ samāgame parasmaiparasmai deyaḥ |
meaning: स्थविरबालातुरभारिकस्त्रीचक्रीवगतां पन्थाः समागमे परस्मैपरस्मै देयः ।
text: If he meets aged men, infants, sick men, load-carriers, women, and persons riding in chariots, he must make way (for them, i.e.) for each later (named before those enumerated earlier).

sanskrit_iast: rājasnātakayoḥ samāgame rājñā snātakāya deyaḥ |
meaning: राजस्नातकयोः समागमे राज्ञा स्नातकाय देयः ।
text: If a king and a Snātaka meet, the king must make (way) for the Snātaka.

sanskrit_iast: sarvair eva vadhvā ūhyamānāyai |
meaning: सर्वैर् एव वध्वा ऊह्यमानायै ।
text: All (must make way) for a bride who is being conveyed (to her husband's house).

sanskrit_iast: tṛṇabhūmyagnyudakavācsūnṛtānasūyāḥ satāṃ gṛhe nocchidyante kadācana kadācaneti |
meaning: तृणभूम्यग्न्युदकवाच्सूनृतानसूयाः सतां गृहे नोच्छिद्यन्ते कदाचन कदाचनेति ।
text: Grass, room (for resting), fire, water, a welcome, and kind words never fail in the houses of good men.

sanskrit_iast: athāto bhojyābhojyaṃ ca varṇayiṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथातो भोज्याभोज्यं च वर्णयिष्यामः ।
text: Now, therefore, we will declare what may be eaten and what may not be eaten.

sanskrit_iast: cikitsakamṛgayupuṃścalīdaṇḍikastenābhiśastaṣaṇḍhapatitānām annam abhojyam |
meaning: चिकित्सकमृगयुपुंश्चलीदण्डिकस्तेनाभिशस्तषण्ढपतितानाम् अन्नम् अभोज्यम् ।
text: Food given by a physician, a hunter, a woman of bad character, a mace-bearer, a thief, an Abhiśasta, a eunuch, (or) an outcast must not be eaten,

sanskrit_iast: kadaryadīkṣitabaddhāturasomavikrayitakṣarajakaśauṇḍikasūcakavārdhuṣikacarmāvakṛntānām |
meaning: कदर्यदीक्षितबद्धातुरसोमविक्रयितक्षरजकशौण्डिकसूचकवार्धुषिकचर्मावकृन्तानाम् ।
text: (Nor that given) by a miser, one who has performed the initiatory ceremony of a Śrauta-sacrifice, a prisoner, a sick person, a seller of the Soma-plant, a carpenter, a washerman, a dealer in spirituous liquor, a spy, a usurer, (or) a cobbler,

sanskrit_iast: śūdrasya ca |
meaning: शूद्रस्य च ।
text: Nor (that given) by a Śūdra,

sanskrit_iast: astrabhṛtaś ca |
meaning: अस्त्रभृतश् च ।
text: Nor (that given) by one who lives by his weapons,

sanskrit_iast: upapater yaś copapatiṃ manyate |
meaning: उपपतेर् यश् चोपपतिं मन्यते ।
text: Nor (that given) by the (kept) paramour of a married woman, or by a husband who allows a paramour (to his wife),

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca gṛhān dahet |
meaning: यश् च गृहान् दहेत् ।
text: Nor (that given) by an incendiary,

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca vadhārhān nopahanyāt |
meaning: यश् च वधार्हान् नोपहन्यात् ।
text: Nor (that given) by (a ruler) who does not slay those worthy of capital punishment,

sanskrit_iast: ko bhokṣyata iti vācābhighuṣṭam |
meaning: को भोक्ष्यत इति वाचाभिघुष्टम् ।
text: Nor (food) offered publicly with these words, 'Who is willing to eat?'

sanskrit_iast: gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ceti |
meaning: गणान्नं गणिकान्नं चेति ।
text: Nor food given by a multitude of givers, or by harlots, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | nāśnanti śvavato devā nāśnanti vṛṣalīpateḥ | bhāryājitasya nāśnanti yasya copapatir gṛha iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । नाश्नन्ति श्ववतो देवा नाश्नन्ति वृषलीपतेः । भार्याजितस्य नाश्नन्ति यस्य चोपपतिर् गृह इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The gods do not eat (the offerings) of a man who keeps dogs, nor of him whose (only) wife is of the Śūdra caste, nor of him who lives in subjection to his wife, nor of (a husband) who (permits) a paramour (of his wife to reside) in his house.'

sanskrit_iast: edhodakayavasakuśalājābhyudyatayānāvasathaśapharīpriyaṅgusrajgandhamadhumāṃsānīty eteṣāṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: एधोदकयवसकुशलाजाभ्युद्यतयानावसथशफरीप्रियङ्गुस्रज्गन्धमधुमांसानीत्य् एतेषां प्रतिगृह्णीयात् ।
text: He may accept (the following presents even) from such (people, viz.) firewood, water, fodder, Kuśa grass, parched grain, (food) given without asking, a vehicle, (shelter in) the house, small fish, millet, a garland, perfumes, honey, and meat.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | gurvarthaṃ dāram ujjihīrṣann arciṣyan devatātithīn | sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyān na tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tata iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । गुर्वर्थं दारम् उज्जिहीर्षन्न् अर्चिष्यन् देवतातिथीन् । सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयान् न तु तृप्येत् स्वयं तत इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'For the sake of a Guru, when he desires to save his wife (and family from starvation), when he wishes to honour the gods or guests, he may accept (presents) from anybody; but let him not satisfy his (own hunger) with such (gifts).'

sanskrit_iast: na mṛgayor iṣucāriṇaḥ parivarjyam annam |
meaning: न मृगयोर् इषुचारिणः परिवर्ज्यम् अन्नम् ।
text: Food given by a hunter who uses the bow must not be rejected.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate hi | agastyo varṣasāhasrike satre mṛgayāṃ cacāra | tasyāsaṃstarasamayāḥ puroḍāśā mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ praśastānām |
meaning: विज्ञायते हि । अगस्त्यो वर्षसाहस्रिके सत्रे मृगयां चचार । तस्यासंस्तरसमयाः पुरोडाशा मृगपक्षिणां प्रशस्तानाम् ।
text: For it is declared in the Veda, 'At a sacrificial session (sattra), which lasted one thousand years, Agastya went out to hunt. He had sacrificial cakes prepared with the meat of beasts and fowls good (to eat).'

sanskrit_iast: api hy atra prājāpatyāñ ślokān udāharanti | udyatām āhṛtāṃ bhikṣāṃ purastād apracoditām | bhojyāṃ prajāpatir mene api duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ |
meaning: अपि ह्य् अत्र प्राजापत्याञ् श्लोकान् उदाहरन्ति । उद्यताम् आहृतां भिक्षां पुरस्ताद् अप्रचोदिताम् । भोज्यां प्रजापतिर् मेने अपि दुष्कृतकारिणः ।
text: With reference to this (subject) they quote also some verses proclaimed by Pra g āpati, 'Pra g āpati (the Lord of created beings) has declared that food freely offered and brought (by the giver himself) may be eaten, though (the giver) be a sinful man, provided the gift has not been asked for beforehand.'

sanskrit_iast: śraddadhānasya bhoktavyaṃ corasyāpi viśeṣataḥ | na tv eva bahuyājyasya yaś copanayate bahūn |
meaning: श्रद्दधानस्य भोक्तव्यं चोरस्यापि विशेषतः । न त्व् एव बहुयाज्यस्य यश् चोपनयते बहून् ।
text: Food offered by a man who has faith must certainly be eaten, even though (the giver) be a thief, but not that given by (a Brāhmaṇa) who sacrifices for many and who initiates many.'

sanskrit_iast: na tasya pitaro 'śnanti daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca | na ca havyaṃ vahaty agnir yas tām abhyavamanyate |
meaning: न तस्य पितरो ऽश्नन्ति दश वर्षाणि पञ्च च । न च हव्यं वहत्य् अग्निर् यस् ताम् अभ्यवमन्यते ।
text: 'The manes do not eat during fifteen years (the food) of that man who disdains a (freely offered gift), nor does the fire carry his offerings (to the gods).'

sanskrit_iast: cikitsakasya mṛgayoḥ śalyahartus tu pāpinaḥ | ṣaṇḍhasya kulaṭāyāś ca udyatāpi na gṛhyata iti |
meaning: चिकित्सकस्य मृगयोः शल्यहर्तुस् तु पापिनः । षण्ढस्य कुलटायाश् च उद्यतापि न गृह्यत इति ।
text: 'But alms, though offered without asking, must not be accepted from a physician, from a hunter, from a surgeon or a (very) wicked man, from a eunuch, and from a faithless wife.'

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭam aguror abhojyam |
meaning: उच्छिष्टम् अगुरोर् अभोज्यम् ।
text: Fragments of food left by other persons than the teacher must not be eaten,

sanskrit_iast: svam ucchiṣṭam ucchiṣṭopahataṃ ca |
meaning: स्वम् उच्छिष्टम् उच्छिष्टोपहतं च ।
text: Nor remnants of one's own (meal) and food touched by leavings,

sanskrit_iast: yad vasanakeśakīṭopahataṃ ca |
meaning: यद् वसनकेशकीटोपहतं च ।
text: Nor (food) defiled by contact with a garment, hair, or insects.

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ tu keśakīṭān uddhṛtyādbhiḥ prokṣya bhasmanāvakīrya vācā praśastam upayuñjīta |
meaning: कामं तु केशकीटान् उद्धृत्याद्भिः प्रोक्ष्य भस्मनावकीर्य वाचा प्रशस्तम् उपयुञ्जीत ।
text: But at pleasure he may use (such food) after taking out the hair and the insects, sprinkling it with water, dropping ashes on it, and (after it has been declared) fit for use by the word (of a Brāhmaṇa).

sanskrit_iast: api hy atra prājāpatyāñ ślokān udāharanti | trīṇi devāḥ pavitrāṇi brāhmaṇānām akalpayan | adṛṣṭam adbhir nirṇiktaṃ yac ca vācā praśasyate |
meaning: अपि ह्य् अत्र प्राजापत्याञ् श्लोकान् उदाहरन्ति । त्रीणि देवाः पवित्राणि ब्राह्मणानाम् अकल्पयन् । अदृष्टम् अद्भिर् निर्णिक्तं यच् च वाचा प्रशस्यते ।
text: With reference to this (subject) they quote also some verses proclaimed by Pra g āpati, The gods created for Brāhmaṇas three means of purifying (defiled substances), viz. ignorance (of defilement), sprinkling (them) with water, and commending (them) by word of mouth.'

sanskrit_iast: devadroṇyāṃ vivāheṣu yajñeṣu prakṛteṣu ca | kākaiḥ śvabhiś ca saṃspṛṣṭam annam tan na visarjayet |
meaning: देवद्रोण्यां विवाहेषु यज्ञेषु प्रकृतेषु च । काकैः श्वभिश् च संस्पृष्टम् अन्नम् तन् न विसर्जयेत् ।
text: Let him not throw away that food which, at a procession with images of the gods, at weddings, and at sacrifices, is touched by crows or dogs.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmād annam apoddhṛtya śeṣaṃ saṃskāram arhati | dravāṇāṃ plāvanenaiva ghanānāṃ prokṣaṇena tu |
meaning: तस्माद् अन्नम् अपोद्धृत्य शेषं संस्कारम् अर्हति । द्रवाणां प्लावनेनैव घनानां प्रोक्षणेन तु ।
text: After the (defiled) portion has been removed, the remainder shall be purified, liquids by straining them, but solid food by sprinkling it with water.'

sanskrit_iast: mārjāramukhasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ śuci eva hi tad bhavet |
meaning: मार्जारमुखसंस्पृष्टं शुचि एव हि तद् भवेत् ।
text: 'What has been touched by the mouth of a cat is even pure.'

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ paryuṣitaṃ bhāvaduṣṭaṃ sahṛdlekhaṃ punaḥsiddham āmamāṃsaṃ pakvaṃ ca |
meaning: अन्नं पर्युषितं भावदुष्टं सहृद्लेखं पुनःसिद्धम् आममांसं पक्वं च ।
text: (Cooked food which has become) stale (by being kept), what is naturally bad, what has been placed once only in the dish, what has been cooked more than once, raw (food), and (food) insufficiently cooked (must not be eaten).

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ tu dadhnā ghṛtena vābhighāritam upayuñjīta |
meaning: कामं तु दध्ना घृतेन वाभिघारितम् उपयुञ्जीत ।
text: But at pleasure he may use (such food) after pouring over it sour milk or clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: api hy atra prājāpatyāñ ślokān udāharanti | ghṛtaṃ vā yadi vā tailaṃ vipro nādyān nakhaścyutam | yamas tad aśuci prāha tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ |
meaning: अपि ह्य् अत्र प्राजापत्याञ् श्लोकान् उदाहरन्ति । घृतं वा यदि वा तैलं विप्रो नाद्यान् नखश्च्युतम् । यमस् तद् अशुचि प्राह तुल्यं गोमांसभक्षणैः ।
text: With reference to this (subject) they quote also some verses proclaimed by Pra g āpati, 'A Brāhmaṇa shall not eat clarified butter or oil which drips from the nails (of the giver). Yama has declared such (food to be) impure; (to eat it is as sinful) as to partake of cow's flesh.'

sanskrit_iast: hastadattās tu ye snehā lavaṇavyañjanāni ca | dātāraṃ nopatiṣṭhanti bhoktā bhuñjīta kilbiṣam |
meaning: हस्तदत्तास् तु ये स्नेहा लवणव्यञ्जनानि च । दातारं नोपतिष्ठन्ति भोक्ता भुञ्जीत किल्बिषम् ।
text: 'But fatty substances, salt, and condiments proffered with the hand do not benefit the giver, and he who partakes of them will eat sin.'

sanskrit_iast: pradadyān na tu hastena nāyasena kadācaneti |
meaning: प्रदद्यान् न तु हस्तेन नायसेन कदाचनेति ।
text: 'Let him give, therefore, such substances placed on a leaf or on grass, but never with his hands or in an iron vessel.'

sanskrit_iast: laśunapalāṇḍukyākugṛñjanaśleṣmāntakavṛkṣaniryāsalohitavraścanaśvakākāvalīḍhaśūdroccheṣaṇabhojaneṣv atikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: लशुनपलाण्डुक्याकुगृञ्जनश्लेष्मान्तकवृक्षनिर्यासलोहितव्रश्चनश्वकाकावलीढशूद्रोच्छेषणभोजनेष्व् अतिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: For eating garlic, onions, mushrooms, turnips, Śleshmāntaka, exudations from trees, the red sap flowing from incisions (in trees or plants), food pecked at by crows or worried by dogs, or the leavings of a Śūdra, an Atik ri k kh ra (penance must be performed).

sanskrit_iast: sandhinīkṣīram avatsākṣīram |
meaning: सन्धिनीक्षीरम् अवत्साक्षीरम् ।
text: (Let him not drink) the milk of a cow that is in heat, nor of one whose calf has died,

sanskrit_iast: gomahiṣyajānām anirdaśāhānām |
meaning: गोमहिष्यजानाम् अनिर्दशाहानाम् ।
text: Nor that which cows, buffalo-cows, and goats give during the first ten days (after giving birth to young ones),

sanskrit_iast: antarnāvy udakam |
meaning: अन्तर्नाव्य् उदकम् ।
text: Nor water collected at the bottom of a boat.

sanskrit_iast: apūpadhānākarambhasaktuvaṭakatailapāyasaśākāni śuktāni varjayet |
meaning: अपूपधानाकरम्भसक्तुवटकतैलपायसशाकानि शुक्तानि वर्जयेत् ।
text: Let him avoid wheat-cakes, (fried) grain, porridge, barley-meal, pulse-cakes, oil, rice boiled in milk, and vegetables that have turned sour (by standing),

sanskrit_iast: anyāṃś ca kṣīrayavapiṣṭavikārān |
meaning: अन्यांश् च क्षीरयवपिष्टविकारान् ।
text: Likewise other kinds of (sour) food prepared with milk and barley-flour.

sanskrit_iast: śvāvidhśalyakaśaśakacchapagodhāḥ pañcanakhānāṃ bhakṣyāḥ |
meaning: श्वाविध्शल्यकशशकच्छपगोधाः पञ्चनखानां भक्ष्याः ।
text: Among five-toed animals, the porcupine, the hedgehog, the hare, the tortoise, and the iguana may be eaten,

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭrāḥ paśūnām anyatodantāś ca |
meaning: अनुष्ट्राः पशूनाम् अन्यतोदन्ताश् च ।
text: Among (domestic) animals those having teeth in one jaw only, excepting camels.

sanskrit_iast: matsyānāṃ vā ceṭagavayaśiśumāranakrakulīrāḥ |
meaning: मत्स्यानां वा चेटगवयशिशुमारनक्रकुलीराः ।
text: And among fishes, the long-nosed crocodile, the Gavaya, the porpoise, the alligator, and the crab (must not be eaten),

sanskrit_iast: vikṛtarūpāḥ sarpaśīrṣāś ca |
meaning: विकृतरूपाः सर्पशीर्षाश् च ।
text: Nor those which are misshaped or have heads like snakes,

sanskrit_iast: gauragavayaśarabhāś ca |
meaning: गौरगवयशरभाश् च ।
text: Nor the bos Gaurus, the Gayal, and the Śarabha,

sanskrit_iast: anuddiṣṭās tathā |
meaning: अनुद्दिष्टास् तथा ।
text: Nor those that have not been (specially mentioned (as fit for food),

sanskrit_iast: dhenvanaḍuhāv apannadantāṃś ca |
meaning: धेन्वनडुहाव् अपन्नदन्तांश् च ।
text: Nor milch-cows, draught-oxen, and animals whose milk teeth have not dropped out.

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣyau tu dhenvanaḍuhau medhyau vājasaneyake vijñāyate |
meaning: भक्ष्यौ तु धेन्वनडुहौ मेध्यौ वाजसनेयके विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Vā g asaneyaka, that (the flesh of) milch-cows and oxen is fit for offerings.

sanskrit_iast: khaḍge tu vivadanty agrāmyaśūkare ca |
meaning: खड्गे तु विवदन्त्य् अग्राम्यशूकरे च ।
text: But regarding the rhinoceros and the wild boar they make conflicting statements.

sanskrit_iast: śakunānāṃ ca viṣuviṣkarajālapādakalaviṅkaplavahaṃsacakravākabhāsavāyasapārāvatakurarasāraṅgapāṇḍukapotakrauñcakrakarakaṅkagṛdhraśyenabakabalākamadguṭiṭṭibhamāndhālanaktañcaradārvāghāṭacakaṭarailātakāhārītakhañjarīṭagrāmyakukkuṭaśukaśārikakokilakravyādo grāmacāriṇaś ca grāmacāriṇaś ceti |
meaning: शकुनानां च विषुविष्करजालपादकलविङ्कप्लवहंसचक्रवाकभासवायसपारावतकुररसारङ्गपाण्डुकपोतक्रौञ्चक्रकरकङ्कगृध्रश्येनबकबलाकमद्गुटिट्टिभमान्धालनक्तञ्चरदार्वाघाटचकटरैलातकाहारीतखञ्जरीटग्राम्यकुक्कुटशुकशारिककोकिलक्रव्यादो ग्रामचारिणश् च ग्रामचारिणश् चेति ।
text: And among birds, those who seek their food by scratching with their feet, the web-footed ones, the Kalaviṅka, the water-hen, the flamingo, the [paragraph continues] Brahmaṇī duck, the Bhāsa, the crow, the blue pigeon, the osprey, the K ātaka, the dove, the crane, the black partridge, the grey heron, the vulture, the falcon, the white egret, the ibis, the cormorant, the peewit, the flying-fox, those flying about at night, the woodpecker, the sparrow, the Railātaka, the green pigeon, the wagtail, the village-cock, the parrot, the starling, the cuckoo, those feeding on flesh, and those living about villages (must not be eaten).

sanskrit_iast: śoṇitaśukrasaṃbhavaḥ puruṣo bhavati mātāpitṛnimittakaḥ |
meaning: शोणितशुक्रसंभवः पुरुषो भवति मातापितृनिमित्तकः ।
text: Man formed of uterine blood and virile seed proceeds from his mother and his father (as an effect) from its cause.

sanskrit_iast: tasya pradānavikrayatyāgeṣu mātāpitarau prabhavataḥ |
meaning: तस्य प्रदानविक्रयत्यागेषु मातापितरौ प्रभवतः ।
text: (Therefore) the father and the mother have power to give, to sell, and to abandon their (son).

sanskrit_iast: na tv ekaṃ putraṃ dadyāt pratigṛhṇīyād vā |
meaning: न त्व् एकं पुत्रं दद्यात् प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् वा ।
text: But let him not give or receive (in adoption) an only son;

sanskrit_iast: sa hi santānāya pūrveṣām |
meaning: स हि सन्तानाय पूर्वेषाम् ।
text: For he (must remain) to continue the line of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: na strī putraṃ dadyāt pratigṛhṇīyād vānyatrānujñānād bhartuḥ |
meaning: न स्त्री पुत्रं दद्यात् प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् वान्यत्रानुज्ञानाद् भर्तुः ।
text: Let a woman neither give nor receive a son except with her husband's permission.

sanskrit_iast: putraṃ pratigṛhīṣyan bandhūn āhūya rājani ca nivedya niveśanasya madhye vyāhṛtibhir hutvādūrabāndhavaṃ bandhusannikṛṣṭam eva pratigṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: पुत्रं प्रतिगृहीष्यन् बन्धून् आहूय राजनि च निवेद्य निवेशनस्य मध्ये व्याहृतिभिर् हुत्वादूरबान्धवं बन्धुसन्निकृष्टम् एव प्रतिगृह्णीयात् ।
text: He who desires to adopt a son, shall assemble his kinsmen, announce his intention to the king, make burnt-offerings in the middle of the house, reciting the Vyāh ri tis, and take (as a son) a not remote kinsman, just the nearest among his relatives.

sanskrit_iast: sandehe cotpanne dūrebāndhavaṃ śūdram iva sthāpayet |
meaning: सन्देहे चोत्पन्ने दूरेबान्धवं शूद्रम् इव स्थापयेत् ।
text: But if a doubt arises (with respect to an adopted son who is) a remote kinsman, (the adopter) shall set him apart like a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate hy ekena bahūṃs trāyata iti |
meaning: विज्ञायते ह्य् एकेन बहूंस् त्रायत इति ।
text: For it is declared in the Veda, 'Through one he saves many.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmiṃś cet pratigṛhīta aurasaḥ putra utpadyeta caturthabhāgabhāgī syād dattakaḥ |
meaning: तस्मिंश् चेत् प्रतिगृहीत औरसः पुत्र उत्पद्येत चतुर्थभागभागी स्याद् दत्तकः ।
text: If, after an adoption has been made, a legitimate son be born, (the adopted son) shall obtain a fourth part,

sanskrit_iast: yadi nābhyudayikeṣu yuktaḥ syāt |
meaning: यदि नाभ्युदयिकेषु युक्तः स्यात् ।
text: Provided he be not engaged in (rites) procuring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: vedaviplāvakaḥ śūdrayājaka uttamavarṇavargapatitās teṣāṃ pātraninayanam |
meaning: वेदविप्लावकः शूद्रयाजक उत्तमवर्णवर्गपतितास् तेषां पात्रनिनयनम् ।
text: He who divulges the Veda (to persons not authorised to study it), he who sacrifices for Śūdras, (and all those) who have fallen from the rank of the highest caste (shall be excommunicated by the ceremony of) emptying the water-vessel.

sanskrit_iast: apātrasaṅkarād akṛtsnaṃ pātram ādāya dāsosavarṇāputro vā bandhur asadṛśo vā guṇahīnaḥ savyena pādena pravṛttāgrān darbhān lohitān vopastīrya pūrṇapātram asmai ninayet |
meaning: अपात्रसङ्कराद् अकृत्स्नं पात्रम् आदाय दासोसवर्णापुत्रो वा बन्धुर् असदृशो वा गुणहीनः सव्येन पादेन प्रवृत्ताग्रान् दर्भान् लोहितान् वोपस्तीर्य पूर्णपात्रम् अस्मै निनयेत् ।
text: A slave or the son of a wife of a lower caste, or a relative not belonging to the same caste, who is destitute of good qualities, shall fetch a broken pot from a heap of vessels unfit for use, place Kuśa grass, the tops of which have been cut off, or Lohita grass (on the ground), and empty the pot for the (outcast, overturning it) with his left foot;

sanskrit_iast: ninetāraṃ cāsya prakīrṇakeśā jñātayo 'nvālabheran |
meaning: निनेतारं चास्य प्रकीर्णकेशा ज्ञातयो ऽन्वालभेरन् ।
text: And the relatives of the (outcast), allowing their hair to hang down, shall touch him who empties (the pot).

sanskrit_iast: apasavyaṃ kṛtvā gṛheṣu svairam āpadyeran |
meaning: अपसव्यं कृत्वा गृहेषु स्वैरम् आपद्येरन् ।
text: Turning (when they leave) their left hands towards (that spot), they may go home at pleasure.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ na taṃ dharmayeyuḥ |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं न तं धर्मयेयुः ।
text: Let them not afterwards admit the (excommunicated person) to sacred rites.

sanskrit_iast: taddharmāṇas taṃ dharmayantaḥ |
meaning: तद्धर्माणस् तं धर्मयन्तः ।
text: Those who admit him to sacred rites become his equals.

sanskrit_iast: patitānāṃ tu caritavratānāṃ pratyuddhāraḥ |
meaning: पतितानां तु चरितव्रतानां प्रत्युद्धारः ।
text: But outcasts who have performed (the prescribed) penance (may be) readmitted.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | agre 'bhyuddharatāṃ gacchet krīḍann iva hasann iva | paścāt pātayatāṃ gacchec chocann iva rudann iveti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अग्रे ऽभ्युद्धरतां गच्छेत् क्रीडन्न् इव हसन्न् इव । पश्चात् पातयतां गच्छेच् छोचन्न् इव रुदन्न् इवेति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): [paragraph continues] 'Let him walk before those who readmit him, like one gamboling and laughing. Let him walk behind those who excommunicate him, like one weeping and sorrowing.'

sanskrit_iast: ācāryamātṛpitṛhantāras tatprasādād apayāpyād vā eṣā teṣāṃ pratyāpattiḥ |
meaning: आचार्यमातृपितृहन्तारस् तत्प्रसादाद् अपयाप्याद् वा एषा तेषां प्रत्यापत्तिः ।
text: Those who strike their teacher, their mother, or their father may be readmitted in the following manner, either after being pardoned by the (persons offended) or after expiating their sin.

sanskrit_iast: puṇyahradāt prasṛtād vā kāñcanaṃ pātraṃ māheyaṃ vā pūrayitvāpohiṣṭhābhir enam adbhir abhiṣiñcanti |
meaning: पुण्यह्रदात् प्रसृताद् वा काञ्चनं पात्रं माहेयं वा पूरयित्वापोहिष्ठाभिर् एनम् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चन्ति ।
text: Having filled a golden or an earthen vessel (with water taken) from a sacred lake or river, they pour (the water) over him, (reciting the three verses) 'Ye waters are' &c.

sanskrit_iast: sarva evābhiṣiktasya pratyuddhāraḥ putrajanmanā vyākhyāto vyākhyāta iti |
meaning: सर्व एवाभिषिक्तस्य प्रत्युद्धारः पुत्रजन्मना व्याख्यातो व्याख्यात इति ।
text: All the (other ceremonies to be performed on the) readmission of one who has bathed (in this manner) have been explained by (those ordained an) the birth of a son.

sanskrit_iast: atha vyavahārāḥ |
meaning: अथ व्यवहाराः ।
text: Now (follow the rules regarding) legal proceedings.

sanskrit_iast: rājā mantrī vā sadaḥkāryāṇi kuryāt |
meaning: राजा मन्त्री वा सदःकार्याणि कुर्यात् ।
text: Let the king (or) his minister transact the business on the bench.

sanskrit_iast: dvayor vivadamānayoḥ pakṣāntaraṃ na gacchet |
meaning: द्वयोर् विवदमानयोः पक्षान्तरं न गच्छेत् ।
text: When two (parties) have a dispute, let him not be partial to one of them.

sanskrit_iast: yathāsanam aparādhohy antenāparādhaḥ |
meaning: यथासनम् अपराधोह्य् अन्तेनापराधः ।
text: Let him reason properly regarding an offence; finally the offence (will become evident thereby).

sanskrit_iast: samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu yathāsanam aparādhohy ādyavarṇayor vidyāntataḥ |
meaning: समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु यथासनम् अपराधोह्य् आद्यवर्णयोर् विद्यान्ततः ।
text: He who properly reasons regarding an offence, in accordance with the sum of the science of the first two castes, is equitable towards all created beings.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpannaṃ ca rakṣayet |
meaning: संपन्नं च रक्षयेत् ।
text: And let him protect what has been gained;

sanskrit_iast: rājabāladhanāni |
meaning: राजबालधनानि ।
text: (Likewise) the property of infants (of the) royal (race).

sanskrit_iast: aprāptavyavahārāṇām |
meaning: अप्राप्तव्यवहाराणाम् ।
text: (Likewise the property) of persons unfit to transact legal business (minors, widows, and so forth).

sanskrit_iast: prāptakāle tu tad yat |
meaning: प्राप्तकाले तु तद् यत् ।
text: But if (a minor) comes of age, his property must be made over to him.

sanskrit_iast: likhitaṃ sākṣiṇo bhuktiḥ pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam | dhanasvīkaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ dhanī dhanam avāpnuyāditi |
meaning: लिखितं साक्षिणो भुक्तिः प्रमाणं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् । धनस्वीकरणं पूर्वं धनी धनम् अवाप्नुयादिति ।
text: 'It is declared in the Sm ri ti that there are three kinds of proof which give a title to (property, viz.) documents, witnesses, and possession; (thereby) an owner may recover property which formerly belonged to him (but was lost).'

sanskrit_iast: mārgakṣetrebhyo visargas tathā parivarttanam |
meaning: मार्गक्षेत्रेभ्यो विसर्गस् तथा परिवर्त्तनम् ।
text: From fields through which (there is a right of) road (a space sufficient for the road) must be set apart, likewise a space for turning (a cart).

sanskrit_iast: taruṇagṛheṣv arthāntareṣu tripādamātram |
meaning: तरुणगृहेष्व् अर्थान्तरेषु त्रिपादमात्रम् ।
text: Near new-built houses (and) other things (of the same description there shall be) a passage three feet broad.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhakṣetravirodhe sāmantapratyayaḥ |
meaning: गृहक्षेत्रविरोधे सामन्तप्रत्ययः ।
text: In a dispute about a house or a field, reliance (may be placed on the depositions of) neighbours.

sanskrit_iast: sāmantavirodhe lekhyapratyayaḥ |
meaning: सामन्तविरोधे लेख्यप्रत्ययः ।
text: If the statements of the neighbours disagree, documents (may be taken as) proof.

sanskrit_iast: pratyabhilekhyavirodhe grāmanagaravṛddhaśreṇīpratyayaḥ |
meaning: प्रत्यभिलेख्यविरोधे ग्रामनगरवृद्धश्रेणीप्रत्ययः ।
text: If conflicting documents are produced, reliance (may be placed) on (the statements of) aged (inhabitants) of the village or town, and on (those of) guilds and corporations (of artisans or traders).

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | paitṛkaṃ krītam ādheyam anvādheyaṃ pratigraham | yajñād upagamo veṇis tathā dhūmaśikhāṣṭamīti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पैतृकं क्रीतम् आधेयम् अन्वाधेयं प्रतिग्रहम् । यज्ञाद् उपगमो वेणिस् तथा धूमशिखाष्टमीति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Property inherited from a father, a thing bought, a pledge, property given to a wife after marriage by her husband's family, a gift, property obtained for performing a sacrifice, the property of reunited coparceners, and wages as the eighth.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra bhuktānubhuktadaśavarṣam |
meaning: तत्र भुक्तानुभुक्तदशवर्षम् ।
text: Whatever belonging to these (eight kinds of property) has been enjoyed (by another person) for ten years continuously (is lost to the owner).

sanskrit_iast: anyathāpy udāharanti | ādhiḥ sīmā bāladhano nikṣepopanidhistriyaḥ | rājasvaṃ śrotriyadravyaṃ na saṃbhogena hīyate |
meaning: अन्यथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । आधिः सीमा बालधनो निक्षेपोपनिधिस्त्रियः । राजस्वं श्रोत्रियद्रव्यं न संभोगेन हीयते ।
text: They quote also (a verse) on the other side: 'A pledge, a boundary, and the property of minor's, an (open) deposit, a sealed deposit, women, the property of a king, (and) the wealth of a Śrotriya are not lost by being enjoyed (by others).'

sanskrit_iast: prahīṇadravyāṇi rājagāmīni bhavanti |
meaning: प्रहीणद्रव्याणि राजगामीनि भवन्ति ।
text: Property entirely given up (by its owner) goes to the king.

sanskrit_iast: tato 'nyathā rājā mantribhiḥ saha nāgaraiś ca kāryāṇi kuryāt |
meaning: ततो ऽन्यथा राजा मन्त्रिभिः सह नागरैश् च कार्याणि कुर्यात् ।
text: If it be otherwise, the king with his ministers and the citizens shall administer it.

sanskrit_iast: vedhaso vā rājā śreyān gṛdhraparivāraṃ syāt |
