meaning: वेधसो वा राजा श्रेयान् गृध्रपरिवारं स्यात् ।
text: A king will be superior even to Brahman if he lives surrounded by servants (who are keen-eyed) like vultures.

sanskrit_iast: gṛdhraparivāraṃ vā rājā śreyān |
meaning: गृध्रपरिवारं वा राजा श्रेयान् ।
text: But a king will not be exalted if he lives surrounded by servants (who are greedy) like vultures.

sanskrit_iast: gṛdhraparivāraṃ syān na gṛdhro gṛdhraparivāraṃ syāt |
meaning: गृध्रपरिवारं स्यान् न गृध्रो गृध्रपरिवारं स्यात् ।
text: Let him live surrounded by servants (who are keen-eyed) like vultures, let him not be a vulture surrounded by vultures.

sanskrit_iast: parivārād hi doṣāḥ prādurbhavanti |
meaning: परिवाराद् हि दोषाः प्रादुर्भवन्ति ।
text: For through his servants blemishes become manifest (in his kingdom),

sanskrit_iast: steyahāravināśanaṃ ca |
meaning: स्तेयहारविनाशनं च ।
text: (Such as) theft, robbery, oppression, and (so forth).

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt pūrvam eva parivāraṃ pṛcchet |
meaning: तस्मात् पूर्वम् एव परिवारं पृच्छेत् ।
text: Therefore let him question his servants before-hand.

sanskrit_iast: atha sākṣiṇaḥ |
meaning: अथ साक्षिणः ।
text: Now (follow the rules regarding) witnesses:

sanskrit_iast: śrotriyo rūpavāñ śīlavān puṇyavān satyavān sākṣiṇaḥ |
meaning: श्रोत्रियो रूपवाञ् शीलवान् पुण्यवान् सत्यवान् साक्षिणः ।
text: Śrotriyas, men of unblemished form, of good character, men who are holy and love truth (are fit to be) witnesses,

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu sarva eva vā |
meaning: सर्वेषु सर्व एव वा ।
text: Or (men of) any (caste may give evidence) regarding (men of) any (other caste).

sanskrit_iast: strīṇāṃ sākṣiṇaḥ striyaḥ kuryād dvijānāṃ sadṛśā dvijāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ santaḥ śūdrāś cāntyānām antyayonayaḥ |
meaning: स्त्रीणां साक्षिणः स्त्रियः कुर्याद् द्विजानां सदृशा द्विजाः शूद्राणां सन्तः शूद्राश् चान्त्यानाम् अन्त्ययोनयः ।
text: Let him make women witnesses regarding women; for twice-born men twice-born men of the same caste (shall be witnesses), and good Śūdras for Śūdras, and men of low birth for low-caste men.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | pratibhāvyaṃ vṛthādānam ākṣikaṃ saurikaṃ ca yat | daṇḍaśulkāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca na putro dātur mahati |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । प्रतिभाव्यं वृथादानम् आक्षिकं सौरिकं च यत् । दण्डशुल्कावशिष्टं च न पुत्रो दातुर् महति ।

sanskrit_iast: brūhi sākṣin yathātattvaṃ lambante pitaras tava | tava vākyam udīkṣāṇā utpatanti patanti ca |
meaning: ब्रूहि साक्षिन् यथातत्त्वं लम्बन्ते पितरस् तव । तव वाक्यम् उदीक्षाणा उत्पतन्ति पतन्ति च ।

sanskrit_iast: nagno muṇḍaḥ kapālī ca bhikṣārthī kṣutpipāsitaḥ | andhaḥ śatrukule gacched yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet |
meaning: नग्नो मुण्डः कपाली च भिक्षार्थी क्षुत्पिपासितः । अन्धः शत्रुकुले गच्छेद् यः साक्ष्यम् अनृतं वदेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: pañca kanyānṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte | śatam aśvānṛte hanti sahasraṃ puruṣānṛte |
meaning: पञ्च कन्यानृते हन्ति दश हन्ति गवानृते । शतम् अश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं पुरुषानृते ।

sanskrit_iast: vyavahāre mṛte dāre prāyaścittaṃ kulastriyāḥ | teṣāṃ pūrvaparicchedāc chidyante 'trāpavādibhiḥ |
meaning: व्यवहारे मृते दारे प्रायश्चित्तं कुलस्त्रियाः । तेषां पूर्वपरिच्छेदाच् छिद्यन्ते ऽत्रापवादिभिः ।

sanskrit_iast: udvāhakāle ratisaṃprayoge prāṇātyaye sarvadhanāpahāre | viprasya cārthe hy anṛtaṃ vadeyuḥ pañcānṛtāny āhur apātakāni |
meaning: उद्वाहकाले रतिसंप्रयोगे प्राणात्यये सर्वधनापहारे । विप्रस्य चार्थे ह्य् अनृतं वदेयुः पञ्चानृतान्य् आहुर् अपातकानि ।

sanskrit_iast: svajanasvārthe yadi vārthahetoḥ pakṣāśrayeṇaiva vadanti kāryam | te śabdavaṃśasya kulasya pūrvān svargasthitāṃs tān api pātayanti | api pātayantīti |
meaning: स्वजनस्वार्थे यदि वार्थहेतोः पक्षाश्रयेणैव वदन्ति कार्यम् । ते शब्दवंशस्य कुलस्य पूर्वान् स्वर्गस्थितांस् तान् अपि पातयन्ति । अपि पातयन्तीति ।

sanskrit_iast: ṛṇam asmin sannayaty amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati | pitā putrasya jātasya paśyec cej jīvato mukham |
meaning: ऋणम् अस्मिन् सन्नयत्य् अमृतत्वं च गच्छति । पिता पुत्रस्य जातस्य पश्येच् चेज् जीवतो मुखम् ।
text: The father throws his debts on the (son) and obtains immortality if he sees the face of a living son.

sanskrit_iast: anantāḥ putriṇāṃ lokā nāputrasya loko 'stīti śrūyate |
meaning: अनन्ताः पुत्रिणां लोका नापुत्रस्य लोको ऽस्तीति श्रूयते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'Endless are the worlds of those who have sons; there is no place for the man who is destitute of male offspring.'

sanskrit_iast: apajāḥ santv atriṇa ity abhiśāpaḥ |
meaning: अपजाः सन्त्व् अत्रिण इत्य् अभिशापः ।
text: There is a curse (in the Veda), 'May our enemies be destitute of offspring.'

sanskrit_iast: prajābhir agne amṛtatvam aśyām ity api nigamo bhavati |
meaning: प्रजाभिर् अग्ने अमृतत्वम् अश्याम् इत्य् अपि निगमो भवति ।
text: There is also (the following) passage of the Veda, 'May I obtain, O Agni, immortality by offspring.'

sanskrit_iast: putreṇa lokāñ jayati pautreṇānantyam aśnute | atha putrasya pautreṇa bradhnasyāpnoti viṣṭapam iti |
meaning: पुत्रेण लोकाञ् जयति पौत्रेणानन्त्यम् अश्नुते । अथ पुत्रस्य पौत्रेण ब्रध्नस्याप्नोति विष्टपम् इति ।
text: 'Through a son he conquers the worlds, through a grandson he obtains immortality, but through his son's grandson he gains the world of the sun.'

sanskrit_iast: kṣetriṇaḥ putro janayituḥ putra iti vivadante |
meaning: क्षेत्रिणः पुत्रो जनयितुः पुत्र इति विवदन्ते ।
text: There is a dispute (among the wise; some say), The son belongs to the husband of the wife;' (and some say), 'The son belongs to the begetter.'

sanskrit_iast: tatrobhayathāpy udāharanti |
meaning: तत्रोभयथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: With respect to this (matter) they quote also on both sides verses like the following:

sanskrit_iast: yady anyagoṣu vṛṣabho vatsānāṃ janayec chatam | gominām eva te vatsā moghaṃ syanditam ārṣabham iti |
meaning: यद्य् अन्यगोषु वृषभो वत्सानां जनयेच् छतम् । गोमिनाम् एव ते वत्सा मोघं स्यन्दितम् आर्षभम् इति ।
text: (Some say), 'If (one man's) bull were to beget a hundred calves on another man's cows, they would belong to the owner of the cows; in vain would the bull have spent his strength.'

sanskrit_iast: apramattā rakṣata tantum etaṃ mā vaḥ kṣetre parabījāni vāpsuḥ | janayituḥ putro bhavati saṃparāye moghaṃ tettā kurute tantum etam iti |
meaning: अप्रमत्ता रक्षत तन्तुम् एतं मा वः क्षेत्रे परबीजानि वाप्सुः । जनयितुः पुत्रो भवति संपराये मोघं तेत्ता कुरुते तन्तुम् एतम् इति ।
text: (Others say), 'Carefully watch the procreation of your offspring, lest strangers sow seed on your soil; in the next world the son belongs to the begetter; (by carelessness) a husband makes (the possession of) offspring in vain.'

sanskrit_iast: bahūnām ekajātānām ekaś cet putravān naraḥ | sarve te tena putreṇa putravanta iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: बहूनाम् एकजातानाम् एकश् चेत् पुत्रवान् नरः । सर्वे ते तेन पुत्रेण पुत्रवन्त इति श्रुतिः ।
text: If amongst many brothers who are begotten by one father, one have a son, they all have offspring through that son; thus says the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: bahvīnām ekapatnīnām ekā putravatī yadi | sarvās tās tena putreṇa putravantya iti śrutiḥ |
meaning: बह्वीनाम् एकपत्नीनाम् एका पुत्रवती यदि । सर्वास् तास् तेन पुत्रेण पुत्रवन्त्य इति श्रुतिः ।
text: If among many wives of one husband, one have a son, they all have offspring through that son; thus says the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa ity eva putrāḥ purāṇadṛṣṭāḥ |
meaning: द्वादश इत्य् एव पुत्राः पुराणदृष्टाः ।
text: Twelve (kinds of) sons only are noticed by the ancients.

sanskrit_iast: svayam utpāditaḥ svakṣetre saṃskṛtāyāṃ prathamaḥ |
meaning: स्वयम् उत्पादितः स्वक्षेत्रे संस्कृतायां प्रथमः ।
text: The first (among these is the son) begotten by the husband himself on his legally married wife.

sanskrit_iast: tadalābhe niyuktāyāṃ kṣetrajo dvitīyaḥ |
meaning: तदलाभे नियुक्तायां क्षेत्रजो द्वितीयः ।
text: The second is the son of a wife (who is begotten) on failure of the (first) on a (wife or widow duly) authorised (thereto, by a kinsman).

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyaḥ putrikā |
meaning: तृतीयः पुत्रिका ।
text: The third is an appointed daughter.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyatebhrātṛkā puṃsaḥ pitṝn abhyeti pratīcīnaṃ gacchati putratvam |
meaning: विज्ञायतेभ्रातृका पुंसः पितॄन् अभ्येति प्रतीचीनं गच्छति पुत्रत्वम् ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'A maiden who has no brothers comes back to the male ancestors (of her own family); returning she becomes their son.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra ślokaḥ | abhrātṛkāṃ pradāsyāmi tubhyaṃ kanyām alaṃkṛtām | asyāṃ yo jāyate putraḥ sa me putro bhaved iti |
meaning: तत्र श्लोकः । अभ्रातृकां प्रदास्यामि तुभ्यं कन्याम् अलंकृताम् । अस्यां यो जायते पुत्रः स मे पुत्रो भवेद् इति ।
text: With reference to this (matter there is) a verse (to be spoken by the father when appointing daughter), 'I shall give thee a brotherless damsel, decked with ornaments; the son whom she may bear, shall be my son.'

sanskrit_iast: paunarbhavaś caturthaḥ |
meaning: पौनर्भवश् चतुर्थः ।
text: The fourth is the son of a remarried woman.

sanskrit_iast: yā kaumāraṃ bharttāram uttsṛjyānyaiḥ saha caritvā tasyaiva kuṭumbam āśrayati sā punarbhūr bhavati |
meaning: या कौमारं भर्त्तारम् उत्त्सृज्यान्यैः सह चरित्वा तस्यैव कुटुम्बम् आश्रयति सा पुनर्भूर् भवति ।
text: She is called remarried (punarbhū) who leaving the husband of her youth, and having lived with others, re-enters his family;

sanskrit_iast: yā ca klībaṃ patitam unmattaṃ vā bharttāram utsṛjyānyaṃ patiṃ vindate mṛte vā sā punarbhūr bhavati |
meaning: या च क्लीबं पतितम् उन्मत्तं वा भर्त्तारम् उत्सृज्यान्यं पतिं विन्दते मृते वा सा पुनर्भूर् भवति ।
text: And she is called remarried who leaving an impotent, outcast or mad husband, or after the death of her husband takes another lord.

sanskrit_iast: kānīnaḥ pañcamaḥ |
meaning: कानीनः पञ्चमः ।
text: The fifth is the son of an unmarried damsel.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ pitṛgṛhe 'saṃskṛtā kāmād utpādayen mātāmahasya putro bhavatīty āhuḥ |
meaning: यं पितृगृहे ऽसंस्कृता कामाद् उत्पादयेन् मातामहस्य पुत्रो भवतीत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that the son whom an unmarried damsel produces through lust in her father's house, is the son of his maternal grandfather.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aprattā duhitā yasya putraṃ vindeta tulyataḥ | putrī mātāmahas tena dadyāt piṇḍaṃ hared dhanam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अप्रत्ता दुहिता यस्य पुत्रं विन्देत तुल्यतः । पुत्री मातामहस् तेन दद्यात् पिण्डं हरेद् धनम् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): If an unmarried daughter bear a son begotten by a man of equal caste, the maternal grandfather has a son through him; he shall offer the funeral cake, and take the wealth (of his grandfather).'

sanskrit_iast: gṛhe ca gūḍhotpannaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ |
meaning: गृहे च गूढोत्पन्नः षष्ठः ।
text: (A male child) secretly born in the house is the sixth.

sanskrit_iast: ity ete dāyādā bāndhavās trātāro mahato bhayād ity āhuḥ |
meaning: इत्य् एते दायादा बान्धवास् त्रातारो महतो भयाद् इत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that these (six) are heirs and kinsmen, preservers from a great danger.

sanskrit_iast: athādāyādabandhūnāṃ sahoḍha eva prathamaḥ |
meaning: अथादायादबन्धूनां सहोढ एव प्रथमः ।
text: Now among those (sons) who are not heirs, but kinsmen, the first is he who is received with a pregnant bride.

sanskrit_iast: yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate sahoḍhaḥ putro bhavati |
meaning: या गर्भिणी संस्क्रियते सहोढः पुत्रो भवति ।
text: (The son of a damsel) who is married pregnant (is called) a son received with the bride (saho dh a).

sanskrit_iast: dattako dvitīyaḥ |
meaning: दत्तको द्वितीयः ।
text: The second is the adopted son,

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ mātāpitarau dadyātām |
meaning: यं मातापितरौ दद्याताम् ।
text: (He) whom his father and his mother give (in adoption).

sanskrit_iast: krītas tṛtīyaḥ |
meaning: क्रीतस् तृतीयः ।
text: (The son) bought is the third.

sanskrit_iast: tac chunaḥśepena vyākhyātam |
meaning: तच् छुनःशेपेन व्याख्यातम् ।
text: That is explained by (the story of) Sunaḥs epa.

sanskrit_iast: hariścandro vai rājā so 'jīgartasya sauyavaseḥ putraṃ cikrāya |
meaning: हरिश्चन्द्रो वै राजा सो ऽजीगर्तस्य सौयवसेः पुत्रं चिक्राय ।
text: 'Hariśk andra, forsooth, was a king. He bought the son of A g īgarta Sauyavasi.

sanskrit_iast: svayam upāgataś caturthaḥ |
meaning: स्वयम् उपागतश् चतुर्थः ।
text: The fourth is (the son) self-given.

sanskrit_iast: tac chunaḥśepena vyākyātam |
meaning: तच् छुनःशेपेन व्याक्यातम् ।
text: That is (likewise) explained by (the story of) Sunaḥs epa.

sanskrit_iast: śunaḥśepo vai yūpe niyukto devatās tuṣṭāva | tasyeha devatāḥ pāśaṃ vimumucus tam ṛtvija ūcuḥ | mamaivāyaṃ putro 'stv iti tān ha na saṃpede | te saṃpādayāmāsuḥ | eṣa eva yaṃ kāmayet tasya putro 'stv iti | tasya ha viśvāmitro hotāsīt tasya putratvam iyāya |
meaning: शुनःशेपो वै यूपे नियुक्तो देवतास् तुष्टाव । तस्येह देवताः पाशं विमुमुचुस् तम् ऋत्विज ऊचुः । ममैवायं पुत्रो ऽस्त्व् इति तान् ह न संपेदे । ते संपादयामासुः । एष एव यं कामयेत् तस्य पुत्रो ऽस्त्व् इति । तस्य ह विश्वामित्रो होतासीत् तस्य पुत्रत्वम् इयाय ।
text: 'Sunaḥs epa, forsooth, when tied to the sacrificial stake, praised the gods; there the gods loosened his bonds. To him poke (each of) the officiating priests, "He shall be my son." He did not agree to their (request. Then) they made him make (this) agreement, "He shall be the son of him whom he chooses." Viśvāmitra was the Hot ri priest at that (sacrifice). He became his son.'

sanskrit_iast: apaviddhaḥ pañcamaḥ |
meaning: अपविद्धः पञ्चमः ।
text: The son cast off is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ mātāpitṛbhyām apāstaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: यं मातापितृभ्याम् अपास्तं प्रतिगृह्णीयात् ।
text: (He is called so) who, cast off by his father and his mother, is received (as a son).

sanskrit_iast: śūdrāputra eva ṣaṣṭho bhavatīty āhur ity etedāyādabāndhavāḥ |
meaning: शूद्रापुत्र एव षष्ठो भवतीत्य् आहुर् इत्य् एतेदायादबान्धवाः ।
text: They declare that the son of a woman of the Śūdra caste is the sixth. These (six) are kinsmen, not heirs.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | yasya pūrveṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ na kaścid dāyādaḥ syād ete tasya dāyaṃ harerann iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । यस्य पूर्वेषां षण्णां न कश्चिद् दायादः स्याद् एते तस्य दायं हरेरन्न् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following rule): 'These (last-mentioned) six (sons) shall take the heritage of him who has no heir belonging to the first-mentioned six (classes).

sanskrit_iast: atha bhrātṝṇāṃ dāyavibhāgaḥ |
meaning: अथ भ्रातॄणां दायविभागः ।
text: Now (follow the rules regarding) the partition of the (paternal) estate among brothers:

sanskrit_iast: yaś cānapatyās tāsām ā putralābhāt |
meaning: यश् चानपत्यास् तासाम् आ पुत्रलाभात् ।
text: And (let it be delayed) until those (widows) who have no offspring, (but are supposed to be pregnant), bear sons.

sanskrit_iast: dvyaṃśaṃ jyeṣṭho haret |
meaning: द्व्यंशं ज्येष्ठो हरेत् ।
text: Let the eldest take a double share,

sanskrit_iast: gavāśvasya cānudaśamam |
meaning: गवाश्वस्य चानुदशमम् ।
text: And a tithe of the kine and horses.

sanskrit_iast: ajāvayo gṛhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhasya |
meaning: अजावयो गृहं च कनिष्ठस्य ।
text: The goats, the sheep, and the house belong to the youngest,

sanskrit_iast: kārṣṇāyasaṃ guhopakaraṇāni ca madhyamasya |
meaning: कार्ष्णायसं गुहोपकरणानि च मध्यमस्य ।
text: Black iron, the utensils, and the furniture to the middlemost.

sanskrit_iast: mātuḥ pāriṇeyaṃ striyo vibhajeran |
meaning: मातुः पारिणेयं स्त्रियो विभजेरन् ।
text: Let the daughters divide the nuptial present of their mother.

sanskrit_iast: yadi brāhmaṇasya brāhmaṇīkṣatriyāvaiśyāsu putrāḥ syuḥ |
meaning: यदि ब्राह्मणस्य ब्राह्मणीक्षत्रियावैश्यासु पुत्राः स्युः ।
text: If a Brāhmaṇa has issue by wives belonging to the Brāhmaṇa, Kshatriya, and Vaiśya classes respectively,

sanskrit_iast: tryaṃśaṃ brāhmaṇyāḥ putro haret |
meaning: त्र्यंशं ब्राह्मण्याः पुत्रो हरेत् ।
text: The son of the Brāhmaṇa wife shall receive three shares,

sanskrit_iast: dvyaṃśaṃ rājanyāyāḥ putraḥ |
meaning: द्व्यंशं राजन्यायाः पुत्रः ।
text: The son of the Kshatriya wife two shares,

sanskrit_iast: samam itare vibhajeran |
meaning: समम् इतरे विभजेरन् ।
text: The other (sons) shall inherit equal shares.

sanskrit_iast: yena caiṣāṃ svayam utpāditaṃ syād dvyaṃśam eva haret |
meaning: येन चैषां स्वयम् उत्पादितं स्याद् द्व्यंशम् एव हरेत् ।
text: And if one of the (brothers) has gained something by his own (effort), he shall receive a double share.

sanskrit_iast: anaṃśās tv āśramāntaragatāḥ |
meaning: अनंशास् त्व् आश्रमान्तरगताः ।
text: But those who have entered a different order receive no share,

sanskrit_iast: klībonmattapatitāś ca |
meaning: क्लीबोन्मत्तपतिताश् च ।
text: Nor (those who are) eunuchs, madmen, or outcasts.

sanskrit_iast: bharaṇaṃ klībonmattānām |
meaning: भरणं क्लीबोन्मत्तानाम् ।
text: Eunuchs and madmen (have a claim to) maintenance.

sanskrit_iast: pretapatnī ṣaḍmāsān vratacāriṇy akṣāralavaṇaṃ bhuñjānādhaḥ śayīta |
meaning: प्रेतपत्नी षड्मासान् व्रतचारिण्य् अक्षारलवणं भुञ्जानाधः शयीत ।
text: The widow of a deceased person shall sleep on the ground during six months, practising religious vows and abstaining from pungent condiments and salt.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍbhyo māsebhyaḥ snāttvā śrāddhaṃ ca patye dattvā vidyākarmaguruyonisaṃbandhān saṃnipātya pitā bhrātā vā niyogaṃ kārayet |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं षड्भ्यो मासेभ्यः स्नात्त्वा श्राद्धं च पत्ये दत्त्वा विद्याकर्मगुरुयोनिसंबन्धान् संनिपात्य पिता भ्राता वा नियोगं कारयेत् ।
text: After the completion of six months she shall bathe, and offer a funeral oblation to her husband. (Then) her father or her brother shall assemble the Gurus who taught or sacrificed (for the deceased) and his relatives, and shall appoint her (to raise issue to her deceased husband).

sanskrit_iast: na sonmādām avaśāṃ vyādhitāṃ vā niyuñjyāt |
meaning: न सोन्मादाम् अवशां व्याधितां वा नियुञ्ज्यात् ।
text: Let him not appoint a (widow who is) mad, ill-conducted, or diseased,

sanskrit_iast: jyāyasīm api |
meaning: ज्यायसीम् अपि ।
text: Nor one who is very aged.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśa varṣāṇi |
meaning: षोडश वर्षाणि ।
text: Sixteen years (after maturity is the period for appointing a widow);

sanskrit_iast: na ced āmayāvī syāt |
meaning: न चेद् आमयावी स्यात् ।
text: Nor (shall an appointment be made) if the (male entitled to approach the widow) is sickly.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatye muhūrte pāṇigrāhavad upacared anyatra samprahāsya vācpāruṣyadaṇḍapāruṣyāc ca |
meaning: प्रजापत्ये मुहूर्ते पाणिग्राहवद् उपचरेद् अन्यत्र सम्प्रहास्य वाच्पारुष्यदण्डपारुष्याच् च ।
text: Let him approach (the widow) in the muhūarta sacred to. Pra g āpati, (behaving) like a husband, without (amorously) dallying with her, and without abusing or ill-treating her.

sanskrit_iast: grāsācchādanasnānānulepaneṣu prāggāminī syāt |
meaning: ग्रासाच्छादनस्नानानुलेपनेषु प्राग्गामिनी स्यात् ।
text: Let her obtain (the expenses for) food, raiment, baths, and unguents from (the estate of) her former (husband).

sanskrit_iast: aniyuktāyām utpanna utpādayituḥ putro bhavatīty āhuḥ |
meaning: अनियुक्तायाम् उत्पन्न उत्पादयितुः पुत्रो भवतीत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that a son begotten on (a widow who has) not been (duly) appointed, belongs to the begetter.

sanskrit_iast: syāc cen niyoginoḥ |
meaning: स्याच् चेन् नियोगिनोः ।
text: If she was (appointed, the child belongs) to both the males connected with the appointment.

sanskrit_iast: rikthalobhān nāsti niyogaḥ |
meaning: रिक्थलोभान् नास्ति नियोगः ।
text: No appointment (shall be made) through a desire to obtain the estate.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittaṃ vāpy upadiśya niyuñjyād ity eke |
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तं वाप्य् उपदिश्य नियुञ्ज्याद् इत्य् एके ।

sanskrit_iast: kumāry ṛtumatī trīṇi varṣāṇy upāsīta |
meaning: कुमार्य् ऋतुमती त्रीणि वर्षाण्य् उपासीत ।

sanskrit_iast: tribhyo varṣebhyaḥ patiṃ vindet tulyam |
meaning: त्रिभ्यो वर्षेभ्यः पतिं विन्देत् तुल्यम् ।
text: After three years (have passed), she may take a. husband of equal caste.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | pituḥ pramādāt tu yadīha kanyā vayaḥpramāṇaṃ samatītya dīyate | sā hanti dātāram udīkṣamāṇā kālātiriktā gurudakṣiṇeva |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पितुः प्रमादात् तु यदीह कन्या वयःप्रमाणं समतीत्य दीयते । सा हन्ति दातारम् उदीक्षमाणा कालातिरिक्ता गुरुदक्षिणेव ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses) But if through a father's negligence a maiden is here given away after the suitable age has passed, she who was waiting (for a husband) destroys him who gives her away, just as the fee which is paid too late to the teacher (destroys the pupil).'

sanskrit_iast: prayacchen nagnikāṃ kanyām ṛtukālabhayāt pitā | ṛtumatyāṃ hi tiṣṭhantyāṃ doṣaḥ pitaram ṛcchati |
meaning: प्रयच्छेन् नग्निकां कन्याम् ऋतुकालभयात् पिता । ऋतुमत्यां हि तिष्ठन्त्यां दोषः पितरम् ऋच्छति ।
text: 'Out of fear of the appearance of the menses let the father marry his daughter while she still runs about naked. For if she stays (in the house) after the age of puberty, sin falls on the father.'

sanskrit_iast: yāvantaḥ kanyām ṛtavaḥ spṛśanti tulyaiḥ sakāmām abhiyācyamānām | bhrūṇāni tāvanti hatāni tābhyāṃ mātāpitṛbhyām iti dharmavādaḥ |
meaning: यावन्तः कन्याम् ऋतवः स्पृशन्ति तुल्यैः सकामाम् अभियाच्यमानाम् । भ्रूणानि तावन्ति हतानि ताभ्यां मातापितृभ्याम् इति धर्मवादः ।
text: 'As often as the courses of a maiden, who is filled with desire, and demanded in marriage by men of equal caste, recur, so often her father and her mother are guilty of (the crime of) slaying an embryo; that is a rule of the sacred law.'

sanskrit_iast: adbhir vācā ca dattāyāṃ mriyetādau varo yadi | na ca mantropanītā syāt kumārī pitur eva sā |
meaning: अद्भिर् वाचा च दत्तायां म्रियेतादौ वरो यदि । न च मन्त्रोपनीता स्यात् कुमारी पितुर् एव सा ।
text: 'If the betrothed of a maiden die after she has been promised to him verbally, and by (a libation of) water, but before she was married with (the recitation of) sacred texts, she belongs to her father alone.'

sanskrit_iast: balāc cet prahṛtā kanyā mantrair yadi na saṃskṛtā | anyasmai vidhivad deyā yathā kanyā tathaiva sā |
meaning: बलाच् चेत् प्रहृता कन्या मन्त्रैर् यदि न संस्कृता । अन्यस्मै विधिवद् देया यथा कन्या तथैव सा ।
text: 'If a damsel has been abducted by force, and not been wedded with sacred texts, she may lawfully be given to another man; she is even like a maiden.'

sanskrit_iast: pāṇigrāhe mṛte bālā kevalaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtā | sā ced akṣatayoniḥ syāt punaḥ saṃskāram arhatīti |
meaning: पाणिग्राहे मृते बाला केवलं मन्त्रसंस्कृता । सा चेद् अक्षतयोनिः स्यात् पुनः संस्कारम् अर्हतीति ।
text: 'If a damsel at the death of her husband had been merely wedded by (the recitation of) sacred texts, and if the marriage had not been consummated, she may be married again.'

sanskrit_iast: proṣitapatnī pañca varṣāṇy upāsīta |
meaning: प्रोषितपत्नी पञ्च वर्षाण्य् उपासीत ।
text: The wife of an emigrant shall wait for five years.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pañcabhyo varṣebhyo bhartṛsakāśaṃ gacchet |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पञ्चभ्यो वर्षेभ्यो भर्तृसकाशं गच्छेत् ।
text: After five years (have passed), she may go (to seek) her husband.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dharmārthābhyāṃ pravāsaṃ pratyanukāmā na syād yathā preta evaṃ vartitavyaṃ syāt |
meaning: यदि धर्मार्थाभ्यां प्रवासं प्रत्यनुकामा न स्याद् यथा प्रेत एवं वर्तितव्यं स्यात् ।
text: If for reasons connected with spiritual or with money matters she be unwilling to leave her home, she must act in the same manner as if (her husband were) dead.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ brāhmaṇī pañca prajātāprajātā catvāri rājanyā prajātā pañcāprajātā trīṇi vaiśyā prajātā catvāry aprajātā dve śūdrā prajātā trīṇy aprajātaikam |
meaning: एवं ब्राह्मणी पञ्च प्रजाताप्रजाता चत्वारि राजन्या प्रजाता पञ्चाप्रजाता त्रीणि वैश्या प्रजाता चत्वार्य् अप्रजाता द्वे शूद्रा प्रजाता त्रीण्य् अप्रजातैकम् ।
text: In this manner a wife of the Brāhmaṇa caste who has issue (shall wait) five years, and one who has no issue, four years; a wife of the Kshatriya caste who has issue, five years, and one who has no issue, three years; a wife of the Vaiśya caste who has issue, four years, and one who has no issue, two years; a wife of the Śūdra caste who has issue, three years, and one who has no issue, one year.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ samānārthajanmapiṇḍodakagotrāṇāṃ pūrvaḥ pūrvo garīyān |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं समानार्थजन्मपिण्डोदकगोत्राणां पूर्वः पूर्वो गरीयान् ।
text: After that among those who are united (with her husband) in interest, or by birth, or by the funeral cake, or by libations of water, or by descent from the same family, each earlier named person is more venerable than the following ones.

sanskrit_iast: na tu khalu kulīne vidyamāne paragāminī syāt |
meaning: न तु खलु कुलीने विद्यमाने परगामिनी स्यात् ।
text: But while a member of her family is living, she shall certainly not go to a stranger.

sanskrit_iast: yasya pūrveṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ na kaścid dāyādaḥ syāt sapiṇḍāḥ putrasthānīyās vā tasya dhanaṃ vibhajeran |
meaning: यस्य पूर्वेषां षण्णां न कश्चिद् दायादः स्यात् सपिण्डाः पुत्रस्थानीयास् वा तस्य धनं विभजेरन् ।
text: Let the Sapiṇd as or the subsidiary sons divide the heritage of him who has no heir of the first-mentioned six kinds.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām alābha ācāryāntevāsinau hareyātām |
meaning: तेषाम् अलाभ आचार्यान्तेवासिनौ हरेयाताम् ।
text: On failure of them the spiritual teacher and a pupil shall take the inheritance.

sanskrit_iast: tayor alābhe rājā haret |
meaning: तयोर् अलाभे राजा हरेत् ।
text: On failure of those two the king inherits.

sanskrit_iast: na tu brāhmaṇasya rājā haret |
meaning: न तु ब्राह्मणस्य राजा हरेत् ।
text: But let the king not take (the estate) of a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: brahmasvaṃ tu viṣaṃ ghoram |
meaning: ब्रह्मस्वं तु विषं घोरम् ।
text: For the property of a Brāhmaṇa is a terrible poison.

sanskrit_iast: na viṣaṃ viṣam ity āhur brahmasvaṃ viṣam ucyate | viṣam ekākinaṃ hanti brahmasvaṃ putrapautrakam iti |
meaning: न विषं विषम् इत्य् आहुर् ब्रह्मस्वं विषम् उच्यते । विषम् एकाकिनं हन्ति ब्रह्मस्वं पुत्रपौत्रकम् इति ।
text: 'Poison they do not call the (worst) poison; the property of a Brāhmaṇa is said to be the (most destructive) poison. Poison destroys only one person, but the property of a Brāhmaṇa (him who takes it) together with sons and grandsons.'

sanskrit_iast: traividyasādhubhyaḥ saṃprayacchet saṃprayacched iti |
meaning: त्रैविद्यसाधुभ्यः संप्रयच्छेत् संप्रयच्छेद् इति ।
text: He should give it to men who are well versed in the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: śūdreṇa brāhmaṇyām utpannaś cāṇḍālo bhavatīty āhuḥ |
meaning: शूद्रेण ब्राह्मण्याम् उत्पन्नश् चाण्डालो भवतीत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that the offspring of a Śūdra and of a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste becomes a K āṇd āla,

sanskrit_iast: rājanyāyāṃ vaiṇaḥ |
meaning: राजन्यायां वैणः ।
text: (That of a Śūdra and) of a female of the Kshatriya caste, a Vaiṇa,

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyāyām antyāvasāyī |
meaning: वैश्यायाम् अन्त्यावसायी ।
text: (That of a Śūdra and) of a female of the Vaiśya caste, an Antyāvasāyin.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyena brāhmaṇyām utpanno rāmako bhavatīty āhuḥ |
meaning: वैश्येन ब्राह्मण्याम् उत्पन्नो रामको भवतीत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that the (son) begotten by a Vaiśya on a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste becomes a Rāmaka,

sanskrit_iast: rājanyāyāṃ pulkasaḥ |
meaning: राजन्यायां पुल्कसः ।
text: (The son begotten by the same) on a female of the Kshatriya caste, a Pulkasa.

sanskrit_iast: rājanyena brāhmaṇyām utpannaḥ sūto bhavatīty āhuḥ |
meaning: राजन्येन ब्राह्मण्याम् उत्पन्नः सूतो भवतीत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that the (son) begotten by a Kshatriya on a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste becomes a Sūta.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | channotpannāś ca ye kecit prātilomyaguṇāśritāḥ | guṇācāraparibhraṃśāt karmabhis tān vijānīyuriti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । छन्नोत्पन्नाश् च ये केचित् प्रातिलोम्यगुणाश्रिताः । गुणाचारपरिभ्रंशात् कर्मभिस् तान् विजानीयुरिति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'One may know by their deeds those who have been begotten secretly, and to whom the stigma of springing from unions in the inverse order of the castes attaches, because they are destitute of virtue and good conduct.'

sanskrit_iast: ekāntarādvyantarātryantarāsu jātā brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyair ambaṣṭhograniṣādā bhavanti |
meaning: एकान्तराद्व्यन्तरात्र्यन्तरासु जाता ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियवैश्यैर् अम्बष्ठोग्रनिषादा भवन्ति ।
text: (Children) begotten by Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, and Vaiśyas on females of the next lower, second lower, and third lower castes become (respectively) Ambash th as, Ugras, and Nishādas.

sanskrit_iast: śūdrāṇāṃ pāraśavaḥ |
meaning: शूद्राणां पारशवः ।
text: (The son of a Brāhmaṇa and) of a Śūdra woman (is) a Pāraśava.

sanskrit_iast: pāraśavo neva jīvann eva śavo bhavatīty āhuḥ |
meaning: पारशवो नेव जीवन्न् एव शवो भवतीत्य् आहुः ।
text: They declare that the condition of a Pāraśava is that of one who, though living, is (as impure) as a corpse.

sanskrit_iast: eke vā etac chmaśānaṃ ye śūdrāḥ |
meaning: एके वा एतच् छ्मशानं ये शूद्राः ।
text: Some call that Śūdra race a burial-ground.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāc chūdrasamīpe nādhyetavyam |
meaning: तस्माच् छूद्रसमीपे नाध्येतव्यम् ।
text: Therefore (the Veda) must not be recited in the presence of a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: athāpi yamagītāñ ślokān udāharanti | śmaśānam etat pratyakṣaṃ ye śūdrāḥ pāpacāriṇaḥ | tasmāc chūdrasamīpe tu nādhyetavyaṃ kadācana |
meaning: अथापि यमगीताञ् श्लोकान् उदाहरन्ति । श्मशानम् एतत् प्रत्यक्षं ये शूद्राः पापचारिणः । तस्माच् छूद्रसमीपे तु नाध्येतव्यं कदाचन ।
text: Now they quote also the (following) verses, which Yama proclaimed: 'The wicked Śūdra-race is manifestly a burial-ground. Therefore (the Veda) must never be recited in the presence of a Śūdra.'

sanskrit_iast: na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyān nocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam | na cāsyopadiśed dharmaṃ na cāsya vratam ādiśet |
meaning: न शूद्राय मतिं दद्यान् नोच्छिष्टं न हविष्कृतम् । न चास्योपदिशेद् धर्मं न चास्य व्रतम् आदिशेत् ।
text: 'Let him not give advice to a Śūdra, nor what remains from his table, nor (remnants of) offerings (to the gods); nor let him explain the holy law to such a man, nor order him (to perform) a penance.'

sanskrit_iast: yaś cāsyopadiśed dharmaṃ yaś cāsya vratam ādiśet | so 'saṃvṛttaṃ tamo ghoraṃ saha tena prapadyata iti |
meaning: यश् चास्योपदिशेद् धर्मं यश् चास्य व्रतम् आदिशेत् । सो ऽसंवृत्तं तमो घोरं सह तेन प्रपद्यत इति ।
text: 'He who declares the law to such a man, and he who instructs him in (the mode of) expiating (sin), sinks together with that very man into the dreadful hell, (called) Asaṃv ri ta.'

sanskrit_iast: vraṇadvāre kṛmir yasya saṃbhaveta kadācana | prājāpatyena śudhyeta hiraṇyaṃ gaur vāso dakṣiṇā iti |
meaning: व्रणद्वारे कृमिर् यस्य संभवेत कदाचन । प्राजापत्येन शुध्येत हिरण्यं गौर् वासो दक्षिणा इति ।
text: 'If ever a worm is produced in an open wound (on his body), he shall purify himself by the Prā g āpatya penance, and give gold, a cow, (and) a garment as presents (to Brāhmaṇas).'

sanskrit_iast: nāgniṃ citvā rāmām upeyāt |
meaning: नाग्निं चित्वा रामाम् उपेयात् ।
text: Let him not approach a wife of the Śūdra caste after he has built the fire-altar for a Śrauta-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇavarṇā yā rāmā ramaṇāyaiva na dharmāya na dharmāyeti |
meaning: कृष्णवर्णा या रामा रमणायैव न धर्माय न धर्मायेति ।
text: For a Śūdra-wife who belongs to the black race, (is espoused) for pleasure, not in order to fulfil the law.

sanskrit_iast: svadharmo rājñaḥ pālanaṃ bhūtānāṃ tasyānuṣṭhānāt siddhiḥ |
meaning: स्वधर्मो राज्ञः पालनं भूतानां तस्यानुष्ठानात् सिद्धिः ।
text: The particular duty of a king is to protect (all) beings; by fulfilling it (he obtains) success (in this world and in the next).

sanskrit_iast: bhayakāruṇyahānaṃ jarāmaryaṃ vā etat satttram āhur vidvāṃsaḥ |
meaning: भयकारुण्यहानं जरामर्यं वा एतत् सत्त्त्रम् आहुर् विद्वांसः ।
text: Those learned (in the sacred law) declare that to be free from fear and pity is, indeed, a life-long sacrificial session (sattra, to be performed by the king).

sanskrit_iast: tasmād gārhasthyanaiyamikeṣu purohitaṃ dadhyāt |
meaning: तस्माद् गार्हस्थ्यनैयमिकेषु पुरोहितं दध्यात् ।
text: Therefore let him appoint a domestic priest to (perform the rites) obligatory on the order of householders.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate | brahmapurohitaṃ rāṣṭram ṛdhnotīti |
meaning: विज्ञायते । ब्रह्मपुरोहितं राष्ट्रम् ऋध्नोतीति ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, 'A realm where a Brāhmaṇa is appointed domestic priest, prospers;'

sanskrit_iast: ubhayasya pālanāt |
meaning: उभयस्य पालनात् ।
text: For thus both (the special duties of a king and those of a householder) will be fulfilled,

sanskrit_iast: asāmarthyāc ca |
meaning: असामर्थ्याच् च ।
text: And (the king alone is) unable (to do both).

sanskrit_iast: deśadharmajātikuladharmān sarvān evaitān anupraviśya rājā caturo varṇān svadharme sthāpayet |
meaning: देशधर्मजातिकुलधर्मान् सर्वान् एवैतान् अनुप्रविश्य राजा चतुरो वर्णान् स्वधर्मे स्थापयेत् ।
text: Let the king, paying attention to all the laws of countries, (subdivisions of) castes ( g āti) and families, make the four castes (varṇa) fulfil their (respective) particular duties.

sanskrit_iast: teṣv apacaratsu daṇḍaṃ dhārayet |
meaning: तेष्व् अपचरत्सु दण्डं धारयेत् ।
text: Let him punish those who stray from (the path of duty).

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍas tu deśakāladharmavayovidyāsthānaviśeṣair hiṃsākrośayoḥ kalpyaḥ |
meaning: दण्डस् तु देशकालधर्मवयोविद्यास्थानविशेषैर् हिंसाक्रोशयोः कल्प्यः ।

sanskrit_iast: āgamād dṛṣṭāntāc ca |
meaning: आगमाद् दृष्टान्ताच् च ।

sanskrit_iast: puṣpaphalopagān pādapān na hiṃsyāt |
meaning: पुष्पफलोपगान् पादपान् न हिंस्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: karṣaṇakāraṇārthaṃ copahanyāt |
meaning: कर्षणकारणार्थं चोपहन्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: gārhasthyāṅgānāṃ ca mānonmāne rakṣite syātām |
meaning: गार्हस्थ्याङ्गानां च मानोन्माने रक्षिते स्याताम् ।

sanskrit_iast: adhiṣṭhānān na nīhāraḥ svārthānām |
meaning: अधिष्ठानान् न नीहारः स्वार्थानाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: mānamūlyamātraṃ naihārikaṃ syāt |
meaning: मानमूल्यमात्रं नैहारिकं स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: mahāmahayoḥ sthānāt pathaḥ syāt |
meaning: महामहयोः स्थानात् पथः स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃyāne daśavāhavāhinī dviguṇakāriṇī syāt |
meaning: संयाने दशवाहवाहिनी द्विगुणकारिणी स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: pratyekaṃ prapāḥ syuḥ |
meaning: प्रत्येकं प्रपाः स्युः ।

sanskrit_iast: puṃṣāṃ śatāvarārdhyaṃ cāhavayet |
meaning: पुंषां शतावरार्ध्यं चाहवयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: avyarthāḥ striyaḥ syuḥ |
meaning: अव्यर्थाः स्त्रियः स्युः ।

sanskrit_iast: karāṣṭhīlā māṣaḥ śaramadhyāpaḥ pādaḥ kārṣāpaṇāḥ syuḥ |
meaning: कराष्ठीला माषः शरमध्यापः पादः कार्षापणाः स्युः ।

sanskrit_iast: nirudakas taro moṣyaḥ |
meaning: निरुदकस् तरो मोष्यः ।
text: A ferry shall be taken away (from a river) in which there is no water.

sanskrit_iast: akaraḥ śrotriyo rājapumān anāthapravrajitabālavṛddhataruṇaprajātāḥ |
meaning: अकरः श्रोत्रियो राजपुमान् अनाथप्रव्रजितबालवृद्धतरुणप्रजाताः ।
text: A Śrotriya is free from taxes, (and so are) a servant of the king, one who has no protector, one who has left (the order of householders), an infant, a very aged man, a young man (who studies), and pradātās;

sanskrit_iast: prāggāmikāḥ kumāryo bhṛtapatnyaś ca |
meaning: प्राग्गामिकाः कुमार्यो भृतपत्न्यश् च ।
text: (Moreover widows) who return to their former (family), unmarried maidens, and the wives of servants,

sanskrit_iast: bāhubhyām uttarañ śataguṇaṃ dadyāt |
meaning: बाहुभ्याम् उत्तरञ् शतगुणं दद्यात् ।
text: He who swims with his arms (across a river in order to escape payment of a toll at a ferry) shall pay one hundred times (the amount due).

sanskrit_iast: nadīkakṣavanadāhaśailopabhogā niṣkarāḥ syuḥ |
meaning: नदीकक्षवनदाहशैलोपभोगा निष्कराः स्युः ।
text: No taxes (shall be paid) on the usufruct of rivers, dry grass, forests, (places of) combustion, and mountains;

sanskrit_iast: tadupajīvino vā dadyuḥ |
meaning: तदुपजीविनो वा दद्युः ।
text: Or those who draw their subsistence from them may pay (something),

sanskrit_iast: pratimāsam udvāhakaraṃ tv āgamayet |
meaning: प्रतिमासम् उद्वाहकरं त्व् आगमयेत् ।
text: But he shall take a monthly tax from artisans.

sanskrit_iast: rājani ca prete dadyāt prāsaṅgikam |
meaning: राजनि च प्रेते दद्यात् प्रासङ्गिकम् ।
text: And when a king has died, let him give what is required for the occasion.

sanskrit_iast: etena mātṛvṛttir vyākhyātā |
meaning: एतेन मातृवृत्तिर् व्याख्याता ।
text: It is hereby explained that (his) mother (must receive) maintenance.

sanskrit_iast: rājamahiṣyāḥ pitṛvyamātulān rājā bibhṛyāt |
meaning: राजमहिष्याः पितृव्यमातुलान् राजा बिभृयात् ।
text: Let the king maintain the paternal and maternal uncles of the chief-queen,

sanskrit_iast: tadbandhūṃś cānyāṃś ca |
meaning: तद्बन्धूंश् चान्यांश् च ।
text: As well as her other relatives.

sanskrit_iast: rājapatnyo grāsācchādanaṃ labheran |
meaning: राजपत्न्यो ग्रासाच्छादनं लभेरन् ।
text: The wives of the (deceased) king shall receive food and raiment,

sanskrit_iast: anicchantyo vā pravrajeran |
meaning: अनिच्छन्त्यो वा प्रव्रजेरन् ।
text: Or if they are unwilling, they may depart.

sanskrit_iast: klībonmattān rājā bibhṛyāt |
meaning: क्लीबोन्मत्तान् राजा बिभृयात् ।
text: Let the king maintain eunuchs and madmen,

sanskrit_iast: tadgāmitvād rikthasya |
meaning: तद्गामित्वाद् रिक्थस्य ।
text: Since their property goes to him.

sanskrit_iast: śulke cāpi mānavaṃ ślokam udāharanti | na bhinnakārṣāpaṇam asti śulke na śilpavṛtto na śiśau na dūte | na bhaikṣalabdhe na hṛtāvaśeṣe na śrotriye pravrajite na yajña iti |
meaning: शुल्के चापि मानवं श्लोकम् उदाहरन्ति । न भिन्नकार्षापणम् अस्ति शुल्के न शिल्पवृत्तो न शिशौ न दूते । न भैक्षलब्धे न हृतावशेषे न श्रोत्रिये प्रव्रजिते न यज्ञ इति ।
text: Now they quote also a verse proclaimed by Manu, which refers to duties and. taxes, 'No duty (is paid) on a sum less than a Karshāpaṇa, there is no tax on a livelihood gained by art, nor on an infant, nor on a messenger, nor on what has been received as alms, nor on the remnants of property left after a robbery, nor on a Śrotriya, nor on an ascetic, nor on a sacrifice.'

sanskrit_iast: steno 'nupraveśān na duṣyate |
meaning: स्तेनो ऽनुप्रवेशान् न दुष्यते ।
text: A thief becomes free from guilt by entering (the royal presence) after (his deed and asking to be punished).

sanskrit_iast: śastradhārī sahoḍho vraṇasaṃpanno vyapadiṣṭas tv ekeṣām |
meaning: शस्त्रधारी सहोढो व्रणसंपन्नो व्यपदिष्टस् त्व् एकेषाम् ।
text: But according to some (lawyers) he (who is caught) with weapons in his hands, with stolen goods in his possession, or covered with wounds is proved (to be a criminal).

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍyotsarge rājaikarātram upavaset |
meaning: दण्ड्योत्सर्गे राजैकरात्रम् उपवसेत् ।
text: In case (a criminal) worthy of punishment is allowed to go free, the king shall fast during one (day and one) night;

sanskrit_iast: trirātraṃ purohitaḥ |
meaning: त्रिरात्रं पुरोहितः ।
text: (And) his domestic priest during three (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchram adaṇḍyadaṇḍane purohitaḥ |
meaning: कृच्छ्रम् अदण्ड्यदण्डने पुरोहितः ।
text: If an innocent man is punished, the domestic priest (shall perform) a K ri k kh ra penance;

sanskrit_iast: trirātraṃ rājā |
meaning: त्रिरात्रं राजा ।
text: (And) the king (shall fast) during three (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | annāde bhrūṇahā mārṣṭiḥ patyau bhāryāpacāriṇī | gurau śiṣyaś ca yājyaś ca steno rājani kilbiṣam |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अन्नादे भ्रूणहा मार्ष्टिः पत्यौ भार्यापचारिणी । गुरौ शिष्यश् च याज्यश् च स्तेनो राजनि किल्बिषम् ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'The slayer of a learned Brāhmaṇa casts his guilt on him who eats his food; an adulterous wife on her (negligent) husband; a student and a sacrificer on an (ignorant) teacher (and officiating priest); and a thief on the king (who pardons him).'

sanskrit_iast: rājabhir dhṛtadaṇḍās tu kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ | nirmalāḥ svargam āyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā |
meaning: राजभिर् धृतदण्डास् तु कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः । निर्मलाः स्वर्गम् आयान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा ।
text: 'But men who have committed offences and have received from kings the punishment (due to them), go pure to heaven, and (become) as holy as the virtuous.'

sanskrit_iast: eno rājānam ṛcchati utsṛjantaṃ sakilbiṣam | taṃ ced vā ghātayed rājā hanti dharmeṇa duṣkṛtam iti |
meaning: एनो राजानम् ऋच्छति उत्सृजन्तं सकिल्बिषम् । तं चेद् वा घातयेद् राजा हन्ति धर्मेण दुष्कृतम् इति ।
text: 'The guilt falls on the king who pardons an offender. If he causes him to be slain, he destroys sin in accordance with the sacred law.'

sanskrit_iast: rājñām ātyayike kārye sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate | tathā nātyayike nityaṃ kāla evātra kāraṇam iti |
meaning: राज्ञाम् आत्ययिके कार्ये सद्यः शौचं विधीयते । तथा नात्ययिके नित्यं काल एवात्र कारणम् इति ।
text: 'It is ordained that kings become at once pure (by bathing) when they have done acts causing death. They are likewise (pure while engaged in business) not causing death. Time is the reason for that.'

sanskrit_iast: yamagītaṃ cātra ślokam udāharanti | nādya doṣo 'sti rājñāṃ vai vratināṃ na ca satriṇām | aindrasthānam upāsīnā brahmabhūtā hi te sadeti | hi te sadeti |
meaning: यमगीतं चात्र श्लोकम् उदाहरन्ति । नाद्य दोषो ऽस्ति राज्ञां वै व्रतिनां न च सत्रिणाम् । ऐन्द्रस्थानम् उपासीना ब्रह्मभूता हि ते सदेति । हि ते सदेति ।
text: And with reference to this (matter) they quote a verse proclaimed by Yama, 'No taint of impurity, forsooth, falls on kings, on those engaged . in practising vows, or on those engaged in the performance of sacrificial session (sattra); for (the first) are seated on the throne of Indra, (and the others) are always equal to Brahman.'

sanskrit_iast: anabhisaṃdhikṛte prāyaścittam aparādhe |
meaning: अनभिसंधिकृते प्रायश्चित्तम् अपराधे ।
text: A penance (shall be performed) for an offence committed unintentionally.

sanskrit_iast: abhisaṃdhikṛte 'py eke |
meaning: अभिसंधिकृते ऽप्य् एके ।
text: Some (declare that it shall be performed) also for (a fault) committed intentionally.

sanskrit_iast: gurur ātmavatāṃ śāstā śāstā rājā durātmanām | atha pracchann apāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yama iti |
meaning: गुरुर् आत्मवतां शास्ता शास्ता राजा दुरात्मनाम् । अथ प्रच्छन्न् अपापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यम इति ।
text: 'The spiritual teacher corrects the learned; the king corrects the evil-minded; but Yama, the son of Vivasvat, forsooth, punishes those who offend secretly.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra ca sūryābhyuditaḥ sann ahas tiṣṭhet sāvitrīṃ ca japet |
meaning: तत्र च सूर्याभ्युदितः सन्न् अहस् तिष्ठेत् सावित्रीं च जपेत् ।
text: And among those (sinful persons), let him who slept at sunrise stand during the (following) day and recite the verse sacred to Savit ri .

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ sūryābhinirmukto rātrāv āsīt |
meaning: एवं सूर्याभिनिर्मुक्तो रात्राव् आसीत् ।
text: Let him who slept at sunset remain in a sitting posture during the (next) night, likewise (reciting the Gāyatrī).

sanskrit_iast: kunakhī śyāvadantas tu kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caret |
meaning: कुनखी श्यावदन्तस् तु कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरेत् ।
text: But let a man with deformed nails or black teeth perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration.

sanskrit_iast: parivittiḥ kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā niviśeta tāṃ caivopayacchet |
meaning: परिवित्तिः कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा निविशेत तां चैवोपयच्छेत् ।
text: He whose younger brother married first shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance during twelve days, marry and take to himself even that (woman whom his brother wedded).

sanskrit_iast: atha parivividānaḥ kṛcchrātikṛcchrau caritvā tasmai dattvā punar niviśeta tāṃ caivopayacchet |
meaning: अथ परिविविदानः कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ चरित्वा तस्मै दत्त्वा पुनर् निविशेत तां चैवोपयच्छेत् ।
text: Now he who has taken a wife before his elder brother shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance and an Atik ri k kh ra penance, give (his wife) to that (elder brother), marry again, and take (back) the same (woman whom he wedded first).

sanskrit_iast: agredidhiṣūpatiḥ kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā niviśeta tāṃ copayacchet |
meaning: अग्रेदिधिषूपतिः कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा निविशेत तां चोपयच्छेत् ।
text: The husband of a younger sister married before her elder sister shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance during twelve days, marry and take to him that (elder sister).

sanskrit_iast: didhiṣūpatiḥ kṛcchrātikṛcchrau caritvā tasmai dattvā punar niviśet |
meaning: दिधिषूपतिः कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ चरित्वा तस्मै दत्त्वा पुनर् निविशेत् ।
text: The husband of an elder sister married after the younger one shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance and an Atik ri k kh ra penance, give (his wife) to that (husband of the younger sister and marry again).

sanskrit_iast: vīrahaṇaṃ parastād vakṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: वीरहणं परस्ताद् वक्ष्यामः ।
text: We shall, declare below (the penance prescribed for) him who extinguishes the sacred fire.

sanskrit_iast: brahmojjhaḥ kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā punar upayuñjīta vedam ācāryāt |
meaning: ब्रह्मोज्झः कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा पुनर् उपयुञ्जीत वेदम् आचार्यात् ।
text: He who has forgot the Veda (by neglecting to recite it daily), shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration, and again learn it from his teacher.

sanskrit_iast: gurutalpagaḥ savṛṣaṇaṃ śiśnam uddhṛtyāñjalāv ādhāya dakṣiṇāmukho gacched yatraiva pratihanyāt tatra tiṣṭhed ā pralayam |
meaning: गुरुतल्पगः सवृषणं शिश्नम् उद्धृत्याञ्जलाव् आधाय दक्षिणामुखो गच्छेद् यत्रैव प्रतिहन्यात् तत्र तिष्ठेद् आ प्रलयम् ।
text: He who violates a Guru's bed shall cut off his organ, together with the testicles, take them into his joined hands and walk towards the south wherever he meets with an obstacle (to further progress), there he shall stand until he dies:

sanskrit_iast: niṣkālako vā ghṛtābhyaktas taptāṃ sūrmīṃ pariṣvajen maraṇāt pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: निष्कालको वा घृताभ्यक्तस् तप्तां सूर्मीं परिष्वजेन् मरणात् पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: Or, having shaved all his hair and smeared his body with clarified butter, he shall embrace the heated (iron) image (of a woman). It is declared in the Veda that he is. purified after death,

sanskrit_iast: ācāryaputraśiṣyabhāryāsu caivam |
meaning: आचार्यपुत्रशिष्यभार्यासु चैवम् ।
text: The same (expiation is prescribed if the offence was committed) with the wife of the teacher, of a son, and of a pupil.

sanskrit_iast: yoniṣu gurvīṃ sakhīṃ gurusakhīm apapātraṃ patitāṃ ca gatvā kṛcchrābdapādaṃ caret |
meaning: योनिषु गुर्वीं सखीं गुरुसखीम् अपपात्रं पतितां च गत्वा कृच्छ्राब्दपादं चरेत् ।
text: If he has had intercourse with a female (who is considered) venerable in the family, with a female friend, with the female friend of a Guru, with an Apapātra female, or with an outcast, he shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance during three months.

sanskrit_iast: etad eva cāṇḍālapatitānnabhojaneṣu tataḥ punarupanayanaṃ vapanādīnāṃ tu nivṛttiḥ |
meaning: एतद् एव चाण्डालपतितान्नभोजनेषु ततः पुनरुपनयनं वपनादीनां तु निवृत्तिः ।
text: The same (penance must be performed) for eating food given by a K āṇd āla or by an outcast. Afterwards the initiation (must be performed) once more; but the tonsure and the rest may be omitted.

sanskrit_iast: mānavaṃ cātra ślokam udāharanti | vapanaṃ mekhalā daṇḍo bhaikṣacaryā vratāni ca | etāni tu nivartante punaḥsaṃskārakarmaṇīti |
meaning: मानवं चात्र श्लोकम् उदाहरन्ति । वपनं मेखला दण्डो भैक्षचर्या व्रतानि च । एतानि तु निवर्तन्ते पुनःसंस्कारकर्मणीति ।
text: And with reference to this (matter) they quote a verse proclaimed by Manu, 'The tonsure, (the tying on of) the sacred girdle, (the wearing of) a staff, and the begging of alias, these acts may be omitted on a second initiation.'

sanskrit_iast: matyā madyapāne tv asurāyāḥ surāyāś cājñāne kṛcchrātikṛcchrau ghṛtaṃ prāśya punaḥsaṃskāraś ca |
meaning: मत्या मद्यपाने त्व् असुरायाः सुरायाश् चाज्ञाने कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ घृतं प्राश्य पुनःसंस्कारश् च ।
text: If (a Brāhmaṇa) intentionally (drinks) other spirituous liquor than that distilled from rice, or if he unintentionally (drinks) spirituous liquor extracted from rice (surā), he (must perform) a K ri k kh ra and an Atik ri k kh ra, and, after eating clarified butter, be initiated again.

sanskrit_iast: mūtraśakṛcchukrābhyavahāreṣu caivam |
meaning: मूत्रशकृच्छुक्राभ्यवहारेषु चैवम् ।
text: The same (expiation is prescribed) for swallowing ordure, urine, and semen.

sanskrit_iast: madyabhāṇḍe sthitā āpo yadi kaścid dvijaḥ pibet padmodumbarabilvapalāśānām udakaṃ pītvā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati |
meaning: मद्यभाण्डे स्थिता आपो यदि कश्चिद् द्विजः पिबेत् पद्मोदुम्बरबिल्वपलाशानाम् उदकं पीत्वा त्रिरात्रेणैव शुध्यति ।
text: If a Brāhmaṇa drinks water which has stood in a vessel used for (keeping) spirituous liquor, he becomes pure by drinking, during three days, water (mixed with a decoction) of lotus, Udumbara, Bilva, and Palāśa (leaves).

sanskrit_iast: abhyāse tu surāyā agnivarṇāṃ tāṃ dvijaḥ piben maraṇāt pūto bhavatīti |
meaning: अभ्यासे तु सुराया अग्निवर्णां तां द्विजः पिबेन् मरणात् पूतो भवतीति ।
text: But a Brāhmaṇa who repeatedly (and intentionally partakes) of liquor extracted from rice, shall drink (liquor of) the same (kind) boiling hot. 'He becomes pure after death.'

sanskrit_iast: bhrūṇahanaṃ vakṣyāmo brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā bhrūṇahā bhavaty avijñātaṃ ca garbham |
meaning: भ्रूणहनं वक्ष्यामो ब्राह्मणं हत्वा भ्रूणहा भवत्य् अविज्ञातं च गर्भम् ।
text: We will declare (who must be considered) the slayer of a learned Brāhmaṇa (bhrūṇahan). He is called Bhrūṇahan who kills a Brāhmaṇa or destroys an embryo (the sex of) which is unknown.

sanskrit_iast: avijñātā hi garbhāḥ pumāṃso bhavati tatmāt puṃḥkṛtyā juhvatīti |
meaning: अविज्ञाता हि गर्भाः पुमांसो भवति तत्मात् पुंःकृत्या जुह्वतीति ।
text: 'For embryos (the sex of) which is unknown become males; therefore they offer burnt-oblations for the production of males.'

sanskrit_iast: bhrūṇahāgnim upasamādhāya juhuyād etāḥ |
meaning: भ्रूणहाग्निम् उपसमाधाय जुहुयाद् एताः ।
text: Let the slayer of a learned Brāhmaṇa kindle a fire and offer (therein the following eight oblations, consisting of portions of his own body),

sanskrit_iast: lomāni mṛtyor juhomi lomabhir mṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti prathamāṃ | tvacaṃ mṛtyor juhomi tvacā mṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti dvitīyāṃ | lohitaṃ mṛtyor juhomi lohitena mṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti tṛtīyāṃ | māṃsaṃ mṛtyor juhomi māṃsena mṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti caturthīṃ | snāvāni mṛtyor juhomi snāvabhir mṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti pañcamīṃ | medo mṛtyor juhomi medasā ṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti ṣaṣṭhīṃ | asthīni mṛtyor juhomy asthibhir mṛtyuṃ vāsaya iti saptamīṃ | majjānaṃ mṛtyor juhomi majjābhir mṛtyuṃ vāsaya ity aṣṭamīm iti |
meaning: लोमानि मृत्योर् जुहोमि लोमभिर् मृत्युं वासय इति प्रथमां । त्वचं मृत्योर् जुहोमि त्वचा मृत्युं वासय इति द्वितीयां । लोहितं मृत्योर् जुहोमि लोहितेन मृत्युं वासय इति तृतीयां । मांसं मृत्योर् जुहोमि मांसेन मृत्युं वासय इति चतुर्थीं । स्नावानि मृत्योर् जुहोमि स्नावभिर् मृत्युं वासय इति पञ्चमीं । मेदो मृत्योर् जुहोमि मेदसा ऋत्युं वासय इति षष्ठीं । अस्थीनि मृत्योर् जुहोम्य् अस्थिभिर् मृत्युं वासय इति सप्तमीं । मज्जानं मृत्योर् जुहोमि मज्जाभिर् मृत्युं वासय इत्य् अष्टमीम् इति ।
text: The first (saying), 'I offer my hair to Death, I feed Death with my hair;' the second (saying), I offer my skin to Death, I feed Death with my skin;' the third (saying), 'I offer my blood to Death, I feed Death with my blood;' the fourth (saying), I offer my flesh to Death, I feed Death with my flesh;' the fifth (saying), 'I offer my sinews to Death, I feed Death with my sinews;' the sixth (saying), 'I offer my fat to Death, I feed Death with my fat;' the seventh (saying), 'I offer my bones to Death, I feed Death with my bones;' the eighth (saying), 'I offer my marrow to Death, I feed Death with my marrow.'

sanskrit_iast: rājārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā saṃgrāme 'bhimukham ātmānaṃ ghātayet |
meaning: राजार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा संग्रामे ऽभिमुखम् आत्मानं घातयेत् ।
text: (Or) let him (fight) for the sake of the king, or for the sake of Brāhmaṇas, and let him die in battle with his face turned (to the foe).

sanskrit_iast: trir ajito vāparāddhaḥ pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate hi |
meaning: त्रिर् अजितो वापराद्धः पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते हि ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, '(A murderer) who remains thrice unvanquished or is thrice defeated (in battle) becomes pure.'

sanskrit_iast: niruktaṃ hy enaḥ kanīyo bhavatīti |
meaning: निरुक्तं ह्य् एनः कनीयो भवतीति ।
text: 'A sin which is openly proclaimed becomes smaller.'

sanskrit_iast: tathāpy udāharanti | patitaṃ patitety uktvā coraṃ coreti vā punaḥ | vacanāt tulyadoṣaḥ syān mithyā dvir doṣatāṃ vrajediti |
meaning: तथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पतितं पतितेत्य् उक्त्वा चोरं चोरेति वा पुनः । वचनात् तुल्यदोषः स्यान् मिथ्या द्विर् दोषतां व्रजेदिति ।
text: To this (effect) they quote also (the following verse): 'By saying to an outcast, "O thou outcast!" or to a thief, "O thou thief!" a man incurs a guilt as great as (that of the offender). (If he) falsely (accuses anybody of such offences), his guilt will be twice as great.'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ rājanyāṃ hatvāṣṭau varṣāṇi caret |
meaning: एवं राजन्यां हत्वाष्टौ वर्षाणि चरेत् ।
text: In like manner having slain a Kshatriya, he shall perform (a penance) during eight years,

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ vaiṣyam |
meaning: षड् वैष्यम् ।
text: For (killing) a Vaiśya during six (years),

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi śūdram |
meaning: त्रीणि शूद्रम् ।
text: For (killing) a Śūdra, during three (years),

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇīṃ cātreyīṃ hatvā savanagatau ca rājanyavaiśyau |
meaning: ब्राह्मणीं चात्रेयीं हत्वा सवनगतौ च राजन्यवैश्यौ ।
text: For killing a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste who is an Atreyī, and a Kshatriya or a Vaiśya, engaged in a sacrifice (the same penance must be performed as for killing a learned Brāhmaṇa).

sanskrit_iast: ātreyīṃ vakṣyāmo rajasvalām ṛtusnātām ātreyīm āhuḥ |
meaning: आत्रेयीं वक्ष्यामो रजस्वलाम् ऋतुस्नाताम् आत्रेयीम् आहुः ।
text: We will explain (the term) Atreyī. They declare that she who has bathed after temporary uncleanness is an Atreyī.

sanskrit_iast: atra hy eṣyadagpatyaṃ bhavatīti |
meaning: अत्र ह्य् एष्यदग्पत्यं भवतीति ।
text: 'For if (the husband) approaches her at that (time), he will have offspring.'

sanskrit_iast: anātreyīṃ rājanyahiṃsāyām |
meaning: अनात्रेयीं राजन्यहिंसायाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: rājanyāṃ vaiśyahiṃsāyām |
meaning: राजन्यां वैश्यहिंसायाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyāṃ śūdrahiṃsāyām |
meaning: वैश्यां शूद्रहिंसायाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: śūdrāṃ hatvā saṃvatsaram |
meaning: शूद्रां हत्वा संवत्सरम् ।

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasuvarṇaharaṇe prakīrya keśān rājānam abhidhāvet steno 'smi bho śāstu māṃ bhavān iti tasmai rājaudumbaraṃ śastraṃ dadyāt tenātmānaṃ pramāpayen maraṇāt pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: ब्राह्मणसुवर्णहरणे प्रकीर्य केशान् राजानम् अभिधावेत् स्तेनो ऽस्मि भो शास्तु मां भवान् इति तस्मै राजौदुम्बरं शस्त्रं दद्यात् तेनात्मानं प्रमापयेन् मरणात् पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।

sanskrit_iast: niṣkālako vā ghṛtākto gomayāgninā pādaprabhṛty ātmānam abhidāhayen maraṇāt pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: निष्कालको वा घृताक्तो गोमयाग्निना पादप्रभृत्य् आत्मानम् अभिदाहयेन् मरणात् पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: Or (such a thief) may shave off all his hair, anoint his body with clarified butter, and cause himself to be burnt from the feet upwards, in a fire of dry cowdung. It is declared in the Veda that he becomes pure after death.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | purā kālāt pramītānāṃ pāpād vividhakarmaṇām | punar āpannadehānām aṅgaṃ bhavati tac chṛṇu |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पुरा कालात् प्रमीतानां पापाद् विविधकर्मणाम् । पुनर् आपन्नदेहानाम् अङ्गं भवति तच् छृणु ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'Hear, (how) the bodies of those who having committed various crimes died a long time ago, and were (afterwards) born again, are (marked);'

sanskrit_iast: stenaḥ kunakhī bhavati śvitrī bhavati brahmahā | surāpaḥ śyāvadantas tu duścarmā gurutalpaga iti |
meaning: स्तेनः कुनखी भवति श्वित्री भवति ब्रह्महा । सुरापः श्यावदन्तस् तु दुश्चर्मा गुरुतल्पग इति ।
text: 'A thief will have deformed nails, the murderer of a Brāhmaṇa will be afflicted with white leprosy, but he who has drunk spirituous liquor will have black teeth, and the violator of his Guru's bed will suffer from skin diseases.'

sanskrit_iast: patitasaṃprayoge ca brāhmeṇa vā yaunena vā yās tebhyaḥ sakāśān mātrā upalabdhās tāsāṃ parityāgas taiś ca na saṃvaset |
meaning: पतितसंप्रयोगे च ब्राह्मेण वा यौनेन वा यास् तेभ्यः सकाशान् मात्रा उपलब्धास् तासां परित्यागस् तैश् च न संवसेत् ।
text: Property received from outcasts, after forming alliances with them either by (teaching) the Veda (and by sacrificing) or by marriage, must be relinquished. Let him not associate with such (men).

sanskrit_iast: udīciṃ diśaṃ gatvānaśnan saṃhitādhyayanam adhīyānaḥ pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: उदीचिं दिशं गत्वानश्नन् संहिताध्ययनम् अधीयानः पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda that (he who has associated with outcasts) becomes pure by reciting the Saṃhitā (of his Veda), proceeding in a northerly direction and fasting.

sanskrit_iast: tathāpy udāharanti | śarīraparitāpena tapasādhyayanena ca | mucyate pāpakṛt pāpād dānāc cāpi pramucyate | iti vijñāyate vijñāyata iti |
meaning: तथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । शरीरपरितापेन तपसाध्ययनेन च । मुच्यते पापकृत् पापाद् दानाच् चापि प्रमुच्यते । इति विज्ञायते विज्ञायत इति ।
text: They quote also (a verse) to this (effect), 'A sinner is liberated from guilt by tormenting his body, by austerities, and by reciting the Veda; he becomes also free by bestowing gifts. That has been declared in the Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: śūdraś ced brāhmaṇīm abhigacched vīraṇair veṣṭayitvā śūdram agnau prāsyed brāhmaṇyāḥ śirasi vapanaṃ kārayitvā sarpiṣā samabhyajya nagnāṃ kṛṣṇakharam āropya mahāpatham anusaṃvrājayet pūtā bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: शूद्रश् चेद् ब्राह्मणीम् अभिगच्छेद् वीरणैर् वेष्टयित्वा शूद्रम् अग्नौ प्रास्येद् ब्राह्मण्याः शिरसि वपनं कारयित्वा सर्पिषा समभ्यज्य नग्नां कृष्णखरम् आरोप्य महापथम् अनुसंव्राजयेत् पूता भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: If a Śūdra approaches a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste, (the king) shall cause the Śūdra to be tied up in Vīraṇa grass and shall throw him into a fire. He shall cause the head of the Brāhmaṇī to be shaved, and her body to be anointed with butter; placing her naked on a black donkey, he shall cause her to be conducted along the highroad. It is declared that she becomes pure (thereby).

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyaś ced brāhmaṇīm abhigacchel lohitadarbhair veṣṭayitvā vaiśyam agnau prāsyed brāhmaṇyāḥ śirasi vapanaṃ kārayitvā sarpiṣā samabhyajya nagnāṃ gaurakharam āropya mahāpatham anusaṃvrājayet pūtā bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: वैश्यश् चेद् ब्राह्मणीम् अभिगच्छेल् लोहितदर्भैर् वेष्टयित्वा वैश्यम् अग्नौ प्रास्येद् ब्राह्मण्याः शिरसि वपनं कारयित्वा सर्पिषा समभ्यज्य नग्नां गौरखरम् आरोप्य महापथम् अनुसंव्राजयेत् पूता भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: If a Vaiśya approaches a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste, (the king) shall cause the Vaiśya to be tied up in Lohita grass and shall throw him into a fire. He shall cause the head of the Brāhmaṇī to be shaved, and her body to be anointed with butter; placing her naked on a yellowish donkey, he shall cause her to be conducted along the highroad. It is declared in the Veda that she becomes pure (thereby).

sanskrit_iast: rājanyaś ced brāhmaṇīm abhigacchec charapatrair veṣṭayitvā rājanyam agnau prāsyed brāhmaṇyāḥ śirasi vapanaṃ kārayitvā sarpiṣā samabhyajya nagnāṃ śvetakharam āropya mahāpatham anusaṃvrājayet pūtā bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: राजन्यश् चेद् ब्राह्मणीम् अभिगच्छेच् छरपत्रैर् वेष्टयित्वा राजन्यम् अग्नौ प्रास्येद् ब्राह्मण्याः शिरसि वपनं कारयित्वा सर्पिषा समभ्यज्य नग्नां श्वेतखरम् आरोप्य महापथम् अनुसंव्राजयेत् पूता भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: If a Kshatriya approaches a female of the Brāhmaṇa caste, (the king) shall cause the Kshatriya to be tied up in leaves of Sara grass and shall throw him into a fire. He shall cause the head of the Brāhmaṇī to be shaved, and her body to be anointed with butter; placing her naked on a white donkey, he shall cause her to be conducted along the highroad. It is declared in the Veda that she becomes pure (thereby).

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vaiśyo rājanyāyām |
meaning: एवं वैश्यो राजन्यायाम् ।
text: A Vaiśya who offends) with a female of the Kshatriya class (shall be treated) in the same manner,

sanskrit_iast: śūdraś ca rājanyāvaiśyayoḥ |
meaning: शूद्रश् च राजन्यावैश्ययोः ।
text: And a Śūdra (who offends) with females of the Kshatriya or Vaiśya castes.

sanskrit_iast: manasā bhartur aticāre trirātraṃ yāvakaṃ kṣīrodanaṃ vā bhuñjānādhaḥ śayītordhvaṃ trirātrād apsu nimagnāyāḥ sāvitryāṣṭaśatena śirobhir juhuyāt pūtā bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: मनसा भर्तुर् अतिचारे त्रिरात्रं यावकं क्षीरोदनं वा भुञ्जानाधः शयीतोर्ध्वं त्रिरात्राद् अप्सु निमग्नायाः सावित्र्याष्टशतेन शिरोभिर् जुहुयात् पूता भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: If (a wife) has been mentally unfaithful to her husband, she shall live on barley or rice boiled in milk during three days, and sleep on the bare ground. After the three days (have expired), the (husband) shall offer eight hundred burnt-oblations, (reciting) the Sāvitrī (and the Mantra called) Śiras, while she is immersed in water. It is declared in the Veda that she becomes pure (thereby).

sanskrit_iast: vācsaṃbandha etad eva māsaṃ caritvordhvaṃ māsād apsu nimagnāyāḥ sāvitryāś caturbhir aṣṭaśataiḥ śirobhir juhuyāt pūtā bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: वाच्संबन्ध एतद् एव मासं चरित्वोर्ध्वं मासाद् अप्सु निमग्नायाः सावित्र्याश् चतुर्भिर् अष्टशतैः शिरोभिर् जुहुयात् पूता भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: If (a wife) has held an (improper) conversation (with another man), she must perform the same penance during a month. After (the expiration of) the month, (the husband) shall offer four times eight hundred burnt-oblations, (reciting) the Sāvitrī (and the Mantra called) Śiras, while she is immersed in water. It is declared in the Veda that she becomes pure (thereby).

sanskrit_iast: vyavāye tu saṃvatsaraṃ ghṛtapaṭaṃ dhārayed gomayagarte kuśaprastare vā śayītordhvaṃ saṃvatsarād apsu nimagnāyāḥ sāvitryaṣṭaśatena śirobhir juhuyāt pūtā bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: व्यवाये तु संवत्सरं घृतपटं धारयेद् गोमयगर्ते कुशप्रस्तरे वा शयीतोर्ध्वं संवत्सराद् अप्सु निमग्नायाः सावित्र्यष्टशतेन शिरोभिर् जुहुयात् पूता भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: But if (a wife) has actually committed adultery, she shall wear during a year a garment smeared with clarified butter, and sleep on a mat of Kuśa grass, or in a pit filled with cowdung. After (the expiration of) the year, (the husband) shall offer eight hundred burnt-oblations, (reciting) the Sāvitrī (and the Mantra called) Śiras, while she is immersed in water. It is declared in the Veda that she becomes pure (thereby).

sanskrit_iast: vyavāye tīrthagamane dharmebhyas tu nivartate |
meaning: व्यवाये तीर्थगमने धर्मेभ्यस् तु निवर्तते ।
text: But if she commits adultery with a Guru, she is forbidden (to assist her husband) in (the fulfilment of) his sacred duties.

sanskrit_iast: catasras tu parityājyāḥ śiṣyagā gurugā ca yā | patighnī ca viśeṣeṇa juṅgitopagatā ca yā |
meaning: चतस्रस् तु परित्याज्याः शिष्यगा गुरुगा च या । पतिघ्नी च विशेषेण जुङ्गितोपगता च या ।
text: But (these) four (wives) must be abandoned, (viz.) one who yields herself to (her husband's) pupil or to (his) Guru, and especially one who attempts the life of her lord, or who commits adultery with a man of a degraded caste.

sanskrit_iast: yā brāhmaṇī ca surāpī na tāṃ devāḥ patilokaṃ nayantīhaiva sā carati kṣīṇapuṇyāpsu lug bhavati śuktikā vā |
meaning: या ब्राह्मणी च सुरापी न तां देवाः पतिलोकं नयन्तीहैव सा चरति क्षीणपुण्याप्सु लुग् भवति शुक्तिका वा ।
text: That woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste who drinks spirituous liquor, the gods will not admit (after death) to the same abode with her husband; losing all spiritual merit she wanders about in this world and is born again as a leech or a pearl-oyster.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ striyaḥ śudreṇa saṅgatāḥ | aprajātā viśudhyanti prāyaścittena netarāḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां स्त्रियः शुद्रेण सङ्गताः । अप्रजाता विशुध्यन्ति प्रायश्चित्तेन नेतराः ।
text: The wives of Brāhmaṇas, Kshatriyas, and Vaiśyas who commit adultery with a Śūdra may be purified by a penance in case no child is born (from their adulterous intercourse), not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast: pratilomaṃ careyus tāḥ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇottaram |
meaning: प्रतिलोमं चरेयुस् ताः कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणोत्तरम् ।
text: (Those who have committed adultery) with a man of lower caste shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance, succeeded by one, two, or three K āndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: pativratānāṃ gṛhamedhinīnāṃ satyavratānāṃ ca śucivratānām | tāsāṃ tu lokāḥ patibhiḥ samānā gomāyulokā vyabhicāriṇīnām |
meaning: पतिव्रतानां गृहमेधिनीनां सत्यव्रतानां च शुचिव्रतानाम् । तासां तु लोकाः पतिभिः समाना गोमायुलोका व्यभिचारिणीनाम् ।
text: Faithful wives who are constantly pure and truthful (reside after death) in the same abodes with their husbands; those who are unfaithful are born as jackals.

sanskrit_iast: pataty ardhaṃ śarīrasya yasya bhāryā surāṃ pibet | patitārdhaśarīrasya niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate |
meaning: पतत्य् अर्धं शरीरस्य यस्य भार्या सुरां पिबेत् । पतितार्धशरीरस्य निष्कृतिर् न विधीयते ।
text: Half the body of the husband falls if his wife drinks spirituous liquor. No purification is prescribed for the half which has fallen.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaś ced aprekṣāpūrvaṃ brāhmaṇadārān abhigacched anivṛttadharmakarmaṇaḥ kṛcchro nivṛttadharmakarmaṇo 'tikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणश् चेद् अप्रेक्षापूर्वं ब्राह्मणदारान् अभिगच्छेद् अनिवृत्तधर्मकर्मणः कृच्छ्रो निवृत्तधर्मकर्मणो ऽतिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: If a Brāhmaṇa unintentionally commits adultery with the wife of a Brāhmaṇa, (he shall perform) a K ri k kh ra penance in case (the husband) fulfils the religious duties (of his caste), and an Atik ri k kh ra penance in case (the husband) does not fulfil his religious duties.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ rājanyavaiśyayoḥ |
meaning: एवं राजन्यवैश्ययोः ।
text: The same (penances are prescribed) for Kshatriyas and Vaiśyas (for adultery with women of their respective castes).

sanskrit_iast: gāṃ ced hanyāt tasyāś carmaṇārdreṇa pariveṣṭitaḥ ṣaḍmāsān kṛcchraṃ taptakṛcchraṃ vātiṣṭhet |
meaning: गां चेद् हन्यात् तस्याश् चर्मणार्द्रेण परिवेष्टितः षड्मासान् कृच्छ्रं तप्तकृच्छ्रं वातिष्ठेत् ।
text: If he kills a cow, let him perform, during six months, a K ri k kh ra or a Taptak ri k kh ra, dressed in the raw hide of that (cow).

sanskrit_iast: tayor vidhiḥ |
meaning: तयोर् विधिः ।
text: The rule for these two (penances is as follows):

sanskrit_iast: tryahaṃ divā bhuṅke naktam aśnāti vai tryaham api | tryaham ayācitavratas tryahaṃ na bhuj iti kṛcchraḥ |
meaning: त्र्यहं दिवा भुङ्के नक्तम् अश्नाति वै त्र्यहम् अपि । त्र्यहम् अयाचितव्रतस् त्र्यहं न भुज् इति कृच्छ्रः ।
text: 'During three days he eats in the day-time (only), and during the (next) three days at night (only), he subsists during (another) period of three days on food offered without asking, and (finally) he fasts during three days.' That is a K ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: tryaham uṣṇāḥ pibed āpas tryaham uṣṇaṃ payaḥ pibet | tryaham uṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣaḥ paraṃ tryaham | iti taptakṛcchraḥ |
meaning: त्र्यहम् उष्णाः पिबेद् आपस् त्र्यहम् उष्णं पयः पिबेत् । त्र्यहम् उष्णं घृतं पीत्वा वायुभक्षः परं त्र्यहम् । इति तप्तकृच्छ्रः ।
text: 'Let him drink hot water during three days; let him drink hot milk during the (next) three days; after drinking during (another) period of three days hot clarified butter, he shall subsist on air during the (last) three days.' That is a Taptak ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabhavehatau ca dadyāt |
meaning: ऋषभवेहतौ च दद्यात् ।
text: And he shall give (to a Brāhmaṇa) a bull and a cow.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | traya eva purā rogā īrṣyā anaśanaṃ jarā | pṛṣadbastavayaṃ hatvā aṣṭānavatim āharediti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । त्रय एव पुरा रोगा ईर्ष्या अनशनं जरा । पृषद्बस्तवयं हत्वा अष्टानवतिम् आहरेदिति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'Through killing a spotted deer, a he-goat, and a bird three maladies (befal men), viz. jealousy, hunger, and old age; (therefore) let him (who is guilty of such an offence) perform (a penance) during ninety-eight (days).'

sanskrit_iast: śvamārjāranakulasarpadarduramūṣkān hatvā kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caret kimcid dadyāt |
meaning: श्वमार्जारनकुलसर्पदर्दुरमूष्कान् हत्वा कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरेत् किम्चिद् दद्यात् ।
text: Having slain a dog, a cat, an ichneumon, a snake, a frog, or a rat, let him perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration, and give something (to a Brāhmaṇa).

sanskrit_iast: anasthimatāṃ tu sattvānāṃ gomātraṃ rāśiṃ hatvā kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caret kimcid dadyāt |
meaning: अनस्थिमतां तु सत्त्वानां गोमात्रं राशिं हत्वा कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरेत् किम्चिद् दद्यात् ।
text: But having slain a quantity of boneless animals, equal to the weight of a cow, let him perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration, and give something (to a Brāhmaṇa).

sanskrit_iast: asthimatāṃ tv ekaikam |
meaning: अस्थिमतां त्व् एकैकम् ।
text: But (the same penance must be performed) for each single (slain animal) that possesses bones.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'gnīn apavidhyet kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā punar ādhānaṃ kārayet |
meaning: यो ऽग्नीन् अपविध्येत् कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा पुनर् आधानं कारयेत् ।
text: He who extinguishes the (sacred) fires shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days, and cause them to be kindled again (by priests engaged for the occasion).

sanskrit_iast: guroś cālīkanirbandhe sacailaṃ snāto guruṃ prasādayet prasādāt pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: गुरोश् चालीकनिर्बन्धे सचैलं स्नातो गुरुं प्रसादयेत् प्रसादात् पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: He who falsely accuses a Guru shall bathe, dressed in his clothes, and ask his Guru's pardon. It is declared in the Veda that he becomes pure by the Guru's forgiving him.

sanskrit_iast: nāstikaḥ kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā viramen nāstikyāt |
meaning: नास्तिकः कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा विरमेन् नास्तिक्यात् ।
text: An atheist shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration, and give up his infidelity.

sanskrit_iast: nāstikavṛttis tv atikṛcchram |
meaning: नास्तिकवृत्तिस् त्व् अतिकृच्छ्रम् ।
text: But he who receives subsistence from infidels (shall perform) an Atik ri k kh ra penance (and not repeat his offence).

sanskrit_iast: etena somavikrayī vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: एतेन सोमविक्रयी व्याख्यातः ।
text: (The rule applicable to) a seller of Soma has been explained hereby.

sanskrit_iast: vānaprastho dīkṣābhede kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā mahākakṣe vardhayet |
meaning: वानप्रस्थो दीक्षाभेदे कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा महाकक्षे वर्धयेत् ।
text: A hermit, on violating the rules of his order, shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration, and continue (the observances obligatory on him) in a great forest.

sanskrit_iast: bhikṣukair vānaprasthavat somavṛddhivardhanaṃ svaśāstrasaṃskāraś ca svaśāstrasaṃskāraś ceti |
meaning: भिक्षुकैर् वानप्रस्थवत् सोमवृद्धिवर्धनं स्वशास्त्रसंस्कारश् च स्वशास्त्रसंस्कारश् चेति ।
text: Ascetics, (offending in the same manner) as hermits, shall perform for a protracted period (the vow of regulating the quantity of their food according to) the growth of the moon, and shall again be initiated, in accordance with (the rules of) the Institutes applicable to them.

sanskrit_iast: atha khalv ayaṃ puruṣo mithyā vyākaroty ayājyaṃ vā yājayaty apratigrāhyaṃ vā pratigṛhṇāty anannaṃ vāśnāty anācaraṇīyam evācarati |
meaning: अथ खल्व् अयं पुरुषो मिथ्या व्याकरोत्य् अयाज्यं वा याजयत्य् अप्रतिग्राह्यं वा प्रतिगृह्णात्य् अनन्नं वाश्नात्य् अनाचरणीयम् एवाचरति ।
text: Now, indeed, man (in) this (world) speaks an untruth, or sacrifices for men unworthy to offer a sacrifice, or accepts what ought not to be accepted, or eats forbidden food, or practises what ought not to be practised.

sanskrit_iast: tatra prāyaścittaṃ kuryān na kuryād iti mīmāṃsante |
meaning: तत्र प्रायश्चित्तं कुर्यान् न कुर्याद् इति मीमांसन्ते ।
text: They are in doubt if he shall perform a penance for such (a deed), or if he shall not do it.

sanskrit_iast: na kuryād ity āhuḥ |
meaning: न कुर्याद् इत्य् आहुः ।
text: (Some) declare that he shall not do it,

sanskrit_iast: na hi karma kṣīyata iti |
meaning: न हि कर्म क्षीयत इति ।
text: Because the deed does not perish.

sanskrit_iast: kuryād ity eva tasmāc chrutinidarśanāt |
meaning: कुर्याद् इत्य् एव तस्माच् छ्रुतिनिदर्शनात् ।
text: (The correct view is, that) he shall perform (a penance), because it is enjoined in the revealed texts,

sanskrit_iast: tarati sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ tarati brahmahattyāṃ yo 'śvamedhena yajata iti |
meaning: तरति सर्वं पाप्मानं तरति ब्रह्महत्त्यां यो ऽश्वमेधेन यजत इति ।
text: 'He who offers a horse-sacrifice conquers all sin, he destroys the guilt of the murder of a Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: iti cābhiśasto gosavenāgniṣṭutā yajeta |
meaning: इति चाभिशस्तो गोसवेनाग्निष्टुता यजेत ।
text: (Moreover), 'Let an Abhiśasta offer a Gosava or an Agnishṭut-sacrifice,'

sanskrit_iast: tasya niṣkrayaṇāni japas tapo homa upavāso dānam |
meaning: तस्य निष्क्रयणानि जपस् तपो होम उपवासो दानम् ।
text: Reciting the Veda, austerity, a sacrifice, fasting, giving gifts are the means for expiating such a (blamable act).

sanskrit_iast: upaniṣado vedādayo vedāntāḥ sarvachandaḥsāṃhitā madhūny aghamarṣaṇam atharvaśiro rudrāḥ puruṣasūktaṃ rājanarauhiṇe sāmanī kūṣmāṇḍāni pāvamānyaḥ sāvitrī ceti pāvanāni |
meaning: उपनिषदो वेदादयो वेदान्ताः सर्वछन्दःसांहिता मधून्य् अघमर्षणम् अथर्वशिरो रुद्राः पुरुषसूक्तं राजनरौहिणे सामनी कूष्माण्डानि पावमान्यः सावित्री चेति पावनानि ।
text: (The purificatory texts are) the Upanishads, the Vedāntas, the Saṃhitā-text of all the Vedas, the (Anuvākas called) Madhu, the (hymn of) Aghamarshaṇa, the Atharvaśiras, the (Anuvākas called) Rudras, the Purusha-hymn, the two Sāmans called Rā g aṇa and Rauhiṇeya, the Kūshmāṇd as, the Pāvamānīs, and the Sāvitrī,

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | vaiśvānarīṃ vrātapatīṃ pavitreṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca | sakṛd ṛtau prayuñjānaḥ punāti daśapūruṣam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । वैश्वानरीं व्रातपतीं पवित्रेष्टिं तथैव च । सकृद् ऋतौ प्रयुञ्जानः पुनाति दशपूरुषम् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'He who performs once in each season the offerings to Vaiśvānara and Vratapati and the Pavitreshṭi sanctifies ten ancestors.'

sanskrit_iast: upavāsanyāyena payovratatā phalabhakṣatā prasṛtayāvako hiraṇyaprāśanaṃ somapānam iti medhyāni |
meaning: उपवासन्यायेन पयोव्रतता फलभक्षता प्रसृतयावको हिरण्यप्राशनं सोमपानम् इति मेध्यानि ।
text: To live on milk alone, as if one were fasting, to eat fruit only, (to live on) barley gruel prepared of a handful of grain, to eat gold, to drink Soma (are modes of subsistence which) purify.

sanskrit_iast: sarve śiloccayāḥ sarvāḥ sravantyaḥ puṇyā hradās tīrthāny ṛṣinivāsagoṣṭhapariṣkandhā iti deśāḥ |
meaning: सर्वे शिलोच्चयाः सर्वाः स्रवन्त्यः पुण्या ह्रदास् तीर्थान्य् ऋषिनिवासगोष्ठपरिष्कन्धा इति देशाः ।
text: All mountains, all rivers, holy lakes, places of pilgrimage, the dwellings of Ri shis, cowpens, and temples of the gods (are) places (which destroy sin).

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaro māsaś caturviṃśatyahar dvādaśāhaḥ ṣaḍahas tryahar ahā rātrā iti kālāḥ |
meaning: संवत्सरो मासश् चतुर्विंशत्यहर् द्वादशाहः षडहस् त्र्यहर् अहा रात्रा इति कालाः ।
text: A year, a month, twenty-four days, twelve days, six days, three days, a day and a night are the periods (for penances).

sanskrit_iast: etāny evānādeśe vikalpena kriyeran |
meaning: एतान्य् एवानादेशे विकल्पेन क्रियेरन् ।
text: These (acts) may be optionally performed when no (particular penance) has been prescribed,

sanskrit_iast: enaḥsu guruṣu gurūṇi laghuṣu laghūni |
meaning: एनःसु गुरुषु गुरूणि लघुषु लघूनि ।
text: (Viz.) for great sins difficult (penances), and for trivial faults easy ones.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchrātikṛcchrau cāndrāyaṇam iti sarvaprāyaścittiḥ sarvaprāyaścittir iti |
meaning: कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ चान्द्रायणम् इति सर्वप्रायश्चित्तिः सर्वप्रायश्चित्तिर् इति ।
text: The K ri k kh ra and the Atik ri k kh ra (as well as) the K āndrāyaṇa are penances for all (offences).

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārī cet striyam upeyād araṇye catuṣpathe laukike 'gnau rakṣodaivataṃ gardabhaṃ paśum ālabhet |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारी चेत् स्त्रियम् उपेयाद् अरण्ये चतुष्पथे लौकिके ऽग्नौ रक्षोदैवतं गर्दभं पशुम् आलभेत् ।
text: If a student has approached a woman, he shall slay in the forest, in a place where four roads meet [paragraph continues] (kindling) a common fire, an ass for the Rakshas (the goblins),

sanskrit_iast: nairṛtaṃ vā caruṃ nirvapet |
meaning: नैरृतं वा चरुं निर्वपेत् ।
text: Or he may offer an oblation of rice ( k aru) to Nir ri ti (the goddess of hell).

sanskrit_iast: tasya juhuyāt kāmāya svāhā kāmakāmāya svāhā nairṛtyai svāhā rakṣodevatābhyaḥ svāheti |
meaning: तस्य जुहुयात् कामाय स्वाहा कामकामाय स्वाहा नैरृत्यै स्वाहा रक्षोदेवताभ्यः स्वाहेति ।
text: Let him throw into the fire (four oblations consisting) of that (sacrificial food, saying), To Lust svāhā; to him who follows his lust svāhā; to Nir ri ti svāhā; to the divine Rakshas svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: etad eva retasaḥ prayatnotsarge divā svapne vratāntareṣu vā samāvartanāt |
meaning: एतद् एव रेतसः प्रयत्नोत्सर्गे दिवा स्वप्ने व्रतान्तरेषु वा समावर्तनात् ।
text: If, before returning home (from his teacher, a student) voluntarily defiles himself, sleeps in the day-time, or practises any other vow (than that of studentship), the same (penance must be performed).

sanskrit_iast: tiryagyonivyavāye śuklam ṛṣabhaṃ dadyāt |
meaning: तिर्यग्योनिव्यवाये शुक्लम् ऋषभं दद्यात् ।
text: If he has committed a bestial crime, he shall give a white bull (to a Brāhmaṇa).

sanskrit_iast: gāṃ gatvā śūdrāvadhena doṣo vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: गां गत्वा शूद्रावधेन दोषो व्याख्यातः ।
text: The guilt incurred by a bestial crime with a cow, has been explained by the (rule regarding) the killing of a female of the Śūdra caste.

sanskrit_iast: brahmacāriṇaḥ śavakarmaṇo vratān nivṛttiḥ |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारिणः शवकर्मणो व्रतान् निवृत्तिः ।
text: A student breaks his vow by performing funeral rites,

sanskrit_iast: anyatra mātāpitroḥ |
meaning: अन्यत्र मातापित्रोः ।
text: Excepting those of his mother and his father.

sanskrit_iast: sa ced vyādhīyīta kāmaṃ guror ucchiṣṭaṃ bheṣajārthaṃ sarvaṃ prāśnīyāt |
meaning: स चेद् व्याधीयीत कामं गुरोर् उच्छिष्टं भेषजार्थं सर्वं प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: If a (student) is sick, he may eat, at his pleasure, all that is left by his teacher as medicine.

sanskrit_iast: guruprayuktaś cen mriyeta trīn kṛcchāṃś cared guruḥ |
meaning: गुरुप्रयुक्तश् चेन् म्रियेत त्रीन् कृच्छांश् चरेद् गुरुः ।
text: If (a student) who is employed by his teacher (to perform some duty), meets with his death, (the teacher) shall perform three K ri k kh ra penances.

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārī cen māṃsam aśnīyād ucchiṣṭabhojanīyaṃ kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारी चेन् मांसम् अश्नीयाद् उच्छिष्टभोजनीयं कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरित्वा व्रतशेषं समापयेत् ।
text: If a student eats meat which has been given to him as leavings (by his teacher), he shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance of twelve days' duration, and afterwards finish his vow.

sanskrit_iast: śrāddhasūtakabhojaneṣu caivam |
meaning: श्राद्धसूतकभोजनेषु चैवम् ।
text: The same (penance must be performed) if he eats food given at a Śrāddha or by a person who is impure on account of a recent death or birth.

sanskrit_iast: akāmatopanataṃ madhu vājasaneyake na duṣyatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: अकामतोपनतं मधु वाजसनेयके न दुष्यतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda, than honey given without asking does not defile (a student) of the Vā g asaneyi- s ākhā.

sanskrit_iast: ya ātmatyāgy abhiśasto bhavati sapiṇḍānāṃ pretakarmachedaḥ |
meaning: य आत्मत्याग्य् अभिशस्तो भवति सपिण्डानां प्रेतकर्मछेदः ।
text: For him who committing suicide becomes An Abhiśasta, his blood-relations (sapiṇd a) shall not perform the funeral rites.

sanskrit_iast: kāṣṭhajalaloṣṭapāṣāṇaśastraviṣarajjubhir ya ātmānam avasādayati sa ātmahā bhavati |
meaning: काष्ठजललोष्टपाषाणशस्त्रविषरज्जुभिर् य आत्मानम् अवसादयति स आत्महा भवति ।
text: He is called a suicide who destroys himself by means of wood, water, clods of earth, stones, weapons, poison, or a rope.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | ya ātmatyāginaḥ kuryāt snehāt pretakriyāṃ dvijaḥ | sa taptakṛcchrasahitaṃ carec cāndrāyaṇavratam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । य आत्मत्यागिनः कुर्यात् स्नेहात् प्रेतक्रियां द्विजः । स तप्तकृच्छ्रसहितं चरेच् चान्द्रायणव्रतम् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verse): 'The twice-born man who out of affection performs the last rites for a suicide, shall perform a K āndrāyaṇa penance together with a Taptak ri k kh ra.'
