sanskrit_iast: cāndrāyaṇaṃ parastād vakṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: चान्द्रायणं परस्ताद् वक्ष्यामः ।
text: We shall describe the K āndrāyaṇa below.

sanskrit_iast: ātmahananādhyavasāye trirātram |
meaning: आत्महननाध्यवसाये त्रिरात्रम् ।
text: A fast of three days (must be performed) for resolving to die by one's own hand.

sanskrit_iast: jīvann ātmatyāgī kṛchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caret trirātraṃ hy upavasen nityaṃ snigdhena vāsasā prāṇān ātmani cāyamya triḥ paṭhed aghamarṣaṇam iti |
meaning: जीवन्न् आत्मत्यागी कृछ्रं द्वादशरात्रं चरेत् त्रिरात्रं ह्य् उपवसेन् नित्यं स्निग्धेन वाससा प्राणान् आत्मनि चायम्य त्रिः पठेद् अघमर्षणम् इति ।
text: 'He who attempts suicide, but remains alive, shall perform a K ri k kh ra penance during twelve days. (Afterwards) he shall fast for three (days and) nights, being dressed constantly in a garment smeared (with clarified butter), and suppressing his breath, he shall thrice recite the Aghamarshaṇa;'

sanskrit_iast: api vaitena kalpena gāyatrīṃ parivartayet |
meaning: अपि वैतेन कल्पेन गायत्रीं परिवर्तयेत् ।
text: Or, following the same rule, he may also frequently recite the Gāyatrī;

sanskrit_iast: api vāgnim upasamādhāya kūṣmāṇḍair juhuyād dhṛtam |
meaning: अपि वाग्निम् उपसमाधाय कूष्माण्डैर् जुहुयाद् धृतम् ।
text: Or, having kindled a fire, he may offer clarified butter with the Kūshmāṇd as.

sanskrit_iast: yac cānyan mahāpātakebhyaḥ sarvam etena pūyata iti |
meaning: यच् चान्यन् महापातकेभ्यः सर्वम् एतेन पूयत इति ।
text: 'And the guilt (of) all (offences) excepting mortal sins is removed thereby.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy ācamed agniś ca mā manyuś ceti prātarmanasā pāpaṃ dhyātvoṃpūrvāḥ satyāntā vyāhṛtīr japed aghamarṣaṇaṃ vā paṭhet |
meaning: अथाप्य् आचमेद् अग्निश् च मा मन्युश् चेति प्रातर्मनसा पापं ध्यात्वोंपूर्वाः सत्यान्ता व्याहृतीर् जपेद् अघमर्षणं वा पठेत् ।
text: Now he may also sip water in the morning, thinking of (the Mantra), 'May fire and wrath and the lords of wrath protect me,' &c., and meditating on his sin; (then) he may mutter the Vyāh ri tis that end with satya (truth), prefixing (the syllable) Om (to each), or he may recite the Aghamarshaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: mānuṣāsthi snigdhaṃ spṛṣṭvā trirātram āśaucam |
meaning: मानुषास्थि स्निग्धं स्पृष्ट्वा त्रिरात्रम् आशौचम् ।
text: If he touches a human bone to which fat still adheres, he becomes impure during three (days and) nights;

sanskrit_iast: asnigdhe tv ahā rātram |
meaning: अस्निग्धे त्व् अहा रात्रम् ।
text: But (on touching a bone) to which no fat adheres, a day and a night,

sanskrit_iast: śavānugamane caivam |
meaning: शवानुगमने चैवम् ।
text: Likewise if he has followed a corpse (to the burial-ground).

sanskrit_iast: adhīyānānām antarāgamane 'hā rātram abhojanam |
meaning: अधीयानानाम् अन्तरागमने ऽहा रात्रम् अभोजनम् ।
text: If he passes between men reciting the Veda, he shall fast during a day and a night.

sanskrit_iast: trirātram abhiṣeko vivāsaś cānyonyena |
meaning: त्रिरात्रम् अभिषेको विवासश् चान्योन्येन ।
text: (Those who recite the Veda) shall sprinkle each other with water and stay away (from their houses) during three (days and) nights.

sanskrit_iast: śvamārjāranakulaśīghragāṇām ahā rātram |
meaning: श्वमार्जारनकुलशीघ्रगाणाम् अहा रात्रम् ।
text: (The same penance must be performed) for a day and night, if a dog, a cat, or an ichneumon pass quickly (between those who recite the Veda).

sanskrit_iast: śvakukkuṭagrāmyaśūkarakaṅkagṛdhrabhāsapārāvatamānuṣakākolūkamāṃsādane saptarātram upavāso niṣpurīṣībhāvo ghṛtaprāśaḥ punaḥ saṃskāraś ca |
meaning: श्वकुक्कुटग्राम्यशूकरकङ्कगृध्रभासपारावतमानुषकाकोलूकमांसादने सप्तरात्रम् उपवासो निष्पुरीषीभावो घृतप्राशः पुनः संस्कारश् च ।
text: If he has swallowed the flesh of a dog, a cock, a village pig, a grey heron, a vulture, a Bhāsa, a pigeon, a man, a crow or an owl, (he must) fast during seven days, (and thus) empty his entrails (afterwards he must) eat clarified butter, and be initiated again.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇas tu śunā daṣṭo nadīṃ gatvā samudragām | prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya tataḥ śuciriti |
meaning: ब्राह्मणस् तु शुना दष्टो नदीं गत्वा समुद्रगाम् । प्राणायामशतं कृत्वा घृतं प्राश्य ततः शुचिरिति ।

sanskrit_iast: śvacāṇḍālapatitopasparśane sacailaṃ snātaḥ sadyaḥ pūto bhavatīti vijñāyate |
meaning: श्वचाण्डालपतितोपस्पर्शने सचैलं स्नातः सद्यः पूतो भवतीति विज्ञायते ।
text: It is declared in the Veda that, on touching a dog, a K āṇd āla, or an outcast, he becomes at once pure, if he bathes, dressed in his clothes.

sanskrit_iast: patitacāṇḍālārāvaśravaṇe trirātraṃ vācyatā anaśnanta āsīran |
meaning: पतितचाण्डालारावश्रवणे त्रिरात्रं वाच्यता अनश्नन्त आसीरन् ।
text: If (while reciting the Veda) they hear noises made by outcasts or K āṇd ālas, they shall sit silent and fasting during three days;

sanskrit_iast: sahasraparamaṃ vā tadabhyasantaḥ pūtā bhavantīti vijñāyate |
meaning: सहस्रपरमं वा तदभ्यसन्तः पूता भवन्तीति विज्ञायते ।
text: Or if they repeat that (text of the Gāyatrī) at least one thousand times, they become pure; thus it is stated in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva garhitādhyāpakayājakā vyākhyātā dakṣiṇātyāgāc ca pūtā bhavantīti vijñāyate |
meaning: एतेनैव गर्हिताध्यापकयाजका व्याख्याता दक्षिणात्यागाच् च पूता भवन्तीति विज्ञायते ।
text: By this rule (the penance to be performed by) those who teach or sacrifice for vile men has been explained. It is declared in the Veda that they become pure by also relinquishing the fees (which they received).

sanskrit_iast: etenaivābhiśasto vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: एतेनैवाभिशस्तो व्याख्यातः ।
text: By this same (rule the penance prescribed for) an Abhiśasta, (one accused of a heinous crime,) has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: bhrūṇahattyāyāṃ dvādaśarātram abbhakṣo dvādaśarātram upavaset |
meaning: भ्रूणहत्त्यायां द्वादशरात्रम् अब्भक्षो द्वादशरात्रम् उपवसेत् ।
text: (If he has been accused of) killing a learned Brāhmaṇa, let him subsist during twelve days on water (only), and fast during (another) twelve days.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇam anṛtenābhiśaṃsya patanīyenopapatanīyena vā māsam abbhakṣaḥ śuddhavatīr āvartayet |
meaning: ब्राह्मणम् अनृतेनाभिशंस्य पतनीयेनोपपतनीयेन वा मासम् अब्भक्षः शुद्धवतीर् आवर्तयेत् ।
text: If he has falsely accused a Brāhmaṇa of a crime which causes loss of caste, or of a minor offence which does not cause loss of caste, he shall subsist during a month on water (only), and constantly repeat the ( Ri k as called) Śuddhavatīs;

sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhāvabhṛthaṃ vā gacchet |
meaning: अश्वमेधावभृथं वा गच्छेत् ।
text: Or he may go to bathe (with the priests) at (the conclusion of) a horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva cāṇḍālīvyavāyo vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: एतेनैव चाण्डालीव्यवायो व्याख्यातः ।
text: By this (rule the penance for) intercourse with a female of the K āṇd āla caste has been declared.

sanskrit_iast: athāparaḥ kṛcchravidhiḥ sādhāraṇo vyūḍhaḥ |
meaning: अथापरः कृच्छ्रविधिः साधारणो व्यूढः ।
text: Now (follows the description of) another K ri k kh ra penance, applicable to all (men), where (the rule given above) has been altered.

sanskrit_iast: ahaḥ prātar ahar naktamahar ekam ayācitam | ahaḥ parākaṃ tantraikam evaṃ caturahau parau | anugrahārthaṃ viprāṇāṃ manur dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | bālavṛddhātureṣv evaṃ śiśukṛcchram uvāca ha |
meaning: अहः प्रातर् अहर् नक्तमहर् एकम् अयाचितम् । अहः पराकं तन्त्रैकम् एवं चतुरहौ परौ । अनुग्रहार्थं विप्राणां मनुर् धर्मभृतां वरः । बालवृद्धातुरेष्व् एवं शिशुकृच्छ्रम् उवाच ह ।
text: On one day (let him eat) in the morning (only), on the (following) day at night (only), on the (next) day food given without asking, and on the (fourth) day (let him) fast; the succeeding (three) periods of four days (must be passed) in the same manner. Wishing to show favour to the Brāhmaṇas, Manu, the chief among the pillars of the law, has thus described the Śisuk ri k kh ra (the hard penance of children) for infants, aged, and sick men.

sanskrit_iast: atha cāndrāyaṇavidhiḥ |
meaning: अथ चान्द्रायणविधिः ।
text: Now follows the rule for (the performance of) the K āndrāyaṇa (lunar penance).

sanskrit_iast: māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣādau grāsān adyāc caturdaśa | grāsopacayabhojī syāt pakṣaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | evaṃ hi śuklapakṣādau grāsam ekaṃ tu bhakṣayet | grāsāpacayabhojī syāt pakṣaśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
meaning: मासस्य कृष्णपक्षादौ ग्रासान् अद्याच् चतुर्दश । ग्रासोपचयभोजी स्यात् पक्षशेषं समापयेत् । एवं हि शुक्लपक्षादौ ग्रासम् एकं तु भक्षयेत् । ग्रासापचयभोजी स्यात् पक्षशेषं समापयेत् ।
text: On the first day of the dark half (of the month) let him eat fourteen (mouthfuls), let him diminish the (number of) mouthfuls (each day by one), and continue in this manner until the end of the fortnight. In like manner let him eat one mouthful on the first day of the bright half, and (daily) increasing (the number 6f) mouthfuls, continue until the end of the fortnight.

sanskrit_iast: atraiva gāyet sāmāni api vā vyāhṛtīr japet |
meaning: अत्रैव गायेत् सामानि अपि वा व्याहृतीर् जपेत् ।
text: Meanwhile let him sing Sāmans, or mutter the Vyāh ri tis.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa cāndrāyaṇo māsaḥ pavitram ṛṣisaṃstutaḥ | anādiṣṭeṣu sarveṣu prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate | vidhīyata iti |
meaning: एष चान्द्रायणो मासः पवित्रम् ऋषिसंस्तुतः । अनादिष्टेषु सर्वेषु प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते । विधीयत इति ।
text: A month during which he thus performs a K āndrāyaṇa, the Ri shis have called by way of laudation, 'a means of purification' (pavitra). It is prescribed as an expiation of all (offences) for which no (special penance) has been mentioned.

sanskrit_iast: athātikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: अथातिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: Now (follows the description of) an Atik ri k kh ra penance.

sanskrit_iast: tryahaṃ prātas tathā sāyam ayācitaṃ parāka iti kṛcchro yāvat sakṛd ādadīta tāvad aśnīyāt pūrvavat so 'tikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: त्र्यहं प्रातस् तथा सायम् अयाचितं पराक इति कृच्छ्रो यावत् सकृद् आददीत तावद् अश्नीयात् पूर्ववत् सो ऽतिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: Let him eat as much as he can take at one (mouthful, and follow the rules given) above for a K ri k kh ra, (viz.) to eat during three days in the morning, (during another three days) in the evening, (during further three days) food given without asking, and to fast during the last three days. That is an Atik ri k kh ra.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchro 'bbhakṣaḥ sa kṛchrātikṛcchraḥ |
meaning: कृच्छ्रो ऽब्भक्षः स कृछ्रातिकृच्छ्रः ।
text: A K ri k kh ra penance (during the performance of which one) subsists on water (only is called) a K ri k kh rātik ri k kh ra.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchrāṇāṃ vratarūpāṇi |
meaning: कृच्छ्राणां व्रतरूपाणि ।
text: The peculiar observances (prescribed during the performance) of K ri k kh ra penances (are as follows):

sanskrit_iast: śmaśrukeśān vāpayed bhruvo 'kṣilomaśikhāvarjaṃ nakhān nikṛtyaikavāso 'ninditabhojī triṣavaṇam udakopasparśī daṇḍī kamaṇḍaluḥ strīśūdrasaṃbhāṣaṇavarjī sthānāsanaśīlo 'has tiṣṭhed rātrāv asītety āha bhagavān vasiṣṭhaḥ |
meaning: श्मश्रुकेशान् वापयेद् भ्रुवो ऽक्षिलोमशिखावर्जं नखान् निकृत्यैकवासो ऽनिन्दितभोजी त्रिषवणम् उदकोपस्पर्शी दण्डी कमण्डलुः स्त्रीशूद्रसंभाषणवर्जी स्थानासनशीलो ऽहस् तिष्ठेद् रात्राव् असीतेत्य् आह भगवान् वसिष्ठः ।
text: 'Having cut his nails, (the performer) shall cause his beard and all his hair to be shaved off, excepting the eyebrows, the eyelashes, and the lock at the top of the head; (wear) one garment only; he shall eat blameless food; what one obtains by going to beg once (is called) blameless food; he shall bathe in the morning, at noon, and in the evening; he shall carry a stick (and) a waterpot; he shall avoid to speak to women and Śūdras; carefully keeping himself in an upright or sitting posture, he shall stand during the day, and remain seated during the night.' Thus speaks the divine Vasish th a.

sanskrit_iast: sa tad yad etad dharmaśāstraṃ nāputrāya nāśiṣyāya nāsaṃvatsaroṣitāya dadyāt |
meaning: स तद् यद् एतद् धर्मशास्त्रं नापुत्राय नाशिष्याय नासंवत्सरोषिताय दद्यात् ।
text: Let him not instruct in these Institutes of the sacred law anybody but his son or a pupil who stays (in his house at least) for a year.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraṃ dakṣiṇā ṛṣabhaikādaśā guruprasādo vā guruprasādo veti |
meaning: सहस्रं दक्षिणा ऋषभैकादशा गुरुप्रसादो वा गुरुप्रसादो वेति ।
text: The fee (for teaching it) is one thousand (paṇas), (or) ten cows and a bull, or the worship of the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: avikhyāpitadoṣāṇāṃ pāpānāṃ mahatāṃ tathā | sarveṣāṃ copapāpānāṃ śuddhiṃ vakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ |
meaning: अविख्यापितदोषाणां पापानां महतां तथा । सर्वेषां चोपपापानां शुद्धिं वक्ष्याम्य् अशेषतः ।
text: I will completely explain the purification of those whose guilt has not been made public, both from great crimes and for minor offences.

sanskrit_iast: āhitāgner vinītasya vṛddhasya viduṣo 'pi vā | rahasyoktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ pūrvoktam itare janāḥ |
meaning: आहिताग्नेर् विनीतस्य वृद्धस्य विदुषो ऽपि वा । रहस्योक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं पूर्वोक्तम् इतरे जनाः ।
text: A penance prescribed in (the section on) secret (penances) is for an Agnihotrin, an aged and a learned man, who have subdued their senses; but other men (must perform the expiations) described above.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāyāmaiḥ pavitraiś ca dānair homair japais tathā | nityayuktāḥ pramucyante pātakebhyo na saṃśayaḥ |
meaning: प्राणायामैः पवित्रैश् च दानैर् होमैर् जपैस् तथा । नित्ययुक्ताः प्रमुच्यन्ते पातकेभ्यो न संशयः ।
text: Those constantly engaged in suppressing their breath, reciting purificatory texts, giving gifts, making burnt-oblations, and muttering (sacred texts) will, undoubtedly, be freed from (the guilt of) crimes causing loss of caste.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāyāmān pavitrāṇi vyāhṛtīḥ praṇavaṃ tathā | pavitrapāṇir āsīno brahma naityakam abhyaset |
meaning: प्राणायामान् पवित्राणि व्याहृतीः प्रणवं तथा । पवित्रपाणिर् आसीनो ब्रह्म नैत्यकम् अभ्यसेत् ।
text: Seated with Kuśa grass in his hands, let him repeatedly suppress his breath, and again and again recite purificatory texts, the Vyāh ri tis, the syllable Om, and the daily portion of the Veda

sanskrit_iast: āvartayan sadā yuktaḥ prāṇāyāmān punaḥ punaḥ | ā lomāgrān nakhāgrāc ca tapas tapyatu uttamam |
meaning: आवर्तयन् सदा युक्तः प्राणायामान् पुनः पुनः । आ लोमाग्रान् नखाग्राच् च तपस् तप्यतु उत्तमम् ।
text: Always intent on the practice of Yoga, let him again and again suppress his breath. Up to the ends of his hair and up to the ends of his nails let him perform highest austerity.

sanskrit_iast: nirodhāj jāyate vāyurvāyor agnir hi jāyate | tāpenāpo 'tha jāyante tato 'ntaḥ śudhyate tribhiḥ |
meaning: निरोधाज् जायते वायुर्वायोर् अग्निर् हि जायते । तापेनापो ऽथ जायन्ते ततो ऽन्तः शुध्यते त्रिभिः ।
text: Through the obstruction (of the expiration) air is generated, through air fire is produced, then through heat water is formed; hence he is internally purified by (these) three.

sanskrit_iast: na tāṃ tīvreṇa tapasā na svādhyāyair na cejyayā | gatiṃ gantuṃ dvijāḥ śaktā yogāt saṃprā vanti yām |
meaning: न तां तीव्रेण तपसा न स्वाध्यायैर् न चेज्यया । गतिं गन्तुं द्विजाः शक्ता योगात् संप्रा वन्ति याम् ।
text: Neither through severe austerities, nor through the daily recitation of the Veda, nor through offering sacrifices can the twice-born reach that condition which they attain by the practice of Yoga.

sanskrit_iast: yogāt saṃprāpyate jñānaṃ yogo dharmasya lakṣaṇam | yogaḥ paraṃ tapo nityaṃ tasmād yuktaḥ sadā bhavet |
meaning: योगात् संप्राप्यते ज्ञानं योगो धर्मस्य लक्षणम् । योगः परं तपो नित्यं तस्माद् युक्तः सदा भवेत् ।
text: Through the practice of Yoga (true) knowledge is obtained, Yoga is the sum of the sacred law, the practice of Yoga is the highest and eternal austerity; therefore let him always be absorbed in the practice of Yoga.

sanskrit_iast: praṇave nityayuktas syād vyāhṛtīṣu ca saptasu | tripadāyāṃ ca gāyatryāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit |
meaning: प्रणवे नित्ययुक्तस् स्याद् व्याहृतीषु च सप्तसु । त्रिपदायां च गायत्र्यां न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् ।
text: For him who is constantly engaged in (reciting the syllable) Om, the seven Vyāh ri tis, and the three-footed Gāyatrī no danger exists anywhere.

sanskrit_iast: praṇavād yās tathā vedāḥ praṇave paryavasthitāḥ | vācmayaṃ praṇavaḥ sarvaṃ tasmāt praṇavam abhyaset |
meaning: प्रणवाद् यास् तथा वेदाः प्रणवे पर्यवस्थिताः । वाच्मयं प्रणवः सर्वं तस्मात् प्रणवम् अभ्यसेत् ।
text: The Vedas likewise begin with the syllable Om, and they end with the syllable Om, the syllable Om is the sum of all speech; therefore let him repeat it constantly.

sanskrit_iast: ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam |
meaning: एकाक्षरं परं ब्रह्म पावनं परमं स्मृतम् ।
text: The most excellent (portion of the) Veda, which consists of one syllable, is declared to be the best purificatory text.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ saṅkare samupasthite | abhyāso daśasāhasraḥ sāvitryāḥ śodhanaṃ mahat |
meaning: सर्वेषाम् एव पापानां सङ्करे समुपस्थिते । अभ्यासो दशसाहस्रः सावित्र्याः शोधनं महत् ।
text: If the guilt of all sins did fall on one man, to repeat the Gāyatrī ten thousand times (would be) an efficient means of purification.

sanskrit_iast: savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha | triḥ paṭhed āyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate | sa ucyata iti |
meaning: सव्याहृतिं सप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह । त्रिः पठेद् आयतप्राणः प्राणायामः स उच्यते । स उच्यत इति ।
text: If, suppressing his breath, he thrice recites the Gāyatrī together with the Vyāh ri tis together with the syllable Om and with the (text called) Śiras, that is called one suppression of breath.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāyāmān dhārayet ttrīnyo yathāvidhy atandritaḥ | ahā rātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati |
meaning: प्राणायामान् धारयेत् त्त्रीन्यो यथाविध्य् अतन्द्रितः । अहा रात्रकृतं पापं तत्क्षणाद् एव नश्यति ।
text: If, untired, he performs three suppressions of his breath according to the rule, the sins which he committed during a day and a night are instantly destroyed.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇā manasā vācā yad ahnā kṛtam ainasam | āsīnaḥ paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ prāṇāyāmair vyapohati |
meaning: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यद् अह्ना कृतम् ऐनसम् । आसीनः पश्चिमां सन्ध्यां प्राणायामैर् व्यपोहति ।
text: Seated during the evening prayer, he removes by (three) suppressions of his breath all guilt which he incurred during the day by deeds, thoughts, or speeches.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇā manasā vācā yad rātryā kṛtam ainasam | uttiṣṭhan pūrvasandhyāṃ tu prāṇāyāmair vyapohati |
meaning: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यद् रात्र्या कृतम् ऐनसम् । उत्तिष्ठन् पूर्वसन्ध्यां तु प्राणायामैर् व्यपोहति ।
text: But standing during the morning prayer, he removes by (three) suppressions of his breath all guilt which he incurred during the night by deeds, thoughts, or speeches.

sanskrit_iast: savyāhṛtikāḥ sapraṇavāḥ prāṇāyāmās tu ṣoḍaśa | api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsātpunanty aharahaḥ kṛtāḥ |
meaning: सव्याहृतिकाः सप्रणवाः प्राणायामास् तु षोडश । अपि भ्रूणहनं मासात्पुनन्त्य् अहरहः कृताः ।
text: But sixteen suppressions of breath, accompanied by (the recitation of) the Vyāh ri tis and the syllable Om, repeated daily, purify after a month even the slayer of a learned Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: japtvā kautsam apety etadvāsiṣṭhaṃ ca tricaṃ prati | māhitraṃ śuddhavatyaś ca surāpo 'pi viśudhyati |
meaning: जप्त्वा कौत्सम् अपेत्य् एतद्वासिष्ठं च त्रिचं प्रति । माहित्रं शुद्धवत्यश् च सुरापो ऽपि विशुध्यति ।
text: Even a drinker of spirituous liquor becomes pure, if he mutters the (hymn seen) by Kutsa, 'Apa naḥsosu k ad agham,' and (the hymn seen) by Vasish th a (which begins with the word) 'Prati,' the Māhitra (hymn), and the Śuddhavatīs.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛj japtvāsyavāmīyaṃ śivasaṅkalpam eva ca | suvarṇam apahṛtyāpi kṣaṇād bhavati nirmalaḥ |
meaning: सकृज् जप्त्वास्यवामीयं शिवसङ्कल्पम् एव च । सुवर्णम् अपहृत्यापि क्षणाद् भवति निर्मलः ।
text: Even he who has stolen gold becomes instantly free from guilt, if he once mutters (the hymn beginning with the words) 'Asya vāmasya' and the Śivasaṃkalpa.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣyantīyam abhyasya na tam aṃha iti tricaṃ | sūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ japtvā mucyate gurutalpagaḥ |
meaning: हविष्यन्तीयम् अभ्यस्य न तम् अंह इति त्रिचं । सूक्तं च पौरुषं जप्त्वा मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः ।
text: The violator of a Guru's bed is freed (from sin) if he repeatedly recites the (hymn beginning) 'Havish pāntam a g aram' and that (beginning) 'Na tam aṃha h ' and mutters the hymn addressed to Purusha.

sanskrit_iast: api vāpsu nimajjānas trir japed aghamarṣaṇam | yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthas tādṛśaṃ manur abravīt |
meaning: अपि वाप्सु निमज्जानस् त्रिर् जपेद् अघमर्षणम् । यथाश्वमेधावभृथस् तादृशं मनुर् अब्रवीत् ।
text: Or plunging into water he may thrice mutter the Aghamarshaṇa. Manu has declared that the (effect is the) same as if he had gone to bathe at a horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ārabhbhayajñāj japayajño viśiṣṭho daśabhir guṇaiḥ | upāṃśuḥ syāc chataguṇaḥ sāhasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ |
meaning: आरभ्भयज्ञाज् जपयज्ञो विशिष्ठो दशभिर् गुणैः । उपांशुः स्याच् छतगुणः साहस्रो मानसः स्मृतः ।
text: An offering consisting of muttered prayers is ten times more efficacious than a sacrifice at which animals are killed; a (prayer) which is inaudible (to others) surpasses it a hundred times, and the mental (recitation of sacred texts) one thousand times.

sanskrit_iast: ye pākayajñāś catvāro vidhiyajñasamanvitāḥ | sarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
meaning: ये पाकयज्ञाश् चत्वारो विधियज्ञसमन्विताः । सर्वे ते जपयज्ञस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ।
text: The four Pākaya g ñ as and those sacrifices which are enjoined by the rules of the Veda are all together not equal in value to the sixteenth part of a sacrifice consisting of muttered prayers.

sanskrit_iast: jāpyenaiva tu saṃsidhyed brāhmaṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ | kuryād anyaṃ na vā kuryān maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate |
meaning: जाप्येनैव तु संसिध्येद् ब्राह्मणो नात्र संशयः । कुर्याद् अन्यं न वा कुर्यान् मैत्रो ब्राह्मण उच्यते ।
text: But, undoubtedly, a Brāhmaṇa reaches the highest goal by muttering prayers only; whether he perform other (rites) or neglect them, he is called a Brāhmaṇa who befriends all creatures (maitra).

sanskrit_iast: jāpināṃ homināṃ caiva dhyāyināṃ tīrthavāsinām | na parivasanti pāpāni ye ca snātāḥ śirovrataiḥ |
meaning: जापिनां होमिनां चैव ध्यायिनां तीर्थवासिनाम् । न परिवसन्ति पापानि ये च स्नाताः शिरोव्रतैः ।
text: The sins of those who are intent on muttering prayers, of those who offer burnt-oblations, of those who are given to meditation, of those who reside in sacred places, and of those who have bathed after performing the vows called Śiras, do not remain.

sanskrit_iast: yathāgnir vāyunā dhūto haviṣā caiva dīpyate | evaṃ jāpyaparo nityaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ saṃpradīpyate |
meaning: यथाग्निर् वायुना धूतो हविषा चैव दीप्यते । एवं जाप्यपरो नित्यं ब्राह्मणः संप्रदीप्यते ।
text: As a fire, fanned by wind, burns brighter, and (as its flame grows) through offerings (of butter), even so a Brāhmaṇa who is daily engaged in muttering sacred texts shines with a brilliant lustre.

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyādhyāyināṃ nityaṃ nityaṃ ca prayatātmanām | japatāṃ juhvatāṃ cāpi vinipāto na vidyate |
meaning: स्वाध्यायाध्यायिनां नित्यं नित्यं च प्रयतात्मनाम् । जपतां जुह्वतां चापि विनिपातो न विद्यते ।
text: The destruction of those who fulfil the duty of daily study, who constantly restrain themselves, who mutter prayers and offer sacrifices has never been known (to happen).

sanskrit_iast: sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām | śuddhikāmaḥ prayuñjīta sarvapāpeṣv api sthitaḥ |
meaning: सहस्रपरमां देवीं शतमध्यां दशावराम् । शुद्धिकामः प्रयुञ्जीत सर्वपापेष्व् अपि स्थितः ।
text: Let him who is desirous of purification repeat, though he be charged with all sins, the divine (Gāyatrī), at the most one thousand times, or one hundred times as a medium (penance), or at least ten times (for trivial faults).

sanskrit_iast: kṣatriyo bāhuvīryeṇa tared āpadam ātmanaḥ | dhanena vaiśyaśudrau tu japaihomair dvijottamaḥ |
meaning: क्षत्रियो बाहुवीर्येण तरेद् आपदम् आत्मनः । धनेन वैश्यशुद्रौ तु जपैहोमैर् द्विजोत्तमः ।
text: A Kshatriya shall pass through misfortunes which have befallen him by the strength of his arms, a Vaiśya and Śūdra by their wealth, the highest among twice-born men by muttered prayers and burnt-oblations.

sanskrit_iast: yathāśvā rathahīnāḥ syū ratho vāśvair vinā yathā | evaṃ tapas tv avidyasya vidyā vāpy atapasvinaḥ |
meaning: यथाश्वा रथहीनाः स्यू रथो वाश्वैर् विना यथा । एवं तपस् त्व् अविद्यस्य विद्या वाप्य् अतपस्विनः ।
text: As horses (are useless) without a chariot, as chariots (are useless) without horses, even so austerity (is useless) to him who is destitute of sacred learning, and sacred learning to him who practises no austerities.

sanskrit_iast: yathānnaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ madhu vānnena saṃyutam | evaṃ tapaś ca vidyā ca saṃyuktaṃ bheṣajaṃ mahat |
meaning: यथान्नं मधुसंयुक्तं मधु वान्नेन संयुतम् । एवं तपश् च विद्या च संयुक्तं भेषजं महत् ।
text: As food mixed with honey, or honey mixed with food, even so are austerities and learning, joined together, a powerful medicine.

sanskrit_iast: vidyātapobhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ japanaityakam | sadāpi pāpakarmāṇam eno na pratiyujyate | eno na pratiyujyata iti |
meaning: विद्यातपोभ्यां संयुक्तं ब्राह्मणं जपनैत्यकम् । सदापि पापकर्माणम् एनो न प्रतियुज्यते । एनो न प्रतियुज्यत इति ।
text: No guilt taints a Brāhmaṇa who possesses learning, practises austerities, and daily mutters sacred texts, though he may constantly commit sinful acts.

sanskrit_iast: yady akāryaśataṃ sāgraṃ kṛtaṃ vedaś ca dhāryate | sarvaṃ tat tasya vedāgnir dahaty agnir ivendhanam |
meaning: यद्य् अकार्यशतं साग्रं कृतं वेदश् च धार्यते । सर्वं तत् तस्य वेदाग्निर् दहत्य् अग्निर् इवेन्धनम् ।
text: If a hundred improper acts, and even more, have been committed, and the (knowledge of the) [paragraph continues] Veda is retained, the fire of the Veda destroys all (the guilt) of that man just as a (common) fire consumes fuel.

sanskrit_iast: yathā jātabalo vahnir dahaty ārdrān api drumān | tathā dahati vedāgniḥ karmajaṃ doṣam ātmanaḥ |
meaning: यथा जातबलो वह्निर् दहत्य् आर्द्रान् अपि द्रुमान् । तथा दहति वेदाग्निः कर्मजं दोषम् आत्मनः ।
text: As a fire that burns strongly consumes even green trees, even so the fire of the Veda destroys one's guilt caused by (evil) deeds.

sanskrit_iast: hatvāpi sa imān lokān bhuñjāno 'pi yatas tataḥ | ṛcvedaṃ dhārayan vipro nainaḥ prāpnoti kimcana |
meaning: हत्वापि स इमान् लोकान् भुञ्जानो ऽपि यतस् ततः । ऋच्वेदं धारयन् विप्रो नैनः प्राप्नोति किम्चन ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa who remembers the Rig-veda is not tainted by any guilt, though he has destroyed these (three) worlds and has eaten the food of all, (even of the most sinful) men.

sanskrit_iast: na vedabalam āśritya pāpakarmaratir bhavet | ajñānāc ca pramādāc ca dahyate karma netarat |
meaning: न वेदबलम् आश्रित्य पापकर्मरतिर् भवेत् । अज्ञानाच् च प्रमादाच् च दह्यते कर्म नेतरत् ।
text: If (a Brāhmaṇa) relies on the power of the Veda, he cannot find pleasure in sinful acts. Guilt (incurred) through ignorance and negligence is destroyed, not (that of) other (intentional offences).

sanskrit_iast: tapas tapyati yo 'raṇye munir mūlaphalāśanaḥ | ṛcam ekāṃ ca yo 'dhīte tac ca tāni ca tat samam |
meaning: तपस् तप्यति यो ऽरण्ये मुनिर् मूलफलाशनः । ऋचम् एकां च यो ऽधीते तच् च तानि च तत् समम् ।
text: If a hermit subsisting on roots and fruit practises austerities in a forest, and (a householder) recites a single Ri k , the merit of the acts of the one and of the other is equal.

sanskrit_iast: itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet | bibhety alpaśrutād vedo mām ayaṃ prahariṣyati |
meaning: इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदं समुपबृंहयेत् । बिभेत्य् अल्पश्रुताद् वेदो माम् अयं प्रहरिष्यति ।
text: Let him strengthen the Veda by (studying) the Itihāsas and Purāṇas. For the Veda fears a man of little learning, (thinking) 'He will destroy me.'

sanskrit_iast: vedābhyāso 'nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyākramaḥ | nāśayaty āśu pāpāni mahāpātakajāny api |
meaning: वेदाभ्यासो ऽन्वहं शक्त्या महायज्ञक्रियाक्रमः । नाशयत्य् आशु पापानि महापातकजान्य् अपि ।
text: The daily recitation of the Veda and the performance, according to one's ability, of the series of Mahāya g ñ as quickly destroy guilt, even that of mortal sins.

sanskrit_iast: vedoditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ | tad hi kurvan yathāśaktyā prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim |
meaning: वेदोदितं स्वकं कर्म नित्यं कुर्याद् अतन्द्रितः । तद् हि कुर्वन् यथाशक्त्या प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् ।
text: Let him daily perform, without tiring, his particular rites which the Veda enjoins. For if he does that according to his ability, he will reach the most blessed state.

sanskrit_iast: yājanādhyāpanād yaunāt tathaivāsatpratigrahāt | vipreṣu na bhaved doṣo jvalanārkasamo hi saḥ |
meaning: याजनाध्यापनाद् यौनात् तथैवासत्प्रतिग्रहात् । विप्रेषु न भवेद् दोषो ज्वलनार्कसमो हि सः ।
text: Through sacrificing for wicked people, through teaching them, through intermarrying with them, and through receiving gifts from them, (learned) [paragraph continues] Brāhmaṇas do not contract guilt, for (a learned Brāhmaṇa) resembles a fire and the sun.

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkāsthāne samutpanne abhojyabhojyasaṃjñake | āhāraśuddhiṃ vakṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu |
meaning: शङ्कास्थाने समुत्पन्ने अभोज्यभोज्यसंज्ञके । आहारशुद्धिं वक्ष्यामि तन् मे निगदतः शृणु ।
text: I will now declare the purification prescribed for (eating) food, regarding which doubts have arisen, whether it may be called fit to be eaten or not. Listen to my words!

sanskrit_iast: akṣāralavaṇāṃ rūkṣāṃ pibedbrāhmīṃ suvarcalām | trirātraṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ ca brāhmaṇaḥ payasā saha |
meaning: अक्षारलवणां रूक्षां पिबेद्ब्राह्मीं सुवर्चलाम् । त्रिरात्रं शङ्खपुष्पीं च ब्राह्मणः पयसा सह ।
text: Let a Brāhmaṇa drink during three days the astringent decoction of the Brahmasuvar k alā plant, unmixed with salt or pungent condiments, and (a decoction of) the Śaṅkhapushpī plant, together with milk.

sanskrit_iast: palāśabilbapatrāṇi kuśān padmān udumbarān | kvāthayitvā pibed āpas trirātreṇaiva śudhyati |
meaning: पलाशबिल्बपत्राणि कुशान् पद्मान् उदुम्बरान् । क्वाथयित्वा पिबेद् आपस् त्रिरात्रेणैव शुध्यति ।
text: Let him drink water, after boiling in it Palāśa and Bilva leaves, Kuśa grass, and (leaves of) lotuses and Udumbara trees; after three days and no more he becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | ekarātropavāsaś ca śvapākam api śodhayet |
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । एकरात्रोपवासश् च श्वपाकम् अपि शोधयेत् ।
text: (Subsisting) during one day on each (of the following substances), cow's urine, cowdung, milk, sour milk, butter, and water in which Kuśa grass has been boiled, and fasting on the seventh day purify even (him who fears that he has partaken of the food of) a Śvapāka.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā | pañcarātraṃ tadāhāraḥ pañcagavyena śudhyati |
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं चैव क्षीरं दधि घृतं तथा । पञ्चरात्रं तदाहारः पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ।
text: He who lives during five days on cow's urine, cowdung, milk, sour milk, and clarified butter, is purified by means of (that) Pa ñ k agavya, (the five products of the cow.)

sanskrit_iast: yavān vidhinopayuñjānaḥ pratyakṣeṇaiva śudhyati | viśuddhabhāve śuddhāḥ syur aśuddhe tu sarāgiṇaḥ |
meaning: यवान् विधिनोपयुञ्जानः प्रत्यक्षेणैव शुध्यति । विशुद्धभावे शुद्धाः स्युर् अशुद्धे तु सरागिणः ।
text: He who, in accordance with the rule, uses barley (for his food), becomes pure even by ocular proof. (For) if he is pure, those (barley grains) will be white, if he is impure they will be discoloured.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣyān prātar āśāṃs trīn sāyam āśāṃs tathaiva ca | ayācitaṃ tathaiva syād upavāsatrayaṃ bhavet |
meaning: हविष्यान् प्रातर् आशांस् त्रीन् सायम् आशांस् तथैव च । अयाचितं तथैव स्याद् उपवासत्रयं भवेत् ।
text: (If he makes) three morning meals of food fit for a sacrifice and three evening meals in like manner, and if food given without asking (is his subsistence) in the same manner, (he will thus perform) three fasts.

sanskrit_iast: atha cet tvarate kartuṃ divasaṃ mārutāśanaḥ | rātrau jalāśaye vyuṣṭaḥ prājāpatyena tat samam |
meaning: अथ चेत् त्वरते कर्तुं दिवसं मारुताशनः । रात्रौ जलाशये व्युष्टः प्राजापत्येन तत् समम् ।
text: Now if he is in haste to make (himself pure), (let him) subsist on air during a day, and pass the night standing in water; (that penance) is equal to a Prā g āpatya (K ri k kh ra).

sanskrit_iast: sāvitryaṣṭasahasraṃ tu japaṃ kṛtvotthite ravau | mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair yadi na brahmahā bhavet |
meaning: सावित्र्यष्टसहस्रं तु जपं कृत्वोत्थिते रवौ । मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर् यदि न ब्रह्महा भवेत् ।
text: But if at sunrise he mutters the Gāyatrī eight thousand times, he will be freed from all mortal sins, provided he be not the slayer of a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai stenaḥ surāpo vā bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ | dharmaśāstram adhītyaiva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ |
meaning: यो वै स्तेनः सुरापो वा भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पगः । धर्मशास्त्रम् अधीत्यैव मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ।
text: He, forsooth, who has stolen (the gold of a Brāhmaṇa), has drunk spirituous liquor, has slain a learned Brāhmaṇa, or has violated his Guru's bed, will become free from all (these) mortal sins if he studies the Institutes of the sacred law.

sanskrit_iast: duritānāṃ duriṣṭānāṃ pāpānāṃ mahatāṃ tathā | kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
meaning: दुरितानां दुरिष्टानां पापानां महतां तथा । कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ।
text: For unlawful acts, for unlawful sacrifices, and for great sins (let him perform) a K ri k kh ra and a K āndrāyaṇa, which destroy all guilt.

sanskrit_iast: ekaikaṃ vardhayet piṇḍaṃ śukle kṛṣṇe ca hrāsayet | amāvāsyāṃ na bhuñjīta evaṃ cāndrāyaṇo vidhiḥ | evaṃ cāndrāyāṇo vidhir iti |
meaning: एकैकं वर्धयेत् पिण्डं शुक्ले कृष्णे च ह्रासयेत् । अमावास्यां न भुञ्जीत एवं चान्द्रायणो विधिः । एवं चान्द्रायाणो विधिर् इति ।
text: Let him add daily one mouthful (to his food) during the bright (half of the month), let him diminish it (daily by one mouthful) during the dark (half), and let him fast on the new-moon day; that is the rule for the K āndrāyaṇa (or lunar penance).

sanskrit_iast: na strī duṣyati jāreṇa na vipro vedakarmaṇā | nāpo mūtrapurīṣeṇa nāgnir dahanakarmaṇā |
meaning: न स्त्री दुष्यति जारेण न विप्रो वेदकर्मणा । नापो मूत्रपुरीषेण नाग्निर् दहनकर्मणा ।
text: A woman is not defiled by a lover, nor a Brāhmaṇa by Vedic rites, nor water by urine and ordure, nor fire by consuming (impure substances).

sanskrit_iast: svayaṃ vipratipannā vā yadi vā vipravāsitā | balāt kāropabhuktā vā corahastagatāpi vā |
meaning: स्वयं विप्रतिपन्ना वा यदि वा विप्रवासिता । बलात् कारोपभुक्ता वा चोरहस्तगतापि वा ।

sanskrit_iast: na tyājyā dūṣitā nārī nāsyās tyāgo vidhīyate | puṣpakālam upāsīta ṛtukālena śudhyati |
meaning: न त्याज्या दूषिता नारी नास्यास् त्यागो विधीयते । पुष्पकालम् उपासीत ऋतुकालेन शुध्यति ।

sanskrit_iast: striyaḥ pavitram atulaṃ naitā duṣyanti karhicit | māsi māsi rajo hy āsāṃ duṣkṛtāny apakarṣati |
meaning: स्त्रियः पवित्रम् अतुलं नैता दुष्यन्ति कर्हिचित् । मासि मासि रजो ह्य् आसां दुष्कृतान्य् अपकर्षति ।
text: Women (possess) an unequalled means of purification; they never become (entirely) foul. For month by month their temporary uncleanness removes their sins.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surair bhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ | gacchanti mānuṣān paścānaitā duṣyanti dharmataḥ |
meaning: पूर्वं स्त्रियः सुरैर् भुक्ताः सोमगन्धर्ववह्निभिः । गच्छन्ति मानुषान् पश्चानैता दुष्यन्ति धर्मतः ।
text: Women belong first to three gods, Soma (the moon), the Gandharva, and Fire, and come afterwards into the possession of men; according to the law they cannot be contaminated.

sanskrit_iast: tāsāṃ somo 'dadac chaucaṃ gandharvaḥ śikṣitāṃ giram | agniś ca sarvamedhyatvaṃ tasmān niskalmaṣāḥ striyaḥ |
meaning: तासां सोमो ऽददच् छौचं गन्धर्वः शिक्षितां गिरम् । अग्निश् च सर्वमेध्यत्वं तस्मान् निस्कल्मषाः स्त्रियः ।
text: Soma gave them cleanliness, the Gandharva their melodious voice, and Fire purity of all (limbs); therefore women are free from stains.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi striyaḥ pātakāni loke dharmavido viduḥ | bhartṛvadho bhrūṇahatyā svasya garbhasya pātanam |
meaning: त्रीणि स्त्रियः पातकानि लोके धर्मविदो विदुः । भर्तृवधो भ्रूणहत्या स्वस्य गर्भस्य पातनम् ।
text: Those versed in the sacred law state that there are three acts (only) which make women outcasts, (viz.) the murder of the husband, slaying a learned Brāhmaṇa, and the destruction of the fruit of their womb.

sanskrit_iast: vatsaḥ prasravaṇe medhyaḥ śakuniḥ phalapātane | striyaś ca ratisaṃsarge śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ |
meaning: वत्सः प्रस्रवणे मेध्यः शकुनिः फलपातने । स्त्रियश् च रतिसंसर्गे श्वा मृगग्रहणे शुचिः ।
text: A calf is pure when the milk flows, a bird when it causes fruit to fall, women during dalliance, and a dog when he catches a deer.

sanskrit_iast: ajāśvā mukhato medhyās gāvo medhyās tu sarvataḥ |
meaning: अजाश्वा मुखतो मेध्यास् गावो मेध्यास् तु सर्वतः ।
text: Pure is the mouth of a goat and of a horse, pure is the back of a cow, pure are the feet of a Brāhmaṇa, but women are pure in all (limbs)

sanskrit_iast: sarvavedapavitrāṇi vakṣyāmy aham ataḥ paraṃ | yeṣāṃ japaiś ca homaiś ca pūyante nātra saṃśayaḥ |
meaning: सर्ववेदपवित्राणि वक्ष्याम्य् अहम् अतः परं । येषां जपैश् च होमैश् च पूयन्ते नात्र संशयः ।
text: I will now declare the purificatory texts (which are found) in each Veda; by muttering them or reciting them at a burnt-oblation (men) are doubtlessly cleansed (from sin).

sanskrit_iast: aghamarṣaṇaṃ devakṛtaṃ śuddhavatyas taratsamāḥ | kūṣmāṇḍāni pāvamānyo durgāsāvitrir eva ca |
meaning: अघमर्षणं देवकृतं शुद्धवत्यस् तरत्समाः । कूष्माण्डानि पावमान्यो दुर्गासावित्रिर् एव च ।
text: (They are) the Aghamarshaṇa, the Devak ri ta, the Śuddhavatīs, the Taratsamas, the K ūshmāṇd as, the Pāvamānīs, and the Durgāsāvitri;

sanskrit_iast: atīṣaṅgāḥ padastobhāḥ sāmāni vyāhṛtīs tathā | bhāruṇḍāni sāmāni ca gāyatraṃ raivataṃ tathā |
meaning: अतीषङ्गाः पदस्तोभाः सामानि व्याहृतीस् तथा । भारुण्डानि सामानि च गायत्रं रैवतं तथा ।
text: The Atīshaṅgas, the Padastobhas, and the Sāmans (called) Vyāh ri ti, the Bhāruṇd a Sāmans, the Gāyatra (Sāman), and the Raivata;

sanskrit_iast: puruṣavrataṃ ca bhāsaṃ ca tathā devavratāni ca | abliṅgaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ tu vācsūktaṃ madhvṛcas tathā |
meaning: पुरुषव्रतं च भासं च तथा देवव्रतानि च । अब्लिङ्गं बार्हस्पत्यं तु वाच्सूक्तं मध्वृचस् तथा ।
text: The Purushavrata and the Bhāsa, and likewise the Devavrata (Sāmans), the Abliṅga, the Bārhaspatya, the hymn addressed to Vā k , likewise the Ri k as (called) Madhu;

sanskrit_iast: śatarudriyam atharvaśiras trisuparṇaṃ mahāvratam | gosūktaṃ cāśvasūktaṃ ca śuddhāśuddhīye sāmanī |
meaning: शतरुद्रियम् अथर्वशिरस् त्रिसुपर्णं महाव्रतम् । गोसूक्तं चाश्वसूक्तं च शुद्धाशुद्धीये सामनी ।
text: The Śatarudriya, the Atharvaśiras, the Trisuparṇa, the Mahāvrata, the Gosūkta, and the Aśvasūkta, and the two Sāmans (called) Suddhāśuddhīya.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇ ājyadohāni rathantaraṃ ca agner vrataṃ vāmadevyaṃ bṛhac ca | etāni japtāni punanti jantūnjātismaratvaṃ labhate yadīcchet |
meaning: त्रीण् आज्यदोहानि रथन्तरं च अग्नेर् व्रतं वामदेव्यं बृहच् च । एतानि जप्तानि पुनन्ति जन्तून्जातिस्मरत्वं लभते यदीच्छेत् ।
text: The three (Sāmans called) Ā g yadohas, the Rathantara, the Agnervrata, the Vāmadevya, and the B ri hat, being muttered, purify (all) living beings. (He who sings them) may obtain the recollection of former existences, if he desires it.

sanskrit_iast: agner apatyaṃ prathamaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhūr vaiṣṇavī sūryasutāś ca gāvaḥ | tāsām anantaṃ phalam aśnuvīta yaḥ kāṃścanaṃ gāṃ ca mahīṃ ca dadyāt |
meaning: अग्नेर् अपत्यं प्रथमं सुवर्णं भूर् वैष्णवी सूर्यसुताश् च गावः । तासाम् अनन्तं फलम् अश्नुवीत यः कांश्चनं गां च महीं च दद्यात् ।
text: Gold is the firstborn of Fire, through Vishṇu exists the earth, and the cows are children of the [paragraph continues] Sun; he who bestows as gifts gold, a cow, and land will obtain rewards without end for them.

sanskrit_iast: uparundhanti dātāraṃ gaur aśvaḥ kanakaṃ kṣitiḥ | aśrotriyasya viprasya hastaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirākṛteḥ |
meaning: उपरुन्धन्ति दातारं गौर् अश्वः कनकं क्षितिः । अश्रोत्रियस्य विप्रस्य हस्तं दृष्ट्वा निराकृतेः ।
text: A cow, a horse, gold, (and) land, bestowed on an unlearned Brāhmaṇa who neglects his sacred duties, prevent the giver (from attaining heaven).

sanskrit_iast: vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā | tilān kṣaudreṇa saṃyuktān kṛṣṇān vā yadi vetarān |
meaning: वैशाख्यां पौर्णमास्यां तु ब्राह्मणान् सप्त पञ्च वा । तिलान् क्षौद्रेण संयुक्तान् कृष्णान् वा यदि वेतरान् ।

sanskrit_iast: prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti yad vā manasi vartate | yāvaj jīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati |
meaning: प्रीयतां धर्मराजेति यद् वा मनसि वर्तते । यावज् जीवकृतं पापं तत्क्षणाद् एव नश्यति ।

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇanābhaṃ kṛtvā tu sakhuraṃ kṛṣṇamārgajam | tilaiḥ pracchādya yo dadyāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
meaning: सुवर्णनाभं कृत्वा तु सखुरं कृष्णमार्गजम् । तिलैः प्रच्छाद्य यो दद्यात् तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ।
text: But hear (now) the reward of the merit acquired by that man who gives the skin of a black antelope, to which the hoofs are (still) attached and the navel of which is adorned with gold, covering it with sesamum grains.

sanskrit_iast: sasuvarṇaguhā tena saśailavanakānanā | caturvaktrā bhaved dattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ |
meaning: ससुवर्णगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना । चतुर्वक्त्रा भवेद् दत्ता पृथिवी नात्र संशयः ।
text: 'Without doubt he has bestowed (through that gift) the four-faced earth, together with its caves filled with gold, and together with its mountains, groves, and forests.'

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛtvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī | dadāti yas tu viprāya sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtām iti | sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam iti |
meaning: कृष्णाजिने तिलान् कृत्वा हिरण्यं मधुसर्पिषी । ददाति यस् तु विप्राय सर्वं तरति दुष्कृताम् इति । सर्वं तरति दुष्कृतम् इति ।
text: He who, placing on the skin of a black antelope, sesamum, gold, honey, and butter, gives it to a Brāhmaṇa, overcomes all sin.'

sanskrit_iast: dānena sarvān kāmān avāpnoti |
meaning: दानेन सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति ।
text: Through liberality (man) obtains all his desires,

sanskrit_iast: cirajīvitvaṃ brahmacārī rūpavān |
meaning: चिरजीवित्वं ब्रह्मचारी रूपवान् ।
text: (Even) longevity, (and he is born again as) a student of the Veda, possessed of beauty.

sanskrit_iast: ahiṃsy upapadyate svargam |
meaning: अहिंस्य् उपपद्यते स्वर्गम् ।
text: He who abstains from injuring (sentient beings) obtains heaven.

sanskrit_iast: agnipraveśād brahmalokaḥ |
meaning: अग्निप्रवेशाद् ब्रह्मलोकः ।
text: By entering a fire the world of Brahman (is gained).

sanskrit_iast: maunāt saubhāgyam |
meaning: मौनात् सौभाग्यम् ।
text: By (a vow of) silence (he obtains) happiness.

sanskrit_iast: nāgādhipatir udakavāsāt |
meaning: नागाधिपतिर् उदकवासात् ।
text: By staying (constantly) in water he becomes a lord of elephants.

sanskrit_iast: nirujaḥ kṣiṇakoṣaḥ |
meaning: निरुजः क्षिणकोषः ।
text: He who expends his hoard (in gifts) becomes free from disease.

sanskrit_iast: toyadaḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhaḥ |
meaning: तोयदः सर्वकामसमृद्धः ।
text: A giver of water (becomes) rich by (the fulfilment of) all his desires.

sanskrit_iast: annapradātā sucakṣuḥ smṛtimān |
meaning: अन्नप्रदाता सुचक्षुः स्मृतिमान् ।
text: A giver of food (will have) beautiful eyes and a good memory.

sanskrit_iast: medhāvī sarvato 'bhayadātā |
meaning: मेधावी सर्वतो ऽभयदाता ।
text: He who gives a promise to protect (somebody) from all dangers (becomes) wise.

sanskrit_iast: goprayukte sarvatīrthopasparśanam |
meaning: गोप्रयुक्ते सर्वतीर्थोपस्पर्शनम् ।
text: (To bestow gifts) for the use of cows (is equal to) bathing at all sacred places.

sanskrit_iast: śayyāsanadānād antaḥpurādhipatyam |
meaning: शय्यासनदानाद् अन्तःपुराधिपत्यम् ।
text: By giving a couch and a seat (the giver becomes) master of a harem.

sanskrit_iast: chatradānād gṛhalābhaḥ |
meaning: छत्रदानाद् गृहलाभः ।
text: By giving an umbrella (the giver) obtains a house.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhaprado nagaram āpnoti |
meaning: गृहप्रदो नगरम् आप्नोति ।
text: He who gives a house obtains a town.

sanskrit_iast: upānatpradātā yanam āsādayate |
meaning: उपानत्प्रदाता यनम् आसादयते ।
text: He who gives a pair of shoes obtains a vehicle.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | yat kimcit kurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarṣitaḥ | api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena śudhyati |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । यत् किम्चित् कुरुते पापं पुरुषो वृत्तिकर्षितः । अपि गोचर्ममात्रेण भूमिदानेन शुध्यति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): Whatever sin a man distressed for livelihood commits, (from that) he is purified by giving land, (be it) even "a bull's hide."'

sanskrit_iast: viprāyācamanārthaṃ tu dadyāt pūrṇakamaṇḍalum | pretya tṛptiṃ parāṃ prāpya somapo jāyate punaḥ |
meaning: विप्रायाचमनार्थं तु दद्यात् पूर्णकमण्डलुम् । प्रेत्य तृप्तिं परां प्राप्य सोमपो जायते पुनः ।
text: 'He who gives to a Brāhmaṇa a vessel filled with water for sipping, will obtain after death complete freedom from thirst and be born again as a drinker of Soma.'

sanskrit_iast: anaḍuhāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ dattānāṃ dhūryavāhinām | supātre vidhivaddānaṃ kanyādānena tat samam |
meaning: अनडुहां सहस्राणां दत्तानां धूर्यवाहिनाम् । सुपात्रे विधिवद्दानं कन्यादानेन तत् समम् ।
text: 'If a gift of one thousand oxen fit to draw a carriage (has been bestowed) according to the rule on a perfectly worthy man, that is equal to giving a maiden.'

sanskrit_iast: trīṇy āhur atidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī | atidānaṃ hi dānānāṃ vidyādānaṃ tato 'dhikam |
meaning: त्रीण्य् आहुर् अतिदानानि गावः पृथ्वी सरस्वती । अतिदानं हि दानानां विद्यादानं ततो ऽधिकम् ।
text: 'They declare that cows, land, and learning are the three most excellent gifts. For to give learning is (to bestow) the greatest of all gifts, and it surpasses those (other gifts).'

sanskrit_iast: ātyantikaphalapradaṃ mokṣasaṃsāramocanam | yo 'nasūyur imaṃ vidvān ācāram anuvartate |
meaning: आत्यन्तिकफलप्रदं मोक्षसंसारमोचनम् । यो ऽनसूयुर् इमं विद्वान् आचारम् अनुवर्तते ।
text: 'A learned man who, free from envy, follows this rule of conduct which procures endless rewards, and which through final liberation frees him from transmigration;'

sanskrit_iast: śraddadhānaḥ śucir dānto dhārayec chruṇuyād api | vihāya sarvapāpāni nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyata iti | nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyata iti |
meaning: श्रद्दधानः शुचिर् दान्तो धारयेच् छ्रुणुयाद् अपि । विहाय सर्वपापानि नाकपृष्ठे महीयत इति । नाकपृष्ठे महीयत इति ।
text: 'Or who, full of faith, pure, and subduing his senses, remembers or even hears it, will, freed from all sin, be exalted in the highest heaven.'

sanskrit_iast: dharmaṃ carata mādharmaṃ satyaṃ vadata mānṛtam | dīrghaṃ paśyata mā hrasvaṃ paraṃ paśyata māparam |
meaning: धर्मं चरत माधर्मं सत्यं वदत मानृतम् । दीर्घं पश्यत मा ह्रस्वं परं पश्यत मापरम् ।
text: Practise righteousness, not unrighteousness; speak truth, not untruth; look far, not near; look towards the Highest, not towards that which is not the Highest.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo bhavaty agniḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणो भवत्य् अग्निः ।
text: A Brāhmaṇa is a fire.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vai brāhmaṇa iti śruteḥ |
meaning: अग्निर् वै ब्राह्मण इति श्रुतेः ।
text: For the Veda (says), 'Agni, forsooth, is a Brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: tac ca katham |
meaning: तच् च कथम् ।
text: And how is that?

sanskrit_iast: tatra sado brāhmaṇasya śarīraṃ vediḥ saṃkalpo yajñaḥ paśur ātmā raśanā buddhiḥ sado mukham āhavanīyaṃ nābhyām udaro 'gnir gārhapatyaḥ prāṇo 'dhvaryur apāno hotā vyāno brahmā samāna udgātātmendriyāṇi yajñapātrāṇi ya evaṃ vidvān indriyair indriyārthaṃ juhotīty api ca kāṭhake vijñāyate |
meaning: तत्र सदो ब्राह्मणस्य शरीरं वेदिः संकल्पो यज्ञः पशुर् आत्मा रशना बुद्धिः सदो मुखम् आहवनीयं नाभ्याम् उदरो ऽग्निर् गार्हपत्यः प्राणो ऽध्वर्युर् अपानो होता व्यानो ब्रह्मा समान उद्गातात्मेन्द्रियाणि यज्ञपात्राणि य एवं विद्वान् इन्द्रियैर् इन्द्रियार्थं जुहोतीत्य् अपि च काठके विज्ञायते ।
text: And it is also declared in the Kā th aka, 'On that (occasion) the body of the Brāhmaṇa who represents the sacrificial seat is the altar, the vow to perform the rite is the sacrifice, the soul is the animal to be slain, the intellect the rope (with which the animal is bound), the mouth of (the Brāhmaṇa) who represents the seat is the Āhavanīya fire, in his navel (is the Dakshiṇā fire), the fire in his abdomen is the Gārhapatya fire, the Prāṇa is the Adhvaryu priest, the Apāna, the Hot ri priest, the Vyāna the Brahman, the Samāna the Udgāt ri priest, the organs of sensation the sacrificial vessels. He who knowing this offers a sacrifice to the organs through the organs.' . . .

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | pāti trāti ca dātāram ātmānaṃ caiva kilbiṣāt | vedendhanasamṛddheṣu hutaṃ vipramukhāgniṣu |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । पाति त्राति च दातारम् आत्मानं चैव किल्बिषात् । वेदेन्धनसमृद्धेषु हुतं विप्रमुखाग्निषु ।
text: Now they quote also (the following verses): 'An offering placed in the mouth-fire of a Brāhmaṇa which is rich in Veda-fuel, protects and saves the giver and (the eater) himself from sin.'

sanskrit_iast: na skandate na vyathate nainam adhyāpatec ca yat | variṣṭham agnihotrāt tu brāhmaṇasya mukhe hutam |
meaning: न स्कन्दते न व्यथते नैनम् अध्यापतेच् च यत् । वरिष्ठम् अग्निहोत्रात् तु ब्राह्मणस्य मुखे हुतम् ।
text: 'But the offering made through the mouth of a Brāhmaṇa, which is neither spilt nor causes pain (to sentient creatures), nor assails him (who makes it), is far more excellent than an Agnihotra.'

sanskrit_iast: dhyānāgniḥ satyopacayanaṃ kṣāntyāhutiḥ sruvaṃ hrīḥ puroḍāśam ahiṃsā saṃtoṣo | yūpaḥ kṛcchraṃ bhūtebhyo 'bhayadākṣiṇyam iti kṛtvā kratu mānasaṃ yāti kṣayaṃ budhaḥ |
meaning: ध्यानाग्निः सत्योपचयनं क्षान्त्याहुतिः स्रुवं ह्रीः पुरोडाशम् अहिंसा संतोषो । यूपः कृच्छ्रं भूतेभ्यो ऽभयदाक्षिण्यम् इति कृत्वा क्रतु मानसं याति क्षयं बुधः ।
text: After performing a mental sacrifice at which meditation (takes the place of the sacred) fire, truthfulness (the place of) the sacred fuel, patience (the place of) the oblation, modesty (the place of) the sacrificial spoon, abstention from injuring living beings (the place of the) sacrificial cake, contentment (the place of) the sacrificial post, (and a promise of) safety given to all beings which is hard to keep (the place of) the reward given to the priests, a wise man goes to his (eternal) home.

sanskrit_iast: jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ | jīvanāśā dhanāśā ca jīryato 'pi na jīryati |
meaning: जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः केशा दन्ता जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः । जीवनाशा धनाशा च जीर्यतो ऽपि न जीर्यति ।
text: The hair of an aging man shows signs of age, (and) the teeth of an aging man show signs of age, (but) the desire to live and the desire for wealth do not decay even in an aging man.

sanskrit_iast: yā dustyajā durmatibhir yā na jīryati jīryataḥ | yāsau prāṇāntiko vyādhis tāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham iti |
meaning: या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर् या न जीर्यति जीर्यतः । यासौ प्राणान्तिको व्याधिस् तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम् इति ।
text: Happiness (is the portion) of that man who relinquishes (all) desire, which fools give up with difficulty, which does not diminish with age, and which is a life-long disease.

sanskrit_iast: namo 'stu mitrāvaruṇayor urvaśyātmajāya śatayātave vasiṣṭhāya vasiṣṭhāyeti |
meaning: नमो ऽस्तु मित्रावरुणयोर् उर्वश्यात्मजाय शतयातवे वसिष्ठाय वसिष्ठायेति ।
text: Adoration to Vasish th a Satayātu, the son of Mitra and Varuṇa and Urvaśī!
